                function createJobCard($title, $dept, $exp, $expiry, $cat, $current_date, $id, $is_urgent = false) {
                    $is_closed = ($current_date > $expiry);
                    $status_class = $is_closed ? 'closed-job' : '';
                    $data_status = $is_closed ? 'closed' : 'open';
                    ?>
                    <div class="list-group-item p-4 job-card <?php echo $status_class; ?>" data-category="<?php echo $cat; ?>" data-status="<?php echo $data_status; ?>">
                        <div class="d-md-flex justify-content-between align-items-start">
                            <div class="flex-grow-1">
                                <span class="badge <?php echo $is_closed ? 'bg-secondary' : 'bg-light text-dark'; ?> mb-2">
                                    <?php echo $is_closed ? "Closed: " : "Closing: "; echo date('d M Y', strtotime($expiry)); ?>
                                </span>
                                <?php if ($is_urgent && !$is_closed): ?>
                                    <span class="badge badge-urgent mb-2 ms-1">URGENT</span>
                                <?php endif; ?>

                                <h5 class="fw-bold mb-2 <?php echo $is_closed ? 'text-muted' : ''; ?>"><?php echo $title; ?></h5>
                                <div class="job-details-meta">
                                    <span><i class="bi bi-building"></i> <?php echo $dept; ?></span>
                                    <span><i class="bi bi-briefcase"></i> <?php echo $exp; ?></span>
                                    <span><i class="bi bi-file-earmark-pdf"></i> <a href="#" class="btn-pdf ms-1">View JD</a></span>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="text-md-end mt-3 mt-md-0">
                                <div class="mb-3"><i class="bi bi-share share-link" onclick="shareJob('<?php echo $title; ?>', '<?php echo $id; ?>')"></i></div>
                                <?php if (!$is_closed): ?>
                                    <a href="apply-now.php?role=<?php echo $id; ?>" class="btn btn-warning fw-bold px-4 rounded-pill">Apply Now</a>
                                <?php else: ?>
                                    <button class="btn btn-secondary disabled rounded-pill px-4">Expired</button>
                                <?php endif; ?>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                <?php } ?>

    <script>
        function filterJobs() {
            let term = document.getElementById('jobSearch').value.toLowerCase();
            let cat = document.getElementById('categoryFilter').value;
            let stat = document.getElementById('statusFilter').value;
            let count = 0;

            document.querySelectorAll('.job-card').forEach(c => {
                let matchesSearch = c.innerText.toLowerCase().includes(term);
                let matchesCat = cat === 'all' || c.dataset.category === cat;
                let matchesStat = stat === 'all' || c.dataset.status === stat;

                if (matchesSearch && matchesCat && matchesStat) {
                    c.classList.remove('d-none');
                    count++;
                } else {
                    c.classList.add('d-none');
                }
            });
            document.getElementById('noJobs').classList.toggle('d-none', count > 0);
        }

        document.querySelectorAll('input, select').forEach(el => el.addEventListener('input', filterJobs));
        function resetFilters() { document.getElementById('jobSearch').value = ''; document.getElementById('categoryFilter').value = 'all'; document.getElementById('statusFilter').value = 'open'; filterJobs(); }
        
        function shareJob(t, i) { 
            const url = window.location.href + '?role=' + i;
            if (navigator.share) { navigator.share({ title: 'SJU Careers', text: `Apply for ${t}:`, url: url }); } 
            else { navigator.clipboard.writeText(url); alert('Link copied!'); }
        }
        filterJobs();
    </script>

<section class=" py-5 mt-2 text-center px-2">
  <div class="container">
    <!-- Section Heading -->
    <div class="title-area text-center pb-2">
        <h2 class="fw-bold mb-3">
           From Historic Institution  <span class="text-warning">to University Status</span>
        </h2>
    </div>
    
    <p class="text-muted">
      St Joseph's University (SJU) is a Jesuit university at the heart of Bengaluru, the Silicon city of India. Established in 1882 by Paris foreign Fathers, 
      the management of the college was handed over to the Jesuit order (Society of Jesus) in 1937. The college was first affiliated to the university of Madras 
      and later to the Mysore and Bangalore universities. In 1986, St Joseph's College became the first affiliated college in Karnataka to offer postgraduate courses. 
      In 1988, it became the first college in Karnataka to get a research center and in 2005, it was one of five colleges in Karnataka that was awarded academic autonomy. 
      In February 2021, St Joseph's University bill was presented in the Karnataka Legislative Assembly and was subsequently passed by the Legislative Assembly and Karnataka 
      Legislative Councill. The college received its University status on 2nd July 2022 and was inaugurated as India's first public-private university by the President of India, 
      Smt. Droupadi Murmu on 27 September 2022.
    </p> 
  </div>
</section>

  <script>
const searchInput = document.getElementById("FacultySearch");
const facultyCards = document.querySelectorAll(".data-item");

searchInput.addEventListener("keyup", function () {

    let searchValue = this.value.toLowerCase();

    facultyCards.forEach(card => {

        let text = card.innerText.toLowerCase();

        if (text.includes(searchValue)) {
            card.style.display = "";
        } else {
            card.style.display = "none";
        }

    });

});
</script>

          <p>St Joseph's University has established a documentation centre in order to create a database of all events, activities, programmes, projects, 
          meetings, seminars, conferences, achievements, publications, awards- academic, curricular, co-curricular and extracurricular activities related to staff, 
          students, management and alumni. Every detail of the life of our institution needs to be documented for perpetual memory. Hence the student leaders, 
          office bearers of various associations, officials, Deans, HODs, COE and office superintendent are required to cooperate in this great task of compiling and 
          documenting every event/activity by sending the required information along with the photographs, videos and reports in the detailed approach below:</p>
               <div class="row g-2">
                 <!-- Image Column -->
                 <div class="col-12 pgm_objective p-4 mb-2">
                     <ul class="language-list mt-4 p-0" style="list-style-type:none;">
                       <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Prior to the event : Any teachers with a login Id for Linways can go to the 
                       Linways staff log in :TAB- EXAT: TAB-event activities and major events: TAB-add new entry.</li> 
                       <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>The details are self explanatory. All events that are planned and need website 
                       coverage must be added here. It is compulsory for staff members to report a planned event here.</li> 

                       <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Post this the room booking can be done on the TAB for infrastructure management on Liways.</li> 
 
                       <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>After the event is completed the report must be handed over to the department incharge 
                       who will update the report by logging into Linways department incharge log  in(Doc- dept) :TAB- EXAT: TAB-department: TAB-events organised :TAB-add new entry.</li> 
                       <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Student achievements for clearing exams, participation  and securing various places can be 
                       recorded by the concerned department by logging into Linways department incharge log in(Doc- dept) : TAB- EXAT: TAB-studentst: TAB-achievements/SLET/NET /EXAM CLEARED  : 
                       TAB-add new entry.</li>  
                       <li><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Individual staff members must update their linways profile from time to time.</li> 
                     </ul>
                 </div>

<script>
document.getElementById('yearFilter').addEventListener('change', function () {
  const selectedYear = this.value;
  const items = document.querySelectorAll('.event-item');

  items.forEach(item => {
    if (item.getAttribute('data-year') === selectedYear) {
      item.style.display = "block";
    } else {
      item.style.display = "none";
    }
  });
});
</script>

          <article class=" mt-5 mb-2"> 
                  <p>In 1882, St. Joseph's College (SJC) had its significant beginnings with the French Foreign Mission fathers, who were mandated to start a 
                  catholic institution to cater to the catholic community that comprised about 1000 Europeans and 5000 Indians. In 1904, the European and Indian 
                  sections separated and until 1949, the institution remained affiliated to the Madras University. As a constituent of Madras University, it was 
                  granted the status of a first-grade College in 1926. The landmark year was 1937, for during this year the French Mission Fathers handed over its 
                  administration to the Society of Jesus (Jesuits). In 1949, the institution was affiliated to the Mysore University. In 1967, the institution was 
                  granted affiliation to Bangalore University. From 2018, the institution is affiliated to Bengaluru City University.  St Joseph's University is the 
                  upgradation of St. Joseph's College (Autonomous) under RUSA 2.0. In February 2021, St Joseph's University bill was presented in the 
                  Karnataka Legislative Assembly and was subsequently passed by the Legislative Assembly and Karnataka Legislative Councill. The college received its 
                  University status on 2 July 2022 and was inaugurated as India's first Public-Private-Parnership University by the Honourable President of India, 
                  Smt. Droupadi Murmu on 27 September 2022.</p>
        </article>

                              </svg>
                          </span>
                              <h4 class="fw-bold text_blue">St. Joseph's University – Aims</h4>
                       </header>
                       <ul class="language-list m-0 p-0" style="list-style-type:none;">
                             <li class="pb-3">
                                 <i class="fa fa-arrow-right me-2" style="color:#f39c12;"></i>To form socially responsible and resourceful citizens rooted in national identity and culture, 
                                 who will create a just, progressive, secular, inclusive and ecologically sensitive society. This we intend to achieve through affordable and world-class 
                                 higher education, aimed primarily at the marginalised sections of society, through experiential, research-based learning and academic excellence.</li>
                             <li class="pb-3">
                                 <i class="fa fa-arrow-right me-2" style="color:#f39c12;"></i>To generate and disseminate new knowledge that is academically progressive and socially empowering 
                                 through cutting-edge research.
                             </li>
                             <li class="pb-3">
                                 <i class="fa fa-arrow-right me-2" style="color:#f39c12;"></i>To impart holistic education that will make significant contributions to nation-building.
                             </li>
                       </ul>
                    </div>

                          <span class="info-icon">
                            <!-- Lightbulb SVG (scales better than icon fonts) -->
                              <svg width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                              <path d="M9 21h6M10 17h4M12 2a7 7 0 0 0-4 12c.6.6 1 1.5 1 2h6c0-.5.4-1.4 1-2a7 7 0 0 0-4-12Z" stroke="#f5a623" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
                              </svg>
                          </span>
                              <h4 class="fw-bold text_blue">Proposed Objectives</h4>
                       </header>
                      <ul class="language-list m-0 p-0" style="list-style-type:none;">
                             <li class="pb-3"> <i class="fa fa-arrow-right me-2" style="color:#f39c12;"></i>To provide higher education leading to excellence and innovations 
                             in Humanities, Sciences, Commerce, Management, Education, Technical Education, Law, Medical and Allied Health Sciences, Information Technology, 
                             Social Work, Mass Media, etc., undergraduate, postgraduate and research degree levels, fully conforming to the concept of a University in accordance 
                             with the University Education Report (1948), the Report of the Committee on Renovation, and Rejuvenation of Higher Education in India (2009).</li>
                             <li class="pb-3"> <i class="fa fa-arrow-right me-2" style="color:#f39c12;"></i>To provide high-quality teaching and research and to enable advancement of 
                             knowledge through various research programmes undertaken in-house by full time faculty/research scholars in diverse disciplines.</li>
                             <li class="pb-3"> <i class="fa fa-arrow-right me-2" style="color:#f39c12;"></i>To engage in areas of specialization with potential to make distinctive 
                             contributions that will realise the objectives of higher education, while at the same time strengthening our pluri-cultural heritage and promoting 
                             fruitful dialogue between tradition and modernity.</li>
                       </ul>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </article>
        
        <article class=" mt-5 mb-2">
            
               <div class="row g-2">
                 <!-- Image Column -->
                 <div class="col-lg-12 pgm_objective p-4 mb-2"> 
                 <h3 class="fw-bold text_blue">To foster intellectual competence by:</h3>
                     <ul class="language-list mt-4 p-0" style="list-style-type:none;">
                       <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Promoting a culture that nurtures critical and analytical thinking, 
                       nurturing skills of reasoning, discussion, teamwork, and coherent communication of ideas and issues through seminars, colloquia, and the 
                       incorporation of a research component into every course on offer.</li> 
                       <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Designing curricula that reflect the current state of knowledge with a 
                       focus on interdisciplinary approaches.</li> 
                       <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Creating study programmes wherein a degree may be earned entirely 
                       through research or practice.</li> 
                       <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Designing integrated degrees (such as B.A.Ed., B.Com. Ed., B.Sc. Ed., etc.,) 
                       that combine arts and science disciplines with education and teacher-development programmes with a view to addressing India's urgent needs for 
                       teaching excellence in schools.</li> 
                       <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Harnessing alternative and non-conventional systems/methods of learning and evaluation.</li> 
                       <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Evolving a meaningful ecology of curricular, co-curricular, and extra-curricular learning 
                       in a campus atmosphere that is liberal, democratic, intellectually challenging and empowering.</li> 
                       <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Creating the widest possible range of programmes, giving students options for 
                       free choice among disciplines.</li> 
                       <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Designing MOOCs, and partnering in SWAYAM & other online programmes.</li> 
                     </ul>
                 </div>
                 <!-- Content Column -->
                 <div class="col-lg-12 pgm_objective p-4">
                     <h3 class="fw-bold text_blue">To foster commitment to humane and humanising values through:</h3> 
                     <ul class="language-list mt-4 p-0" style="list-style-type:none;">
                       <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>A process of discussion, reflection, and introspection.</li>
                       <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Action programmes that place students in positions of responsibility that call for a strong commitment to values.</li>
                     </ul>
                 </div>
                 <div class="col-lg-12 pgm_objective p-4">
                     <h3 class="fw-bold text_blue">To activate social concern by:</h3> 
                     <ul class="language-list mt-4 p-0" style="list-style-type:none;">
                       <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Organizing outreach programmes through which students actively serve communities in need.</li>
                       <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Promoting gender sensitivity, ecological sensitivity, and disaster-response. Incorporating the social concern dimension into curricular design.</li>
                       <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Making relevant and positive interventions in the social space, especially aimed at the empowerment of the marginalised in both the urban and rural spheres.</li>
                       <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Promoting sustainability studies and research into alternative models of development as a means of seeking meaningful and innovative solutions to problems stemming from global warming and climate change.</li>
                     </ul>
                 </div>
               </div>
        </article>

  <script>
    (function () {
      var btns = document.querySelectorAll('.nl-filter-btn');
      var cards = document.querySelectorAll('.nl-card');
      var noResults = document.getElementById('nl-no-results');
      var countEl = document.getElementById('nl-count');

      btns.forEach(function (btn) {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
          btns.forEach(function (b) { b.classList.remove('active'); });
          btn.classList.add('active');

          var year = btn.getAttribute('data-year');
          var visible = 0;

          cards.forEach(function (card) {
            var match = year === 'all' || card.getAttribute('data-year') === year;
            card.style.display = match ? '' : 'none';
            if (match) visible++;
          });

          noResults.style.display = visible === 0 ? '' : 'none';
          countEl.textContent = visible + (visible === 1 ? ' Edition' : ' Editions');
        });
      });
    })();
  </script>

    .nl-badge-new { background: #fff3cd; color: #856404; border: 1px solid #ffc107; }

    .nl-btn-view {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a3c6e, #2563b0);
      color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 9px 22px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600;
      white-space: nowrap; transition: opacity 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
    }
    .nl-btn-view:hover { opacity: 0.9; color: #fff; transform: translateY(-1px); }
  </style>

  <script>
    (function () {
      var btns = document.querySelectorAll('.nl-filter-btn');
      var cards = document.querySelectorAll('.nl-card');
      var noResults = document.getElementById('nirf-no-results');
      var countEl = document.getElementById('nirf-count');

      btns.forEach(function (btn) {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
          btns.forEach(function (b) { b.classList.remove('active'); });
          btn.classList.add('active');

          var year = btn.getAttribute('data-year');
          var visible = 0;

          cards.forEach(function (card) {
            var match = year === 'all' || card.getAttribute('data-year') === year;
            card.style.display = match ? '' : 'none';
            if (match) visible++;
          });

          noResults.style.display = visible === 0 ? '' : 'none';
          countEl.textContent = visible + (visible === 1 ? ' Report' : ' Reports');
        });
      });
    })();
  </script>

        <p>Arrupe Nivas is a vibrant and diverse community of Jesuit faculty members, administrators, and students from different parts of the world. 
        The construction of the residence was completed in the year 2000 and is located in the North wing of St. Joseph`s University campus on Langford Road- Bengaluru. 
        The Faculty residence is presently composed of 22 members who bring together perspectives and expertise from varied academic disciplines, including the social sciences, 
        natural sciences, computer sciences, media studies, business studies, research and development in addition to archival and record management. As a community of administrators, 
        educators and learners, Arrupe Nivas is committed to living out the Jesuit values of intellectual inquiry, spiritual growth, social concern and Civic engagement. While the members 
        have a demonstrated history in education management they simultaneously oversee the day-to-day operations of the residence while fostering spiritual growth and ensuring a supportive 
        environment for all its companions. This is in conjunction with our modus vivendi which is centred on Cura Personalis – translated to care for the whole person and Cura Apostolica – 
        The care for our mission and its collaborators. Our administrators include the Rector, who is also the Pro Chancellor of the University and his team of consultors who tend to the 
        spiritual and material needs of all at Arrupe Nivas Jesuit Faculty Residence. We invite you to visit Arrupe Nivas to learn more about us and the activities we are engaged in. 
        Contact us at: Rector and superior of Jesuit community: Fr Swebert D'Sliva SJ Administrator of the Jesuit community: Fr Cyril D'Mello SJ</p>

<section class="timeline-section py-5 px-3">
  <div class="container">

    <!-- Section Header -->
    <div class="title-area text-center pb-2">
        <h2 class="fw-bold mb-3">
           Defining moments that <span class="text-warning">shaped our legacy</span>
        </h2>
    </div>

    <!-- Timeline Item 1 -->
    <article class="timeline-item p-4 px-2 px-sm-4">
      <div class="row align-items-start">
        
        <div class="col-md-3 col-12 mb-3 mb-md-0">
          <div class="timeline-year">
            <span class="year text-warning">1854</span>
            <span class="year-line"></span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="col-md-9 col-12">
          <div class="timeline-content position-relative p-4">
          <p class="timeline-text mb-0">
            St Joseph's was founded by the catholic priests of Missions Etrangeres\' de Paris (MEP) in 1854. 
            It was first started as a seminary on a piece of land known as St John's Hill (near present day 
            St. John's Church, north-west of Ulsoor, Bengaluru).
          </p>
         </div>
        </div>

      </div>
    </article> 

    <!-- Timeline Item 2 -->
    <article class="timeline-item p-4 px-0 px-sm-4">
      <div class="row align-items-start">
        
        <div class="col-md-3 col-12 mb-3 mb-md-0">
          <div class="timeline-year">
            <span class="year text-warning">1882</span>
            <span class="year-line"></span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="col-md-9 col-12">
         <div class="timeline-content position-relative p-4">
          <p class="timeline-text mb-0">
            The small seminary was transformed to a full fledged college by the then rector Fr. Maurice Vissac in 1882. 
            He had the college affiliated to the Madras University which could prepare and send students for the F.A. (First Arts) exams.
          </p>
         </div>
        </div>

      </div>
    </article> 
    <!-- Timeline Item 3 -->
    <article class="timeline-item p-4 px-0 px-sm-4">
      <div class="row align-items-start">
        
        <div class="col-md-3 col-12 mb-3 mb-md-0">
          <div class="timeline-year">
            <span class="year text-warning">1884</span>
            <span class="year-line"></span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="col-md-9 col-12">
          <div class="timeline-content position-relative p-4">
          <p class="timeline-text mb-0">
            In 1884, 2 candidates appeared for this exam and qualified successfully. Fr. Vissac, being a visionary, 
            wanted the school to be located in the heart of the city and shifted the college to the vicinity of St Patrick's Church, Bengaluru.
          </p>
          </div>
        </div>

      </div>
    </article> 

<!-- Timeline Item 4 -->
    <article class="timeline-item p-4 px-0 px-sm-4">
      <div class="row align-items-start">
        
        <div class="col-md-3 col-12 mb-3 mb-md-0">
          <div class="timeline-year">
            <span class="year text-warning">1937</span>
            <span class="year-line"></span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="col-md-9 col-12">
          <div class="timeline-content position-relative p-4">
          <p class="timeline-text mb-0"> 
            In 1937, the management of the college was transferred to the Jesuit order. Following the independence of the country and the birth of the state of Karnataka, 
            the college was affiliated to the Mysore University.
          </p>
          </div>
        </div>

      </div>
    </article> 
    <!-- Timeline Item 5 -->
    <article class="timeline-item p-4 px-0 px-sm-4">
      <div class="row align-items-start">
        
        <div class="col-md-3 col-12 mb-3 mb-md-0">
          <div class="timeline-year">
            <span class="year text-warning">1967</span>
            <span class="year-line"></span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="col-md-9 col-12">
          <div class="timeline-content position-relative p-4">
          <p class="timeline-text mb-0"> 
            With the establishment of the Bangalore university, the college was permanently affiliated to it since 1967.
          </p>
          </div>
        </div>

      </div>
    </article> 
    <!-- Timeline Item 6 -->
    <article class="timeline-item p-4 px-0 px-sm-4">
      <div class="row align-items-start">
        
        <div class="col-md-3 col-12 mb-3 mb-md-0">
          <div class="timeline-year">
            <span class="year text-warning">1986</span>
            <span class="year-line"></span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="col-md-9 col-12">
          <div class="timeline-content position-relative p-4">
          <p class="timeline-text mb-0"> 
            In 1986, it became the first affiliated college in Karnataka to offer postgraduate programmes.
          </p>
          </div>
        </div>

      </div>
    </article> 
    <!-- Timeline Item 7 -->
    <article class="timeline-item p-4 px-0 px-sm-4">
      <div class="row align-items-start">
        
        <div class="col-md-3 col-12 mb-3 mb-md-0">
          <div class="timeline-year">
            <span class="year text-warning">1988</span>
            <span class="year-line"></span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="col-md-9 col-12">
          <div class="timeline-content position-relative p-4">
          <p class="timeline-text mb-0"> 
            In 1988, it became the first college in Karnataka to get a research center.
          </p>
          </div>
        </div>

      </div>
    </article> 
    <!-- Timeline Item 8 -->
    <article class="timeline-item p-4 px-0 px-sm-4">
      <div class="row align-items-start">
        
        <div class="col-md-3 col-12 mb-3 mb-md-0">
          <div class="timeline-year">
            <span class="year text-warning">1998</span>
            <span class="year-line"></span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="col-md-9 col-12">
          <div class="timeline-content position-relative p-4">
          <p class="timeline-text mb-0"> 
            The college is also one of the early ones to go for NAAC accreditation in 1998.
          </p>
          </div>
        </div>

      </div>
    </article> 
    <!-- Timeline Item 9 -->
    <article class="timeline-item p-4 px-0 px-sm-4">
      <div class="row align-items-start">
        
        <div class="col-md-3 col-12 mb-3 mb-md-0">
          <div class="timeline-year">
            <span class="year text-warning">2001</span>
            <span class="year-line"></span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="col-md-9 col-12">
          <div class="timeline-content position-relative p-4">
          <p class="timeline-text mb-0"> 
            In 2001 the college moved from the Residency Road campus to its present location at the intersection of Langford Road 
            and Lalbagh Road. The college held many achievements to its credit.
          </p>
          </div>
        </div>

      </div>
    </article> 
     <!-- Timeline Item 10 -->
    <article class="timeline-item p-4 px-0 px-sm-4">

            <span class="year text-warning">2021</span>
            <span class="year-line"></span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="col-md-9 col-12">
          <div class="timeline-content position-relative p-4">

            It was subsequently passed by the Karnataka Legislative Council.
          </p>
          </div>
        </div>

      </div>

        <p>Aloysius Sequeira hails from Mangalore and completed his early education at St. Aloysius College. He holds a Bachelor of Engineering in Electrical Power, a 
        Master of Technology in Industrial Management from the esteemed Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Bombay, and a Ph.D. from Mysore University. Additionally, 
        he obtained a Diploma in Training & Development from the Indian Society for Training & Development (ISTD).</p>

        <p>With over 41 years of professional experience in teaching, research, and administration, Dr. Sequeira has made significant contributions to NITK. Throughout 
        his four-decade career there, he has held various positions, including Director of NITK-STEP, Registrar, Head of Department, and Dean of Faculty Welfare at NITK Surathkal.</p>

        <p>He has published 78 papers in reputable, indexed research journals, supervised 13 research scholars in their pursuit of a Ph.D., and successfully completed three sponsored 
        research projects funded by the Government of India. Dr. Sequeira also serves as an associate editor for a reputed journal and reviewer for six distinguished research journals.</p>

        <p>He received sponsorship to undergo training in Educational Technology at the University of Huddersfield in England and has visited several prestigious universities in the U.K., 
        Germany, Switzerland, Singapore, and the USA for various official assignments.</p>

        <p>Dr. Sequeira is an active member of several university bodies, including the National Board of Accreditation (NBA), University Grants Commission (UGC), National Assessment and 
        Accreditation Council (NAAC), and the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), among others.</p>

        <p>He has been recognized with five different awards for his service and excellence, including the Distinguished Alumni Award from M.I.T. Manipal. Dr. Sequeira retired in May 2022 
        as a Professor (Higher Administrative Grade) from the School of Management at NITK Surathkal.</p>

        <div class="saint-content">
         <p>
           St Joseph's University is run by a Catholic religious order known as the Society of Jesus (SJ). The members of the Society of Jesus 
           are popularly known as the Jesuits. The origins of the Society of Jesus go back to Saint Ignatius of Loyola, a 16th century Spanish soldier. 
           In 1521, he was seriously wounded in a battle against the French in Pamplona, Spain. Intense prayer over months of painful recuperation prompted 
           a personal transformation. He gave up his military career and became a soldier for Jesus Christ possessed with a single vision of establishing a 
           world of humanity and justice. He found friends who shared his vision and went on to establish the Society of Jesus in 1540.
         </p>
         <p>
           Saint Ignatius of Loyola had a keen desire to spread education and knowledge, media of liberation for a just and equitable society. 
           The group he founded, the Society of Jesus, has been active in the field of education throughout the world since its origin. In the world, 
           the Jesuits are responsible for 3,897 educational institutions in 96 countries. The education imparted by the Jesuits aims at the integral, 
           personal formation of youth.
         </p>

</div>
      </div>

    </div>
</div>

          <p>My hand and God's - what'er the odds</p>

          <p>Evils onset hold in defiance!</p>

      <div class="title-line">
        <h2 class="text-white">University Emblem and Motto </h2>
        <p class="year-line m-0"></p>
      </div>
    </div>

  <div class="container">

    <div class="row align-items-center gy-5 px-2 py-5">

      <!-- Emblem Image -->
      <div class="col-lg-5 text-center">
        <img src="../assets/img/about/St-Josephs-university-emblem.webp" 
             alt="University Emblem with Motto Fide et Labore"
             class="img-fluid emblem-img">
      </div>

      <!-- Content -->
      <div class="col-lg-7">
        <div class="emblem-content">

          <p>
              The emblem of an institution is the central representation of the core values which it stands for. Envisioned by the French Foreign Missionary Fathers in 1882, 
              the emblem and motto announce these core values of the institution.
          </p>

          <p>The emblem is made up of two scrolls, one scroll is placed above the crown, on which is inscribed the motto of the Institution in Latin - <span class="highlight">"Fide et Labore" </span>
             which translated to "Faith and Toil" and on the other scroll is placed beneath the palm leaves which bear the name of the Institution. 
             The shield which bears a cross in the centre is symbolic of Christian faith. There are two bees on either side of the lower part of the cross 
             representing hard and persevering work. The crown, which is placed above the shield, is a heraldic symbol of supremacy and glory. 
             The compartment beneath the shield consists of palm leaves that are a sign of victory.
          </p>

          <p>The University motto is 'Fide et Labore' which means <span class="highlight">'Faith and Toil'</span>. Faith among other things gives persons a commitment to God, 
             to his fellowmen, to intellectual pursuits. Toil is a necessary pre-requisite for success.
          </p> 

        </div>
      </div>

    </div>

  </div>
</section>

                         </svg>
                    </span>
                            <h2>Vision</h2>
                </header>
                <p> To form women and men for and with others, who through holistic education, strive for a just, secular, democratic, and ecologically sensitive 
                society which empowers the poor, the oppressed and the marginalized.</p>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="col-lg-6 d-flex">
            <div class="info-card vision-card w-100">
                <header class="info-card-header">
                    <span class="info-icon">
                    <!-- Lightbulb SVG (scales better than icon fonts) -->
                    <svg width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                    <path d="M9 21h6M10 17h4M12 2a7 7 0 0 0-4 12c.6.6 1 1.5 1 2h6c0-.5.4-1.4 1-2a7 7 0 0 0-4-12Z" stroke="#f5a623" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
                    </svg>
                    </span>
                     <h2>Mission</h2>
                </header>
                <p> In keeping with the Jesuit heritage, the university aims at an integral formation of the staff and the students, to be men and women who will be agents of societal change, 
                by enabling them to attain academic and human excellence in a teaching-learning environment that fosters intellectual curiosity, ceaseless enquiry, personal integrity, 
                social commitment, creativity, critical thinking, and innovation.</p>
            </div>
         </div>
    </div>
    <!--Values-->
    <div class="row align-items-stretch">
        <div class="col-12">
            <div class="our-values w-100 py-4 px-5">
                <div class="saint-caption mt-4 pb-3">
                  <div class="accent-line my-3"></div>
                  <h2 class="text-center text_blue fw-bold">Values</h2> 
                </div>
                <p> St Joseph's University is focused on nurturing a vibrant academic environment anchored in a framework of core values that constitute the foundation of Jesuit education:</p>
                <ol class="eligibility-list p-0">
                       <li class="pb-3"><strong>‘Cura Personalis' - </strong>emphasises the view that reach person is a unique creation of God. ‘Cura Personalis' (meaning ‘care of whole self') 
                       is demonstrated by personal attention in the classroom, a deep respect for diversity and an emphasis on holistic care for the mind, body and spirit;</li>
                       <li class="pb-3"><strong>Discernment - </strong> Discernment encourages students to be open to God's spirit as they make decisions and take actions that contribute to the greater good. Discernment is 
                       practiced through prayer, reflection, consultation with others and considering the full impact of actions from diverse perspectives;</li>

                       <li class="pb-3"><strong>Finding God in all things – </strong>A Jesuit education is one grounded in the presence of God, and encompasses imagination, emotion and intellect. 
                       The Jesuit Vision encourages students to see the divine in all things – in all people and cultures, in all areas of study and learning, and in every human experience;  </li>

                       <li class="pb-3"><strong>‘Magis' – </strong>A commitment to the concept of ‘Magis' is a hallmark of Jesuit education. It challenges students to go beyond what is expected, 
                       interacting with the world with generosity, excellence and empathy. ‘Magis' is modelled by personal accountability and high expectations and achievement;</li>

                       <li class="pb-3"><strong>Reflection -  </strong>A foundational value of Jesuit education is the practice of reflection. Students are invited to pause and consider the world 
                       around them and their place within it, before making decisions. This includes challenging the status quo, acknowledging biases and accepting responsibility for action;</li>

                       <li class="pb-3"><strong>Service rooted in justice and love -  </strong>Jesuit education cultivates critical awareness of social and personal evil, but points out that 
                       God' s love is more powerful. This value is illustrated through community service programs, immersion experiences, and various volunteering opportunities for students;</li>

                       <li class="pb-3"><strong>Solidarity and kinship – </strong>Students work together for the greater good. They develop relationships with their surrounding communities 
                       and share their talents and skills to help and  serve others. This value is practiced through community-engaged learning, where 
                       students work with community members to come up with innovative solutions. </li>
                     </ol>
            </div>
        </div> 
    </div>
  </div>

<script>

/* PROGRAM FILTER */

const levelFilter = document.getElementById("levelFilter");
const schoolFilter = document.getElementById("schoolFilter");
const blocks = document.querySelectorAll(".school-block");
const noResults = document.getElementById("noResults");

function filterCourses(){

let level = levelFilter.value;
let school = schoolFilter.value;

let visibleCount = 0;

blocks.forEach(block=>{

let blockLevel = block.dataset.level;
let blockSchool = block.dataset.school;

let levelMatch = (level === "all" || blockLevel === level);
let schoolMatch = (school === "all" || blockSchool === school);

if(levelMatch && schoolMatch){
block.style.display = "grid";
visibleCount++;
}else{
block.style.display = "none";
}

});

/* SHOW MESSAGE IF NOTHING VISIBLE */

if(visibleCount === 0){
noResults.style.display = "block";
}else{
noResults.style.display = "none";
}

}

document.getElementById("filterBtn").addEventListener("click", filterCourses);

/* run on page load */
filterCourses();



/* FEE MODAL */

document.querySelectorAll(".fee-btn").forEach(btn=>{

btn.addEventListener("click",function(){

let url = this.dataset.url;

document.getElementById("feeContent").innerHTML = "Loading...";

fetch("fee_fetch.php?url="+encodeURIComponent(url)+"&t="+Date.now())
.then(res=>res.text())
.then(data=>{

if(data.trim() === ""){
document.getElementById("feeContent").innerHTML = "Fee details not available.";
}else{
document.getElementById("feeContent").innerHTML = data;
}

})
.catch(()=>{
document.getElementById("feeContent").innerHTML = "Unable to load fee details.";
});

let modal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById("feeModal"));
modal.show();

});

});

</script>

<script>

/* PROGRAM FILTER */

const levelFilter = document.getElementById("levelFilter");
const schoolFilter = document.getElementById("schoolFilter");
const blocks = document.querySelectorAll(".school-block");
const noResults = document.getElementById("noResults");

function filterCourses(){

let level = levelFilter.value;
let school = schoolFilter.value;

let visibleCount = 0;

blocks.forEach(block=>{

let blockLevel = block.dataset.level;
let blockSchool = block.dataset.school;

let levelMatch = (level === "all" || blockLevel === level);
let schoolMatch = (school === "all" || blockSchool === school);

if(levelMatch && schoolMatch){
block.style.display = "grid";
visibleCount++;
}else{
block.style.display = "none";
}

});

/* SHOW MESSAGE IF NOTHING VISIBLE */

if(visibleCount === 0){
noResults.style.display = "block";
}else{
noResults.style.display = "none";
}

}

document.getElementById("filterBtn").addEventListener("click", filterCourses);

/* run on page load */
filterCourses();



/* FEE MODAL */

document.querySelectorAll(".fee-btn").forEach(btn=>{

btn.addEventListener("click",function(){

let url = this.dataset.url;

document.getElementById("feeContent").innerHTML = "Loading...";

fetch("fee_fetch.php?url="+encodeURIComponent(url)+"&t="+Date.now())
.then(res=>res.text())
.then(data=>{

if(data.trim() === ""){
document.getElementById("feeContent").innerHTML = "Fee details not available.";
}else{
document.getElementById("feeContent").innerHTML = data;
}

})
.catch(()=>{
document.getElementById("feeContent").innerHTML = "Unable to load fee details.";
});

let modal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById("feeModal"));
modal.show();

});

});

</script>

<script>

/* PROGRAM FILTER */

const levelFilter = document.getElementById("levelFilter");
const schoolFilter = document.getElementById("schoolFilter");
const blocks = document.querySelectorAll(".school-block");
const noResults = document.getElementById("noResults");

function filterCourses(){

let level = levelFilter.value;
let school = schoolFilter.value;

let visibleCount = 0;

blocks.forEach(block=>{

let blockLevel = block.dataset.level;
let blockSchool = block.dataset.school;

let levelMatch = (level === "all" || blockLevel === level);
let schoolMatch = (school === "all" || blockSchool === school);

if(levelMatch && schoolMatch){
block.style.display = "grid";
visibleCount++;
}else{
block.style.display = "none";
}

});

/* SHOW MESSAGE IF NOTHING VISIBLE */

if(visibleCount === 0){
noResults.style.display = "block";
}else{
noResults.style.display = "none";
}

}

document.getElementById("filterBtn").addEventListener("click", filterCourses);

/* run on page load */
filterCourses();



/* FEE MODAL */

document.querySelectorAll(".fee-btn").forEach(btn=>{

btn.addEventListener("click",function(){

let url = this.dataset.url;

document.getElementById("feeContent").innerHTML = "Loading...";

fetch("fee_fetch.php?url="+encodeURIComponent(url)+"&t="+Date.now())
.then(res=>res.text())
.then(data=>{

if(data.trim() === ""){
document.getElementById("feeContent").innerHTML = "Fee details not available.";
}else{
document.getElementById("feeContent").innerHTML = data;
}

})
.catch(()=>{
document.getElementById("feeContent").innerHTML = "Unable to load fee details.";
});

let modal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById("feeModal"));
modal.show();

});

});

</script> 
  <!-- Footer injected -->

        '/home/sjubedu/config.php',
        __DIR__ . '/../config.php',
        __DIR__ . '/../../config.php',
        __DIR__ . '/../../../config.php'
    ];

    $config_loaded = false;

    // Loop through paths and load the first one that exists
    foreach ($config_paths as $path) {
        if (file_exists($path)) {
            require_once $path;
            $config_loaded = true;
            break;
        }
    }

    if (!$config_loaded) {
        die("Error: Configuration file not found.");
    }

<script>

/* PROGRAM FILTER */

const levelFilter = document.getElementById("levelFilter");
const schoolFilter = document.getElementById("schoolFilter");
const blocks = document.querySelectorAll(".school-block");
const noResults = document.getElementById("noResults");

function filterCourses(){

let level = levelFilter.value;
let school = schoolFilter.value;

let visibleCount = 0;

blocks.forEach(block=>{

let blockLevel = block.dataset.level;
let blockSchool = block.dataset.school;

let levelMatch = (level === "all" || blockLevel === level);
let schoolMatch = (school === "all" || blockSchool === school);

if(levelMatch && schoolMatch){
block.style.display = "grid";
visibleCount++;
}else{
block.style.display = "none";
}

});

/* SHOW MESSAGE IF NOTHING VISIBLE */

if(visibleCount === 0){
noResults.style.display = "block";
}else{
noResults.style.display = "none";
}

}

document.getElementById("filterBtn").addEventListener("click", filterCourses);

/* run on page load */
filterCourses();



/* FEE MODAL */

document.querySelectorAll(".fee-btn").forEach(btn=>{

btn.addEventListener("click",function(){

let url = this.dataset.url;

document.getElementById("feeContent").innerHTML = "Loading...";

fetch("fee_fetch.php?url="+encodeURIComponent(url)+"&t="+Date.now())
.then(res=>res.text())
.then(data=>{

if(data.trim() === ""){
document.getElementById("feeContent").innerHTML = "Fee details not available.";
}else{
document.getElementById("feeContent").innerHTML = data;
}

})
.catch(()=>{
document.getElementById("feeContent").innerHTML = "Unable to load fee details.";
});

let modal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById("feeModal"));
modal.show();

});

});

</script>

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
  var cards     = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.calendar-card'));
  var countEl   = document.getElementById('scCount');
  var searchEl  = document.getElementById('scSearch');
  var noResults = document.getElementById('scNoResults');
  var sugBox    = document.getElementById('scSuggestions');

  /* ââ Tags ââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââ
   * Reads the card title and auto-detects the programme level tag.
   * Checked in priority order (PG Diploma before PG, etc.).
   *
   * TO ADD A NEW ABBREVIATION â find the right line and append:
   *   PG Diploma : "postgraduate diploma|pg diploma"
   *   PhD        : "\bph\.?d\b|doctor of"
   *   PG         : "\bmaster\b|m\.sc.|m\.a.|m\.com.|mba\b|m\.c\.a.|mca\b|m\.ed.|m\.s\.w.|m\.des."
   *   UG         : "\bbachelor\b|b\.sc.|b\.a.|b\.com.|bba\b|b\.b\.a.|bca\b|b\.c\.a.|b\.ed.|b\.s\.w.|b\.voc."
   *   Shift III  : added on top of the level tag if title contains "Shift III"
   *
   * Examples:
   *   "Master of Science (M.Sc.) in Physics"              â' PG
   *   "Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.)"                     â' UG
   *   "Postgraduate Diploma in Cyber Security"            â' PG Diploma
   *   "Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) Shift III" â' UG + Shift III
   *   "Ph.D in Chemistry"                                 â' PhD
   * âââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââ */
  function getTags(title) {
    var tags = [];
    // PG Diploma â checked first so it doesn't match PG by mistake
    if (/postgraduate diploma|pg diploma/i.test(title))
      tags.push({ label: 'PG Diploma', cls: 'sc-tag-pgdip' });
    // PhD
    else if (/\bph\.?d\b|doctor of/i.test(title))
      tags.push({ label: 'PhD', cls: 'sc-tag-phd' });
    // PG â add new master's abbreviations after m\.s\.w\.
    else if (/\bmaster\b|m\.sc\.|m\.a\.|m\.com\.|mba\b|m\.c\.a\.|mca\b|m\.ed\.|m\.s\.w\./i.test(title))
      tags.push({ label: 'PG', cls: 'sc-tag-pg' });
    // UG â add new bachelor's abbreviations after b\.s\.w\.
    else if (/\bbachelor\b|b\.sc\.|b\.a\.|b\.com\.|bba\b|b\.b\.a\.|bca\b|b\.c\.a\.|b\.ed\.|b\.s\.w\./i.test(title))
      tags.push({ label: 'UG', cls: 'sc-tag-ug' });
    // Shift III â added on top of the level tag above
    if (/shift\s*iii/i.test(title))
      tags.push({ label: 'Shift III', cls: 'sc-tag-shift' });
    return tags;
  }
  cards.forEach(function (card) {
    var titleEl = card.querySelector('.calendar-title, h5');
    if (!titleEl) return;
    var tags = getTags(titleEl.textContent);
    if (!tags.length) return;
    var wrap = document.createElement('div');
    wrap.className = 'sc-tags';
    tags.forEach(function (t) {
      var s = document.createElement('span');
      s.className = 'sc-tag ' + t.cls;
      s.textContent = t.label;
      wrap.appendChild(s);
    });
    titleEl.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', wrap);
  });

  /* ââ Count badges on filter tabs ââ */
  var levelMap = { ug: 0, pg: 0, pgdip: 0, phd: 0 };
  cards.forEach(function (card) {
    var titleEl = card.querySelector('.calendar-title, h5');
    if (!titleEl) return;
    var t = titleEl.textContent;
    if (/postgraduate diploma|pg diploma/i.test(t)) levelMap.pgdip++;
    else if (/\bph\.?d\b|doctor of/i.test(t)) levelMap.phd++;
    else if (/\bmaster\b|m\.sc\.|m\.a\.|m\.com\.|mba\b|m\.c\.a\.|mca\b|m\.ed\.|m\.s\.w\./i.test(t)) levelMap.pg++;
    else if (/\bbachelor\b|b\.sc\.|b\.a\.|b\.com\.|bba\b|b\.b\.a\.|bca\b|b\.c\.a\.|b\.ed\.|b\.s\.w\./i.test(t)) levelMap.ug++;
    card.setAttribute('data-level',
      /postgraduate diploma|pg diploma/i.test(t) ? 'pgdip' :
      /\bph\.?d\b|doctor of/i.test(t) ? 'phd' :
      /\bmaster\b|m\.sc\.|m\.a\.|m\.com\.|mba\b|m\.c\.a\.|mca\b|m\.ed\.|m\.s\.w\./i.test(t) ? 'pg' :
      /\bbachelor\b|b\.sc\.|b\.a\.|b\.com\.|bba\b|b\.b\.a\.|bca\b|b\.c\.a\.|b\.ed\.|b\.s\.w\./i.test(t) ? 'ug' : 'other');
  });
  var fcAll = document.getElementById('fc-all'); if (fcAll) fcAll.textContent = cards.length;
  ['ug','pg','pgdip','phd'].forEach(function (k) {
    var el = document.getElementById('fc-' + k); if (el) el.textContent = levelMap[k];
  });

  /* ââ Count ââ */
  if (countEl) countEl.textContent = cards.length + ' document' + (cards.length === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' listed';
  if (!searchEl) return;


  /* ââ Cache card text ââ */
  var cardTexts   = cards.map(function (c) { return c.textContent.toLowerCase(); });
  var filterCache = {};

  /* ââ Fuzzy match ââ */
  function isSubseq(n, h) {
    var ni = 0;
    for (var hi = 0; hi < h.length && ni < n.length; hi++)
      if (n[ni] === h[hi]) ni++;
    return ni === n.length;
  }
  function fuzzyMatch(text, q) {
    if (!q) return true;
    if (text.includes(q)) return true;
    return q.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).every(function (qw) {
      if (text.includes(qw)) return true;
      if (qw.length < 4) return false;
      return text.split(/\W+/).some(function (tw) {
        return tw.length >= qw.length && tw.length <= qw.length + 3 && isSubseq(qw, tw);
      });
    });
  }

  /* ââ Filter cards ââ */
  function runFilter(q) {
    var ql = q.toLowerCase().trim();
    var res = filterCache[ql];
    if (!res) { res = cardTexts.map(function (t) { return fuzzyMatch(t, ql); }); filterCache[ql] = res; }
    var vis = 0;
    cards.forEach(function (card, i) {
      if (res[i]) { card.style.removeProperty('display'); vis++; }
      else card.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
    });
    if (countEl) countEl.textContent = vis + ' document' + (vis === 1 ? '' : 's') + (ql ? ' found' : ' listed');
    if (noResults) noResults.style.display = vis === 0 ? '' : 'none';
  }

  /* ââ Suggestion bank ââ */
  var seen = {}, bank = [];
  function addSug(label, type) {
    var k = label.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    if (!seen[k] && k.length > 1) { seen[k] = 1; bank.push({ label: label.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(), type: type }); }
  }
  ['January','February','March','April','May','June','July','August','September','October','November','December']
    .forEach(function (m) { addSug(m, 'date'); });
  for (var y = 2024; y <= 2030; y++) addSug(String(y), 'date');
  cards.forEach(function (card) {
    var titleEl = card.querySelector('.calendar-title, h5');
    if (!titleEl) return;
    var txt = titleEl.textContent.trim();
    var d1 = txt.match(/\b(\d{1,2}(?:st|nd|rd|th)\s+[A-Z][a-z]+\s+\d{4})\b/i);
    if (d1) addSug(d1[1], 'date');
    var d2 = txt.match(/\b([A-Z][a-z]+\s+\d{4})\b/);
    if (d2) addSug(d2[1], 'date');
    var prog = txt.replace(/provisional list.*?for\s*/i, '').replace(/\s*[-â]?\s*interview.*$/i, '').trim();
    if (prog.length > 3) addSug(prog, 'programme');
  });

  /* ââ Highlight ââ */
  function esc(s) { return s.replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;'); }
  function highlight(label, q) {
    var idx = label.toLowerCase().indexOf(q.toLowerCase());
    if (idx >= 0)
      return esc(label.slice(0, idx)) + '<strong class="sc-sug-match">' + esc(label.slice(idx, idx + q.length)) + '</strong>' + esc(label.slice(idx + q.length));
    return esc(label);
  }

  /* ââ Dropdown ââ */
  var activeIdx = -1;
  function showSug(q) {
    if (!q) { hideSug(); return; }
    var hits = bank.filter(function (s) { return fuzzyMatch(s.label.toLowerCase(), q.toLowerCase()); }).slice(0, 8);
    if (!hits.length) { hideSug(); return; }
    activeIdx = -1;
    var icons = { date: 'fa-calendar-alt', programme: 'fa-graduation-cap' };
    sugBox.innerHTML = hits.map(function (s, i) {
      return '<div class="sc-sug-item" data-val="' + esc(s.label) + '" data-idx="' + i + '">' +
        '<span class="sc-sug-left">' +
          '<i class="fas ' + (icons[s.type] || 'fa-search') + ' sc-sug-icon"></i>' +
          '<span class="sc-sug-text">' + highlight(s.label, q) + '</span>' +
        '</span>' +
        '<span class="sc-sug-type">' + s.type + '</span>' +
        '</div>';
    }).join('');
    sugBox.classList.add('show');
  }
  function hideSug() { sugBox.classList.remove('show'); activeIdx = -1; }
  function pickSug(val) { searchEl.value = val; hideSug(); applyFilters(); if (clearBtn) clearBtn.style.display = 'block'; searchEl.focus(); }

  var clearBtn = document.getElementById('sc-clear-btn');
  searchEl.addEventListener('input', function () {
    applyFilters();
    showSug(this.value.trim());
    if (clearBtn) clearBtn.style.display = this.value ? 'block' : 'none';
  });
  searchEl.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    var items = sugBox.querySelectorAll('.sc-sug-item');
    if (!items.length) return;
    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown')    { e.preventDefault(); activeIdx = Math.min(activeIdx + 1, items.length - 1); }
    else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') { e.preventDefault(); activeIdx = Math.max(activeIdx - 1, 0); }
    else if (e.key === 'Enter' && activeIdx >= 0) { e.preventDefault(); pickSug(items[activeIdx].getAttribute('data-val')); return; }
    else if (e.key === 'Escape')  { hideSug(); return; }
    items.forEach(function (el, i) { el.classList.toggle('sc-sug-active', i === activeIdx); });
  });

  /* works on desktop (mousedown) and mobile (touchstart) */
  function onPick(e) {
    var item = e.target.closest('.sc-sug-item');
    if (!item) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    pickSug(item.getAttribute('data-val'));
  }
  sugBox.addEventListener('mousedown',  onPick);
  sugBox.addEventListener('touchstart', onPick, { passive: false });

  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    if (!searchEl.contains(e.target) && !sugBox.contains(e.target)) hideSug();
  });

  /* ââ Active filter state ââ */
  var activeFilter = 'all';

  /* ââ applyFilters: combine search text + active level filter ââ */
  function applyFilters() {
    var q = searchEl.value.toLowerCase().trim();
    var vis = 0;
    var suggestSet = {};
    cards.forEach(function (card, i) {
      var textMatch = !q || fuzzyMatch(cardTexts[i], q);
      var levelMatch = activeFilter === 'all' || card.getAttribute('data-level') === activeFilter;
      if (textMatch && levelMatch) {
        card.style.removeProperty('display');
        vis++;
      } else {
        card.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
        if (!textMatch && levelMatch) {
          var titleEl2 = card.querySelector('.calendar-title, h5');
          if (titleEl2) {
            var prog2 = titleEl2.textContent.replace(/provisional list.*?for\s*/i,'').replace(/\s*[-â]?\s*interview.*$/i,'').trim();
            if (prog2.length > 3) suggestSet[prog2] = 1;
          }
        }
      }
    });
    if (countEl) countEl.textContent = vis + ' document' + (vis === 1 ? '' : 's') + (q ? ' found' : ' listed');
    if (noResults) {
      noResults.style.display = vis === 0 ? '' : 'none';
      if (vis === 0) {
        var sl = document.getElementById('sc-suggest-list');
        if (sl) {
          var pills = Object.keys(suggestSet).slice(0, 6);
          sl.innerHTML = pills.length
            ? pills.map(function (p) {
                return '<button class="sc-suggest-pill" onclick="document.getElementById(\'scSearch\').value=\'' +
                  p.replace(/'/g, "\\'") + '\';document.getElementById(\'scSearch\').dispatchEvent(new Event(\'input\'));this.closest(\'#scNoResults\').style.display=\'none\'">' +
                  p + '</button>';
              }).join('')
            : '';
        }
      }
    }
  }

  /* ââ Filter button clicks ââ */
  document.querySelectorAll('.sc-filter-btn').forEach(function (btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      document.querySelectorAll('.sc-filter-btn').forEach(function (b) { b.classList.remove('active'); });
      this.classList.add('active');
      activeFilter = this.getAttribute('data-filter');
      applyFilters();
    });
  });

  /* ââ Back to top on scroll ââ */
  var backTop = document.getElementById('sc-back-top');
  window.addEventListener('scroll', function () {
    if (backTop) backTop.classList.toggle('show', window.scrollY > 400);
  }, { passive: true });

  /* ââ "/" shortcut to focus search ââ */
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key === '/' && document.activeElement !== searchEl &&
        !['INPUT','TEXTAREA','SELECT'].includes(document.activeElement.tagName)) {
      e.preventDefault();
      searchEl.focus();
    }
  });
});
</script>

</body>
</html>

$pdo = new PDO("mysql:host=" . DB_HOST . ";dbname=" . DB_NAME . ";charset=utf8mb4", DB_USER, DB_PASS);
    $pdo->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);

function makeSlug($text)
{
    $text = strtolower($text);

    // remove special characters except spaces and hyphen
    $text = preg_replace('/[^a-z0-9\s-]/', '', $text);

    // convert spaces to hyphen
    $text = preg_replace('/\s+/', '-', $text);

    // DO NOT remove double hyphen (important for your DB)
    return trim($text, '-');
}

document.getElementById('yearFilter').addEventListener('change', function () {
  const selectedYear = this.value;
  const items = document.querySelectorAll('.event-item');

  items.forEach(item => {
     if (selectedYear === "all") {
      item.style.display = "block";
    }
    else
    if (item.getAttribute('data-year') === selectedYear) {
      item.style.display = "block";
    } else {
      item.style.display = "none";
    }
  });
});
</script>

      <!-- About -->
      <div class="mb-4">
        <h5 class="fw-bold mb-3">Newspaper – The Beacon</h5>
        <p>The Institute of Communication and Media Studies has been providing a solid grounding in print reporting for cub reporters for the last 16 years through its unique and successful initiative called The Beacon. The daily practice newspaper is written and published by the students of the M.A. Journalism &amp; Mass Communication program, providing a real-time simulated experience of a newsroom.</p>
        <p>The Beacon follows a complete workflow, mirroring the actual newsroom process, starting with pitching news story ideas to the editorial board, intense discussions on the news sense of the pitch, and finding varied sources. After preliminary research, the student reporters hunt for multiple sources, conduct field interviews, and write news stories in line with the modern principles of reporting, editing, and design.</p>
        <p>Each day's copies are published well within the deadline. This immersive experience has transformed enthusiastic cub reporters into fully-fledged professional reporters, who have ended up working for several reputable news organisations.</p>
      </div>

<script>
  function applyFilter(year) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.beacon-year-group').forEach(function(group) {
      group.style.display = (year === 'all' || group.dataset.year === year) ? '' : 'none';
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('.beacon-filter-btn').forEach(function(btn) {
      btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.year === year);
    });
  }

  document.querySelectorAll('.beacon-filter-btn').forEach(function(btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function() { applyFilter(this.dataset.year); });
  });
</script>

        <h5 class="fw-bold mb-3">Monthly Magazine – Communique</h5>
        <p>For 16 years, the M.A. Journalism &amp; Mass Communication program has been grooming journalism students through Communique, a monthly magazine that offers an immersive experience in magazine journalism and long-form storytelling.</p>
        <p>Produced entirely by student reporters, Communique provides a platform for students to pitch, research, and write compelling narrative news and non-news features, adding value to their copies. The rigorous training extends beyond journalistic production, with students fulfilling administrative and organisational responsibilities, such as collecting sponsorship for publication and organising sales within and outside the campus.</p>
        <p>Communique has become an indispensable component of the M.A. Journalism &amp; Mass Communication program, providing students with unique and invaluable learning opportunities. With its commitment to rigorous training and real-world experience, Communique is a testament to the program's dedication to preparing students for successful careers in journalism.</p>

<script>
  function applyFilter(year) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.beacon-year-group').forEach(function(group) {
      group.style.display = (year === 'all' || group.dataset.year === year) ? '' : 'none';
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('.beacon-filter-btn').forEach(function(btn) {
      btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.year === year);
    });
  }
  document.querySelectorAll('.beacon-filter-btn').forEach(function(btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function() { applyFilter(this.dataset.year); });
  });
</script>

<script>
  function applyFilter(year) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.beacon-year-group').forEach(function(group) {
      group.style.display = (year === 'all' || group.dataset.year === year) ? '' : 'none';
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('.beacon-filter-btn').forEach(function(btn) {
      btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.year === year);
    });
  }
  document.querySelectorAll('.beacon-filter-btn').forEach(function(btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function() { applyFilter(this.dataset.year); });
  });
</script>

    <?php
    // âââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââ
    //  YouTube Data API v3 â configuration
    //  Get a free key at https://console.cloud.google.com/
    //  Enable "YouTube Data API v3" then paste the key below.
    // âââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââ
    define('YT_API_KEY',       '');            // â paste API key here
    define('YT_CHANNEL_HANDLE','SJUBengaluru');
    define('YT_CACHE_FILE',    sys_get_temp_dir() . '/sju_yt_videos.json');
    define('YT_CACHE_TTL',     86400);         // re-fetch every 24 hours

    // ââ Static fallback (used when no API key is set) ââ
    // thumbnail is derived from the video ID at render time; no need to hardcode it.
    $fallback_videos = [
        ['id'=>'47xEPoMHd-E','title'=>"St. Joseph's University Promo Video",         'year'=>'2024','thumbnail'=>''],
        ['id'=>'m1S5l5CyUYc','title'=>"St Joseph's University Promo",                 'year'=>'2024','thumbnail'=>''],
        ['id'=>'IPl_OkGI6eo','title'=>'Ignitors Program â Centre for Human Excellence','year'=>'2023','thumbnail'=>''],
        ['id'=>'WM2LBfI-7e8','title'=>'SJU Election Documentary',                     'year'=>'2023','thumbnail'=>''],
        ['id'=>'bK534lW88QE','title'=>'SJU Documentary',                               'year'=>'2023','thumbnail'=>''],
    ];

    $videos       = [];
    $channel_info = [];
    $api_active   = false;

    if (YT_API_KEY !== '') {
        $api_active = true;

        // ââ Load from cache or fetch fresh ââ
        if (file_exists(YT_CACHE_FILE) && (time() - filemtime(YT_CACHE_FILE)) < YT_CACHE_TTL) {
            $cached = json_decode(file_get_contents(YT_CACHE_FILE), true);
            $videos       = $cached['videos']  ?? [];
            $channel_info = $cached['channel'] ?? [];
        } else {
            $ctx = stream_context_create(['http'=>['timeout'=>10,'ignore_errors'=>true]]);

            // 1. Resolve handle â' channel info
            $ch_url  = 'https://www.googleapis.com/youtube/v3/channels?part=snippet,contentDetails,statistics'
                     . '&forHandle=' . urlencode(YT_CHANNEL_HANDLE)
                     . '&key=' . urlencode(YT_API_KEY);
            $ch_raw  = @file_get_contents($ch_url, false, $ctx);
            $ch_data = $ch_raw ? json_decode($ch_raw, true) : null;

            if (!empty($ch_data['items'][0])) {
                $ch      = $ch_data['items'][0];
                $uploads = $ch['contentDetails']['relatedPlaylists']['uploads'];

                $channel_info = [
                    'title'       => $ch['snippet']['title'],
                    'description' => $ch['snippet']['description'],
                    'thumbnail'   => $ch['snippet']['thumbnails']['high']['url']
                                  ?? $ch['snippet']['thumbnails']['default']['url'] ?? '',
                    'subscribers' => $ch['statistics']['subscriberCount'] ?? null,
                    'video_count' => $ch['statistics']['videoCount']      ?? null,
                    'handle'      => YT_CHANNEL_HANDLE,
                ];

                // 2. Paginate through the uploads playlist
                $page_token = '';
                do {
                    $pl_url  = 'https://www.googleapis.com/youtube/v3/playlistItems'
                             . '?part=snippet&maxResults=50'
                             . '&playlistId=' . urlencode($uploads)
                             . '&key=' . urlencode(YT_API_KEY)
                             . ($page_token ? '&pageToken=' . urlencode($page_token) : '');
                    $pl_raw  = @file_get_contents($pl_url, false, $ctx);
                    $pl_data = $pl_raw ? json_decode($pl_raw, true) : null;

                    foreach ($pl_data['items'] ?? [] as $item) {
                        $vid_id  = $item['snippet']['resourceId']['videoId'];
                        $pub     = $item['snippet']['publishedAt'];
                        $videos[] = [
                            'id'        => $vid_id,
                            'title'     => $item['snippet']['title'],
                            'thumbnail' => $item['snippet']['thumbnails']['high']['url']
                                        ?? $item['snippet']['thumbnails']['medium']['url']
                                        ?? $item['snippet']['thumbnails']['default']['url'] ?? '',
                            'year'      => substr($pub, 0, 4),
                            'published' => $pub,
                        ];
                    }
                    $page_token = $pl_data['nextPageToken'] ?? '';
                } while ($page_token);

                // 3. Cache
                file_put_contents(YT_CACHE_FILE, json_encode([
                    'channel' => $channel_info,
                    'videos'  => $videos,
                ], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE));
            }
        }
    }

    // Fallback if API inactive or returned nothing
    if (empty($videos)) { $videos = $fallback_videos; }

    // Build sorted year list (newest first)
    $years = array_values(array_unique(array_column($videos, 'year')));
    rsort($years);
    ?>

<script>
  var _ytOverlay = document.getElementById('yt-overlay');
  var _ytFrame   = document.getElementById('ytOverlayFrame');
  var _ytTitle   = document.getElementById('ytOverlayTitle');

  function openYT(el) {
    var vid   = el.dataset.vid;
    var title = el.dataset.title;
    _ytTitle.textContent = title;
    _ytFrame.src = 'https://www.youtube.com/embed/' + vid + '?autoplay=1&rel=0';
    _ytOverlay.classList.add('open');
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    return false;
  }

  function closeYT() {
    _ytOverlay.classList.remove('open');
    _ytFrame.src = '';
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
  }

  _ytOverlay.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    if (e.target === _ytOverlay) closeYT();
  });

  document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && _ytOverlay.classList.contains('open')) closeYT();
  });

  function applyFilter(year) {
    var cards = document.querySelectorAll('.yt-card');
    var count = 0;
    cards.forEach(function(c) {
      var show = (year === 'all' || c.dataset.year === year);
      c.style.display = show ? '' : 'none';
      if (show) count++;
    });
    document.getElementById('yt-count').textContent = count;
    document.getElementById('yt-empty').style.display = (count === 0) ? '' : 'none';
    document.querySelectorAll('.yt-filter-btn').forEach(function(btn) {
      btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.year === year);
    });
  }

  document.querySelectorAll('.yt-filter-btn').forEach(function(btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function() { applyFilter(this.dataset.year); });
  });
</script>
</body>
</html>

<?php


$config = file_exists('/home/sjubedu/config.php') ? '/home/sjubedu/config.php' : __DIR__ . '/../../config.php';
require_once $config;
$pdo = new PDO("mysql:host=" . DB_HOST . ";dbname=" . DB_NAME . ";charset=utf8mb4", DB_USER, DB_PASS);
    $pdo->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);

    $today = date('Y-m-d');
$weekStart = date('Y-m-d', strtotime('monday this week'));
$weekEnd = date('Y-m-d', strtotime('sunday this week'));
$monthStart = date('Y-m-01');

$status = 'Y';
 $sql = "SELECT n.title, n.slug, n.description, n.d_start_date,n.c_image
        FROM news n
        JOIN news_departments nd ON n.id = nd.news_id
        WHERE nd.c_department = :department
        AND n.c_status = :status
        AND n.d_start_date >= :today
        ORDER BY n.d_start_date DESC";

          $stmt = $pdo->prepare($sql);
          $stmt->bindParam(':department', $department);
          $stmt->bindParam(':status', $status);
          $stmt->bindParam(':today', $today);

              $stmt->execute();




while ($row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)) {
  $newsDate = date('Y-m-d', strtotime($row['d_start_date']));

if ($newsDate == $today) {
    $category = "today";
}
elseif ($newsDate >= $weekStart && $newsDate <= $weekEnd && $newsDate != $today) {
    $category = "week";
}
elseif ($newsDate >= $monthStart && $newsDate < $weekStart) {
    $category = "month";
}
else {
    $category = "all";
}
    ?>

           </div>

          <div class="col-md-9">
            <div class="py-2 px-4">
             <span class="news-date"><?php echo date("d-m-Y", strtotime($row['d_start_date']));?></span>

             <h4 class="fw-bold"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['title']);?></h4>

<script>
    const tabs = document.querySelectorAll(".news-tabs button");
const newsCards = document.querySelectorAll(".news-type");
const searchInput = document.getElementById("newsSearch");

tabs.forEach(tab => {

tab.addEventListener("click", function(){

tabs.forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove("active","btn-primary"));
tabs.forEach(btn => btn.classList.add("btn-light"));

this.classList.add("active","btn-primary");
this.classList.remove("btn-light");

let filter = this.getAttribute("data-filter");

newsCards.forEach(card => {

if(filter === "all" || card.dataset.category === filter){
card.style.display = "block";
}else{
card.style.display = "none";
}

});

});

});

    card.style.display = "none";

});

});

    curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
    curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, ["Authorization: $API_TOKEN", "Accept: application/json"]);

    curl_close($api_ch);

                              usort($response_data['data'], function($a, $b) {
                              $dateA = strtotime($a['Year'] ?? '');
                              $dateB = strtotime($b['Year'] ?? '');

                              // First sort by date (latest first)
                              if ($dateA != $dateB) {
                                  return $dateB - $dateA;
                              }

                              // If dates are same, sort by name alphabetically
                              return strcmp(
                                  $a['Name of Faculty'] ?? '',
                                  $b['Name of Faculty'] ?? ''
                              );
                            });

function makeSlug($text)
{
    $text = strtolower($text);

    // remove special characters except spaces and hyphen
    $text = preg_replace('/[^a-z0-9\s-]/', '', $text);

    // convert spaces to hyphen
    $text = preg_replace('/\s+/', '-', $text);

    // DO NOT remove double hyphen (important for your DB)
    return trim($text, '-');
}

$slug = $_GET['slug'] ?? '';
$slug = urldecode($slug);
$slug = makeSlug($slug);

$status = 'Y';
  $sql = "SELECT event_name, slug, description, created_at, c_image ,d_start_date,d_end_date,c_file_type,c_pdf,c_url,c_text,
 c_registration,c_registration_link,c_venue,c_phone,c_email
        FROM events 
        WHERE slug = :slug AND c_status = :status 
        LIMIT 1";

$stmt = $pdo->prepare($sql);
$stmt->bindParam(':slug', $slug);
$stmt->bindParam(':status', $status);
$stmt->execute();

$details = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

 //$newsDate = date('d-m-Y', strtotime($details['created_at']));

                $c_registration = $details['c_registration'];

<?php
$config = file_exists('/home/sjubedu/config.php') ? '/home/sjubedu/config.php' : __DIR__ . '/../../config.php';

$pdo = new PDO("mysql:host=" . DB_HOST . ";dbname=" . DB_NAME . ";charset=utf8mb4", DB_USER, DB_PASS);
    $pdo->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);
$status = 'Y';

$sql = "SELECT event_name, slug, description, d_start_date, c_image,d_end_date,c_file_type,c_url
        FROM events
        WHERE c_status = :status
        ORDER BY d_start_date DESC";

$stmt = $pdo->prepare($sql);
$stmt->bindParam(':status', $status);
$stmt->execute();
$events = [];
$years = [];

while ($row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)) {

    $year = date('Y', strtotime($row['d_start_date']));
    $date = date('jS F Y', strtotime($row['d_start_date']));

    $row['year'] = $year;
    $row['date'] = $date;

    $events[] = $row;

    $years[$year] = $year; // prevents duplicate years
}

rsort($years);


    ?>
  <div class="container mb-4">
    <div class="row align-items-center">
      <div class="col-lg-6 col-12">
        <h2 class="fw-bold mb-1">Events</h2>
