      <div class="col-lg-3 col-md-4 col-12 ms-lg-auto">
        <select class="form-select year-filter" id="yearFilter">
          <option value="all">Select the year</option>
          <?php foreach($years as $year){ ?>
            <option value="<?php echo $year; ?>"><?php echo $year; ?></option>
            <?php } ?>
        </select>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Cards -->
  <div class="container">
    <div class="row g-4">
<?php foreach($events as $row){ ?>

<div class="col-lg-4 col-md-6 event-item" data-year="<?php echo $row['year']; ?>">

  <div class="events-card">

    <div class="event-img">
     
      <img src="sju_admin/assets/admin/uploads/events/original/<?php echo $row['c_image'];?>" alt="Image">
    </div>

    <div class="event-content">
<?php
if($row['c_file_type']=="URL"){


$link = $row['c_url'];

if (!preg_match("~^(?:f|ht)tps?://~i", $link)) {
    $link = "https://" . $link;
}
  ?>
 <a href="<?php echo $link;?>" class="">
  <?php
} else {?>

      <a href="events-detail.php?slug=<?php echo $row['slug'];?>" class="">
         <?php
} ?>
      <p class="event-date">
        <i class="fa-regular fa-calendar me-2"></i>
        <?php echo $row['date']; ?>
      </p>

      <h5><?php echo $row['event_name']; ?></h5>
</a>
    </div>

  </div>

</div>

<?php } ?>
     

    </div>

<script>
document.getElementById('yearFilter').addEventListener('change', function () {
  const selectedYear = this.value;
  const items = document.querySelectorAll('.event-item');

  items.forEach(item => {
     if (selectedYear === "all") {
      item.style.display = "block";
    }
    else
    if (item.getAttribute('data-year') === selectedYear) {
      item.style.display = "block";
    } else {
      item.style.display = "none";
    }
  });
});
</script>

                St Joseph's College (Autonomous) was officially upgraded to St Joseph's University. SJU was officially inaugurated on 27 September 2022.

                Foreign language other than English. However, with special permission from the Vice-Chancellor, students can select Additional English as a Foreign Language. The University offers
                the following Language courses: Kannada, Hindi, Introductory Kannada, Tamil, Sanskrit, French and German. Applicants selecting Kannada, Hindi, Tamil, Sanskrit and French must have
                studied these languages at plus-two level. CBSE and ISC students who have not studied a second language at plus-two level and others who have not studied Kannada, Hindi, Tamil, Sanskrit,
                French shall select German, Additional English or Introductory Kannada.<br>Students who have not studied Kannada before but are interested in learning Kannada can opt for Introductory

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

  const images = document.querySelectorAll('.img-box img');
  const lightbox = document.getElementById('lightbox');
  const lightboxImg = document.getElementById('lightbox-img');
  const closeBtn = document.querySelector('.lightbox-close');
  const prevBtn = document.querySelector('.lightbox-prev');
  const nextBtn = document.querySelector('.lightbox-next');
  const playPauseBtn = document.getElementById('playPauseBtn');
  const playIcon = document.getElementById('playIcon');
  const downloadBtn = document.getElementById('downloadBtn');
  const progressBar = document.querySelector('.progress');

  let currentIndex = 0;
  let slideshowInterval = null;
  let isPlaying = false;
  const duration = 3000;

  const imgArray = Array.from(images);

  function showImage(index) {
    if (index < 0) {
      currentIndex = imgArray.length - 1;
    } else if (index >= imgArray.length) {
      currentIndex = 0;
    } else {
      currentIndex = index;
    }

    const src = imgArray[currentIndex].src;
    lightboxImg.src = src;
    downloadBtn.href = src;

    resetProgress();
  }

  function resetProgress() {
    progressBar.style.transition = 'none';
    progressBar.style.width = '0%';

    setTimeout(() => {
      progressBar.style.transition = `width ${duration}ms linear`;
      progressBar.style.width = '100%';
    }, 50);
  }

  function startSlideshow() {
    resetProgress();

    slideshowInterval = setInterval(() => {
      showImage(currentIndex + 1);
    }, duration);

    isPlaying = true;
    playIcon.textContent = "❚❚";
  }

  function stopSlideshow() {
    clearInterval(slideshowInterval);
    isPlaying = false;
    playIcon.textContent = "▶";
    progressBar.style.width = '0%';
  }

  // Open
  imgArray.forEach((img, index) => {
    img.addEventListener('click', () => {
      currentIndex = index;
      showImage(currentIndex);
      lightbox.style.display = 'flex';
    });
  });

  // Navigation
  nextBtn.onclick = () => showImage(currentIndex + 1);
  prevBtn.onclick = () => showImage(currentIndex - 1);

  // Play/Pause
  playPauseBtn.onclick = () => {
    if (isPlaying) {
      stopSlideshow();
    } else {
      startSlideshow();
    }
  };

  // Close
  closeBtn.onclick = () => {
    lightbox.style.display = 'none';
    stopSlideshow();
  };

  lightbox.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if (e.target === lightbox) {
      lightbox.style.display = 'none';
      stopSlideshow();
    }
  });

  // Keyboard
  document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (lightbox.style.display === 'flex') {
      if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') showImage(currentIndex + 1);
      if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') showImage(currentIndex - 1);
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        lightbox.style.display = 'none';
        stopSlideshow();
      }
    }
  });

});
</script>

          <h2 class="fw-bold text_blue mb-3">Bengaluru, India</h2>
          <p class="text-muted">
            St Joseph's University is a Jesuit university at the heart of Bengaluru, the silicon city of India.
            Established in 1882 by Paris Foreign Mission Fathers, the management of the college was handed 
            over to the Jesuit order (Society of Jesus) in 1937. The college was first affiliated with the University 
            of Madras and later with the Mysore and Bangalore universities. In 1986, St Joseph's College became 
            the first affiliated college in Karnataka to offer postgraduate programmes. In 1988, it became the first 
            college in Karnataka to get a Research Centre.
          </p>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

  const track = document.getElementById("carouselTrack");
  const wrapper = document.querySelector(".custom-carousel");
  const nextBtn = document.querySelector(".carousel-btn.next");
  const prevBtn = document.querySelector(".carousel-btn.prev");

  // Clone items for infinite loop
  const items = [...track.children];
  items.forEach(item => {
    track.appendChild(item.cloneNode(true));
  });

  let position = 0;
  let autoSpeed = 0.4;
  let isPaused = false;

  function animate() {
    if (!isPaused) {
      position -= autoSpeed;
    }

    if (Math.abs(position) >= track.scrollWidth / 2) {
      position = 0;
    }

    track.style.transform = `translate3d(${position}px,0,0)`;
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  }

  animate();

  // Mouse Wheel
  wrapper.addEventListener("wheel", function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    isPaused = true;

    position += e.deltaY * -0.6;

    clearTimeout(wrapper.scrollTimer);
    wrapper.scrollTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      isPaused = false;
    }, 700);
  }, { passive: false });

 
  nextBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    isPaused = true;
    position -= 300;

    setTimeout(() => {
      isPaused = false;
    }, 500);
  });

 
  prevBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    isPaused = true;
    position += 300;

    setTimeout(() => {
      isPaused = false;
    }, 500);
  });

});
</script>

$sql = "SELECT n.event_name, n.slug, n.description, n.d_start_date
        FROM events n
        JOIN event_departments nd ON n.id = nd.events_id
        WHERE nd.c_department = :department
        AND n.c_status = :status
        
        ORDER BY n.d_end_date DESC";

$stmt = $pdo->prepare($sql);
$stmt->bindParam(':department', $department);
$stmt->bindParam(':status', $status);
//$stmt->bindParam(':today', $today);
$stmt->execute();
$events = [];
$years = [];

while ($row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)) {

$events[] = $row;
}
foreach($events as $row){
  $date = date('jS F Y', strtotime($row['d_start_date']));

            $desc = strip_tags($row['description']);
               htmlspecialchars(substr($desc,0,40)); 
              if (strlen($desc) > 50) {
            $desc = substr($desc, 0, 50) . '...';
            }


            $event_name = strip_tags($row['event_name']);
               htmlspecialchars(substr($event_name,0,40)); 
              if (strlen($event_name) > 50) {
            $event_name = substr($event_name, 0, 50) . '...';
            }
?>
        <div class="event-card">
          <div class="card h-100 shadow-sm border-0">
            <div class="card-header h-100 fw-bold rounded-top">
              <?php echo $desc;?>
                  <div class="event-date d-flex align-items-center mt-2">
                    <i class="bi bi-calendar-event me-2"></i><span><?php echo $date;?></span>
                  </div>
            </div>
            <div class="card-body bg-light">
              <a href="events-detail.php?slug=<?php echo $row['slug'];?>" class="">
              <p class="text-muted mb-0"><?php echo $event_name;?></p>
</a>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <?php }?>
</div>

      <div class="carousel-dots text-center mt-4 mb-5"></div>
    </div>

$department="Homepage";
$sql = "SELECT n.title, n.slug, n.d_start_date
        FROM announcements n
        JOIN announcement_departments nd ON n.id = nd.announcement_id
        WHERE nd.c_department = :department
        AND n.c_status = :status
        AND n.d_end_date >= :today
        ORDER BY n.d_end_date DESC";

$stmt = $pdo->prepare($sql);

$stmt->bindParam(':status', $status);
$stmt->bindParam(':today', $today);

          <p class="text-muted">
            St Joseph's University is a Jesuit university at the heart of Bengaluru, the silicon city of India.
            Established in 1882 by Paris Foreign Mission Fathers, the management of the college was handed 
            over to the Jesuit order (Society of Jesus) in 1937. The college was first affiliated with the University 
            of Madras and later with the Mysore and Bangalore universities. In 1986, St Joseph's College became 
            the first affiliated college in Karnataka to offer postgraduate programmes. In 1988, it became the first 
            college in Karnataka to get a Research Centre.

    <div class="events-carousel-wrapper position-relative overflow-hidden">
      <div class="events-track d-flex">
        <!-- 6 Event Cards -->
<?php

        $status = 'Y';
$department="Homepage";
$sql = "SELECT n.event_name, n.slug, n.description, n.d_start_date
        FROM events n
        JOIN event_departments nd ON n.id = nd.events_id
        WHERE nd.c_department = :department
        AND n.c_status = :status
        
        ORDER BY n.d_end_date DESC";

$stmt = $pdo->prepare($sql);
$stmt->bindParam(':department', $department);
$stmt->bindParam(':status', $status);
//$stmt->bindParam(':today', $today);
$stmt->execute();
$events = [];
$years = [];

while ($row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)) {

$events[] = $row;
}
foreach($events as $row){
  $date = date('jS F Y', strtotime($row['d_start_date']));

            $desc = strip_tags($row['description']);
               htmlspecialchars(substr($desc,0,40)); 
              if (strlen($desc) > 50) {
            $desc = substr($desc, 0, 50) . '...';
            }


            $event_name = strip_tags($row['event_name']);
               htmlspecialchars(substr($event_name,0,40)); 
              if (strlen($event_name) > 50) {
            $event_name = substr($event_name, 0, 50) . '...';
            }
?>
        <div class="event-card">
          <div class="card h-100 shadow-sm border-0">
            <div class="card-header h-100 fw-bold rounded-top">
              <?php echo $desc;?>
                  <div class="event-date d-flex align-items-center mt-2">
                    <i class="bi bi-calendar-event me-2"></i><span><?php echo $date;?></span>
                  </div>
            </div>
            <div class="card-body bg-light">
              <a href="events-detail.php?slug=<?php echo $row['slug'];?>" class="">
              <p class="text-muted mb-0"><?php echo $event_name;?></p>
</a>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <?php }?>

        <div class="mt-4">
          <h2 class="fw-bold text-warning mb-1">Welcome to St Joseph's University,</h2>
          <h2 class="fw-bold text_blue mb-3">Bengaluru, India</h2>
          <p class="text-muted">
            St Joseph's University is a Jesuit university at the heart of Bengaluru, the silicon city of India.
            Established in 1882 by Paris Foreign Mission Fathers, the management of the college was handed 
            over to the Jesuit order (Society of Jesus) in 1937. The college was first affiliated with the University 
            of Madras and later with the Mysore and Bangalore universities. In 1986, St Joseph's College became 
            the first affiliated college in Karnataka to offer postgraduate programmes. In 1988, it became the first 
            college in Karnataka to get a Research Centre.
          </p>
          <a href="#" class="btn btn-success px-4 py-2 mt-2">
            More <i class="fa fa-arrow-right ms-2"></i>

          <h2 class="fw-bold text-warning mb-1">Welcome to St Joseph's University,</h2>
          <h2 class="fw-bold text_blue mb-3">Bengaluru, India</h2>
          <p class="text-muted">
            St Joseph's University is a Jesuit university at the heart of Bengaluru, the silicon city of India.
            Established in 1882 by Paris Foreign Mission Fathers, the management of the college was handed 
            over to the Jesuit order (Society of Jesus) in 1937. The college was first affiliated with the University 
            of Madras and later with the Mysore and Bangalore universities. In 1986, St Joseph's College became 
            the first affiliated college in Karnataka to offer postgraduate programmes. In 1988, it became the first 
            college in Karnataka to get a Research Centre.
          </p>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

  const track = document.getElementById("carouselTrack");

  // Clone items for seamless loop
  const items = track.children;
  const cloneCount = items.length;

  for (let i = 0; i < cloneCount; i++) {
    track.appendChild(items[i].cloneNode(true));
  }

  let position = 0;
  const speed = 0.4;

  function autoScroll() {
    position -= speed;

    if (Math.abs(position) >= track.scrollWidth / 2) {
      position = 0;
    }

    track.style.transform = `translate3d(${position}px, 0, 0)`;
    requestAnimationFrame(autoScroll);
  }

  autoScroll();

});
</script>

		    <div class="row gy-5 mb-5">
      <!-- Image Column -->
      <div class="col-lg-5 text-center">
        <img src="images/lobo-sj.jpg" alt="Rev Dr Victor Lobo SJ " class="img-fluid saint-img" width="390"><br/><br/>
<div><strong>Rev Dr Victor Lobo SJ </strong><br>Vice - Chancellor</div>
      </div>

      <!-- Content Column -->
      <div class="col-lg-7 mt-0">
        <div class="saint-content">
                 <p>Dear International Student,
<p>We invite you to join St. Joseph's University, Bengaluru to have brilliant higher education career journey of your life and enrich your professional talent at one of the oldest higher education institutions in India established in 1882.</p>

<p>The University is administered by the Society of Jesus (SJ), also known as the Jesuits founded by St. Ignatius of Loyola in 1540. With their headquarters in Rome, Italy, the Jesuits are actively involved with mission of providing quality education and character formation in nearly fifty countries of the world and run such reputed world class Universities like Universidad de Buenos Aires, Argentina, Pontificia Universidad Catholica de Rio de Jameiro, Brazil, St. Mary's University, Halifax, Canada, Sophia University, Tokyo-Japan, Champion Hall – Oxford University, U.K., Boston College, Massachusetts, U.S.A., Fordham University, U.S.A., Georgetown University, Washington D.C., U.S.A., Loyola University, Chicago, U.S.A., University of San Francisco, U.S.A., Sogang University, Seoul, South Korea, IQS Barcelona, Spain, Sanata Dharma University, Indonesia, etc.</p>

<p>The Jesuits came to India in 1542 under the leadership of St. Francis Xavier and established the first ever higher education institution in India – St. Paul's College, Goa the same year (which underwent several transformations). Subsequently they established a large number of schools, colleges and seminaries in Goa and also in other prominent towns and cities of India. Most of the more than 100 year old and not for profit colleges in India are presently run by the Society of Jesus like St. Joseph's, Trichy, St. Xavier's, Kolkata, St. Xavier's, Mumbai, Loyola, Chennai, St. Aloysius, Mangalore, etc.</p>

<p>Our Institution founded as St. Joseph's College in 1882 has a glorious history of high academic achievements of more than 140 years. On 2nd July 2022 the St. Joseph's College, Bangalore was elevated to the status of an University by the Government of Karnataka under the R.U.S.A. (Rashtriya Uchchatar Siksha Abhiyan) Scheme of the Government of India, Ministry of Human Resource Development, New Delhi. St. Joseph's University, Bangalore has the unique distinction as being, the only private college in India to be raised to this status of the first of its kind Public – Private Partnership (PPP) University in India!</p>

<p>On 27th September 2022, Her Excellency Smt. Draupadi Murmu, President of India, formally inaugurated the St Joseph's University in the august presence of Hon'ble Shri Thaawar Chand Gehlot, Governor of Karnataka, Hon'ble Shri Basavaraj Bommai, Chief Minister, Hon'ble Shri C. Ashwath Narayan, Minister for Higher Education of the State and Rt. Rev. Dr. Peter Machado, Archbishop of Bangalore.</p>
<p>
The Bangalore Jesuit Educational Society (Regd) has already embarked on a mission to develop the University as a centre to provide world class education at affordable cost to all deserving young people irrespective of their caste, creed, economic status or nationality keeping in mind the triple values of academic excellence, character formation and social concern.</p>

<p>Plans are afoot to augment the infrastructure facilities like library, laboratories, computer and network system, hostels and cafeterias, sports grounds and gymnasiums, auditoriums and seminar halls, astronomical observations, student health and counselling centres, placement and skills development cells, etc at the present Lal Bagh Road Campus and also to build a huge state of the art new campus to cater to all the future expansions needs of the University in a 30 acres – Mount Saint Joseph, Bannerghatta Road in next five years time from now.</p>

<p>Saint Ignatius of Loyola had a keen desire to spread education and knowledge, media of liberation for a just and equitable society. The group he founded, the Society of Jesus, has been active in the field of education throughout the world since its origin. In the world, the Jesuits are responsible for 3,897 Educational Institutions in 96 countries. The education imparted by the Jesuits aims at the integral, personal formation of youth.</p>

        </div>
      </div>

		  <ul class="language-list mt-0 p-0" style="list-style-type:none;">
                       <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>For the programs for which Provisional Admission is offered to International Students is based on the marks card, certificates and other documents submitted along-with the application form and thepersonal/telephonic interview held thereon.</li>
                       <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>All programmes offered are full time and minimum 75% class attendance for each subject is compulsory to be eligible to write the end-semester examinations.</li>
			  <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>All foreign nationals except from Nepal and Bhutan admitted to the University are required to arrive in India with valid passport and student visa specifying “for study at St. Joseph's University, Bengaluru, India”.</li>
                       <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>No foreign student except from Nepal and Bhutan will be permitted to attend classes at the University without valid Passport, Student Visa and Residential Permit.</li>
			  <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Such of those foreign nationals who are already in India studying in other educational institutions have to obtain No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their present institutions and enclose the same along-with their application form.</li>
                       <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>After obtaining Provisional Admission letter from the University, they have to change the Student Visa in favor of St. Joseph's University at the local Foreigners Regional Registration Office, Bengaluru, before they start attending classes at St. Joseph's University.</li>
			  <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Within 14 days of their arrival in India, foreign students are required to register with the local Foreigners Regional Registration Office (FRRO), address is follows:
			  
			  <ul style="list-style-type:none;"><li>Foreigners Regional Registration Officer,<br>
Bureau of Immigration<br>
(Ministry of Home Affairs, Govt. of India)<br>
TTMC ‘A' Block, 5 th Floor, BMTC Bus Stand Building,<br>
K.H. Road, Shanthi Nagar,<br>
Bengaluru – 560 027.<br>
Website: www.immigrationindia.nic.in</li></ul>
			  
			  </li></ul>

			 <ul class="language-list mt-0 p-0" style="list-style-type:none;">
                       <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Applicant shall create User-id/Password by registering online into portal: www.indianfrro.gov.in</li>
				 <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Submit an online application for Registration with necessary documents and photograph. The application would not be successfully submitted unless the documents and photographs are uploaded online successfully</li>

<section class="news-section py-5 px-3">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="row g-4 align-items-stretch">

    <div class="col-lg-7 d-flex flex-column">
<h2 class="fw-bold text-blue mb-4">Announcements</h2>

<div id="announcementCarousel" class="carousel slide" data-bs-ride="carousel" data-bs-interval="4000">
<div class="carousel-inner">

<?php
$status = 'Y';
$department = "Library";

$sql = "SELECT n.title, n.slug, n.description, n.d_start_date
        FROM announcements n
        JOIN announcement_departments nd ON n.id = nd.announcement_id
        WHERE nd.c_department = :department
        AND n.c_status = :status
        AND n.d_start_date >= :today
        ORDER BY n.d_start_date DESC";

$stmtannouncement = $pdo->prepare($sql);
$stmtannouncement->bindParam(':department', $department);
$stmtannouncement->bindParam(':status', $status);
$stmtannouncement->bindParam(':today', $today);
$stmtannouncement->execute();

$announcementrows = $stmtannouncement->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
$totalannouncementCount = count($announcementrows);

$announcementcount = 0;

foreach ($announcementrows as $row) {

    // open new slide every 3 items
    if ($announcementcount % 3 == 0) {

        // close previous slide
        if ($announcementcount != 0) echo '</div>';

        // first slide active
        echo ($announcementcount == 0)
            ? '<div class="carousel-item active">'
            : '<div class="carousel-item">';

        $inner = 0; // reset inside-slide counter
    }

    // margin only for 2nd & 3rd items
    $marginClass = ($inner == 0) ? '' : 'mt-3';

    // format date
    $d_start_date = (!empty($row['d_start_date']) && $row['d_start_date'] != '0000-00-00')
        ? date('j F Y', strtotime($row['d_start_date']))
        : '';
?>
<a href="<?php echo LIVE_URL;?>announcement-detail.php?slug=<?php echo $row['slug'];?>">
      <div class="announcement-item p-4 rounded <?php echo $marginClass; ?>">
        <h6 class="fw-bold mb-1"><?php echo $d_start_date; ?></h6>
        <p class="mb-0"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['title']); ?></p>
    </div>
</a>
<?php
    $announcementcount++;
    $inner++;
}

// close last slide
if ($announcementcount > 0) echo '</div>';
?>

</div>
<div class="carousel-indicators-outside text-center mt-4">

<?php
$totalSlides = ceil($totalannouncementCount / 3);

for ($i = 0; $i < $totalSlides; $i++) {
?>
    <button type="button"
        data-bs-target="#announcementCarousel"
        data-bs-slide-to="<?php echo $i; ?>"
        class="<?php echo ($i == 0) ? 'active' : ''; ?>">
    </button>
<?php } ?>

</div>
</div>
</div>
         
  
     
      <div class="col-lg-5 d-flex flex-column">

                 <div class="content">
			<div class="left_title_border mt-4 mb-2">
           <h3 class="br_title text_blue fw-bold"><span></span>About Library</h3> 
        </div> <p>St Joseph's University Library is one of the well-stocked university libraries in Karnataka. It regularly subscribes best and top national and international journals, periodicals/magazines and daily newspapers. It caters to the needs of more than 9000 undergraduate, postgraduate and research-level staff and students. The library is fully automated; it has two spacious reading halls and can accommodate two hundred and fifty users at any time. The library operations are managed by the latest version of Koha Integrated Library Management System Software, and the digital library using DSpace software for digital library and institutional repository. The library is upgraded with barcode and Radio Frequency IDentification (RFID) technology. The library is well equipped with all the modern facilities and resources (print and electronic) in the form of CDROMs, DVD-ROM, video cassettes, books, journals, etc. The library follows the Dewey Decimal Scheme of classification, AACR-II cataloguing code, and MARC-21 format for bibliographic data. Books are arranged on the shelves in numerical order from 000-999.</p>
										
                </div>
                
			</div>
        </article>

						<li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Strict silence should be observed in the library.</li>
						 <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Use of cell phones in the library is strictly prohibited.</li>
						<li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Eatables and drinks are not allowed in the library.</li>
						 <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Personal books and other belongings are not allowed inside the library, except notebooks/laptops, with the permission of the librarian.</li>
						<li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Violation of library rules will result in strict disciplinary action.</li>

						<li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Kindly cooperate and interact gently with library staff.</li>
						 <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Sleeping, eating and having refreshments inside the library are strictly prohibited.</li>
						<li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Check the library noticeboards regularly (Both inside and outside the library premises).</li>
						 <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Students and staff members must settle all library dues to obtain Clearance Certificate from the Library Office upon completion of studies or duty.</li>

			<article id="guidlines" class="dept-section department_tab mb-5">
            <div class="row align-items-stretch">

                  <div class="content">   
                 
				<div class="left_title_border mt-4 mb-2">
           <h3 class="br_title text_blue fw-bold"><span></span>Guidelines</h3> 
        </div>	
					
			<div class="left_title_border mt-4 mb-2">
           <h5 class="br_title text_blue fw-bold"><span></span>GUIDELINES FOR SELF-CIRCULATION KIOSK</h5> 
        </div>			
				<p>Arrupe Central Library has implemented Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) enabled KIOSK; this latest technology is used to automate the book handling process, including check-out, and inventory maintenance. The technology would allow the readers to utilise the service of self 'issue' and 'reissue' books without standing in a queue.</p>	
					
					
				<div class="left_title_border mt-4 mb-2">
           <h5 class="br_title text_blue fw-bold"><span></span>GUIDELINES FOR LENDING SECTION</h5> 
        </div>			
				<p>The book borrowing facility is available only for the Fathers, faculty members, current students and staff members of the college. Student can borrow at most two books and faculty members can borrow at most ten books depending on the availability of the same in the library, at a time 10 days for student and thirty days for Faculty members, which are further renewable at most once in ten days slot for students and thirty days slot for faculty members. A delay in return is charged by Rs.2/- (Rupees two only) per day per book.</p>	
					  
					  
					  
					  
					
			<div class="left_title_border mt-4 mb-2">
           <h5 class="br_title text_blue fw-bold"><span></span>GUIDELINES FOR READING SECTION</h5> 
        </div>
					 
					 <ul class="language-list mt-0 p-0" style="list-style-type:none;">	   
		
						 <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>The books marked as "REFERENCE" and periodicals (both journals and magazines) are meant only for reading consultation inside the READING ROOM ONLY, and cannot be taken out.</li>
						<li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>You will be allowed to take a maximum of THREE BOOKS at a time for study in the Reading Room.</li>
						 <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Do not scatter the pages of newspapers when reading.</li>
						<li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>DO NOT misplace books while selecting from the shelves. After consulting books, return them at the counter.</li>
						 <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Laptops and Palmtops are allowed in the library.</li>
						<li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Books newly acquired are displayed in the New Arrival Section.</li>
						
					 </ul>
					  
					  
					  
					 <div class="left_title_border mt-4 mb-2">
           <h5 class="br_title text_blue fw-bold"><span></span>GUIDELINES FOR REPROGRAPHY SECTION</h5> 
        </div>			
				<p>The reprographic facilities are available in Central Library for the students and faculty members, at a very nominal rate of Rs.1/- per A4 size impression (for photocopy) and Rs.2/- only per A4 size page (for printout). One internet-facilitated computer is directly connected to the photocopy machine for taking printouts of any online and also offline material. This section remains open from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM Monday to Friday, and 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM on Saturday.</p>

<p>The photocopy section is for library books only. The class notes, outside papers and outside books are strictly not to be photocopied here.</p> 
					  
					  
				 
					 
					 
										
                </div>
                
			</div>

	   <h3> Reprography Facility</h3>
	 
	  
	  <p>The reprographic facilities are available in Central Library for the students and faculty members, at a very nominal rate of Rs.1/- per A4 size impression (for photocopy) and Rs.2/- only per A4 size page (for print out). One internet-facilitated computer is directly connected with the photocopy machine for taking print out of any online and also offline material as well. This section remains open from 08.00 AM to 09.00 PM on Monday to Friday, and 08.00 AM TO 08.00 PM on Saturday.</p>

		<h5>A personal research assistant:</h5>
		<p class="text-muted">
      Zotero is the only research tool that automatically senses content in your web browser, allowing you to add it to your library with a single click. Whether you're searching for a preprint on arXiv.org, a journal article from JSTOR, a news story from the New York Times, or a book from your university library catalogue, Zotero has you covered with support from thousands of sites.
    </p> 
			
		<h5>Store anything:</h5>
		<p class="text-muted">Zotero collects all your research in a single, searchable interface. You can add PDFs, images, audio and video files, snapshots of web pages, and really anything else. Zotero automatically indexes the full-text content of your library, enabling you to find exactly what you're looking for with just a few keystrokes.</p>

<?php


$config = file_exists('/home/sjubedu/config.php') ? '/home/sjubedu/config.php' : __DIR__ . '/../../config.php';
require_once $config;
$pdo = new PDO("mysql:host=" . DB_HOST . ";dbname=" . DB_NAME . ";charset=utf8mb4", DB_USER, DB_PASS);
    $pdo->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);

    $today = date('Y-m-d');
$weekStart = date('Y-m-d', strtotime('monday this week'));
$weekEnd = date('Y-m-d', strtotime('sunday this week'));
$monthStart = date('Y-m-01');
$status = 'Y';

$sql = "SELECT title,slug,description,created_at,c_image FROM news WHERE c_status = :status 
        ORDER BY created_at DESC";
$stmt = $pdo->prepare($sql);
$stmt->bindParam(':status', $status);
$stmt->execute();

while ($row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)) {
  $newsDate = date('Y-m-d', strtotime($row['created_at']));

if ($newsDate == $today) {
    $category = "today";
}
elseif ($newsDate >= $weekStart && $newsDate <= $weekEnd && $newsDate != $today) {
    $category = "week";
}
elseif ($newsDate >= $monthStart && $newsDate < $weekStart) {
    $category = "month";
}
else {
    $category = "all";
}
    ?>

<script>
    const tabs = document.querySelectorAll(".news-tabs button");
const newsCards = document.querySelectorAll(".news-type");
const searchInput = document.getElementById("newsSearch");

tabs.forEach(tab => {

tab.addEventListener("click", function(){

tabs.forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove("active","btn-primary"));
tabs.forEach(btn => btn.classList.add("btn-light"));

this.classList.add("active","btn-primary");
this.classList.remove("btn-light");

let filter = this.getAttribute("data-filter");

newsCards.forEach(card => {

if(filter === "all" || card.dataset.category === filter){
card.style.display = "block";
}else{
card.style.display = "none";
}

});

});

});
 


 //SEARCH
 //const searchInput = document.getElementById("newsSearch");
//const newsCards = document.querySelectorAll(".news-type");

searchInput.addEventListener("keyup", function() {

let searchValue = this.value.toLowerCase();

newsCards.forEach(card => {

let text = card.innerText.toLowerCase();

if(text.includes(searchValue)){
    card.style.display = "block";
}else{
    card.style.display = "none";
}

});

});
</script>

function makeSlug($text)
{
    $text = strtolower($text);

    // remove special characters except spaces and hyphen
    $text = preg_replace('/[^a-z0-9\s-]/', '', $text);

    // convert spaces to hyphen
    $text = preg_replace('/\s+/', '-', $text);

    // DO NOT remove double hyphen (important for your DB)
    return trim($text, '-');
}

$slug = $_GET['slug'] ?? '';
$slug = urldecode($slug);
$slug = makeSlug($slug);
$status = 'Y';
$sql = "SELECT title, slug, description, created_at, c_image ,c_file_type,c_pdf,c_url,c_text,d_start_date,d_end_date
        FROM news 
        WHERE slug = :slug AND c_status = :status 
        LIMIT 1";

$stmt = $pdo->prepare($sql);
$stmt->bindParam(':slug', $slug);
$stmt->bindParam(':status', $status);
$stmt->execute();

$details = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

    const tabs = document.querySelectorAll(".news-tabs button");
const newsCards = document.querySelectorAll(".news-type");
const searchInput = document.getElementById("newsSearch");

tabs.forEach(tab => {

tab.addEventListener("click", function(){

tabs.forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove("active","btn-primary"));
tabs.forEach(btn => btn.classList.add("btn-light"));

this.classList.add("active","btn-primary");
this.classList.remove("btn-light");

let filter = this.getAttribute("data-filter");

newsCards.forEach(card => {

if(filter === "all" || card.dataset.category === filter){
card.style.display = "block";
}else{
card.style.display = "none";
}

});

});

});

    <?php

    $status = 'Y';
$department="Homepage";
$sql = "SELECT n.title, n.slug, n.d_start_date
        FROM announcements n
        JOIN announcement_departments nd ON n.id = nd.announcement_id
        WHERE nd.c_department = :department
        AND n.c_status = :status
        AND n.d_end_date >= :today
        ORDER BY n.d_end_date DESC";

$stmt = $pdo->prepare($sql);
$stmt->bindParam(':department', $department);
$stmt->bindParam(':status', $status);
$stmt->bindParam(':today', $today);

$stmt->execute();

while ($row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)) {

 $announcement_title = $row['title'];
 $announcement_slug = $row['slug'];
  $announcementDate = date('d F Y', strtotime($row['d_start_date']));


  ?>
      <div class="announcement__message"><a href="announcement-detail.php?slug=<?php echo $announcement_slug;?>">
        <?php echo $announcementDate;?> : <?php echo $announcement_title;?> &nbsp; <span>âºâº</span>&nbsp;</a>
      </div>

      <?php }?>
      
    </div>
  </div>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

  const images = document.querySelectorAll('.img-box img');
  const lightbox = document.getElementById('lightbox');
  const lightboxImg = document.getElementById('lightbox-img');
  const closeBtn = document.querySelector('.lightbox-close');
  const prevBtn = document.querySelector('.lightbox-prev');
  const nextBtn = document.querySelector('.lightbox-next');
  const playPauseBtn = document.getElementById('playPauseBtn');
  const playIcon = document.getElementById('playIcon');
  const downloadBtn = document.getElementById('downloadBtn');
  const progressBar = document.querySelector('.progress');

  let currentIndex = 0;
  let slideshowInterval = null;
  let isPlaying = false;
  const duration = 3000;

  const imgArray = Array.from(images);

  function showImage(index) {
    if (index < 0) {
      currentIndex = imgArray.length - 1;
    } else if (index >= imgArray.length) {
      currentIndex = 0;
    } else {
      currentIndex = index;
    }

    const src = imgArray[currentIndex].src;
    lightboxImg.src = src;
    downloadBtn.href = src;

    resetProgress();
  }

  function resetProgress() {
    progressBar.style.transition = 'none';
    progressBar.style.width = '0%';

    setTimeout(() => {
      progressBar.style.transition = `width ${duration}ms linear`;
      progressBar.style.width = '100%';
    }, 50);
  }

  function startSlideshow() {
    resetProgress();

    slideshowInterval = setInterval(() => {
      showImage(currentIndex + 1);
    }, duration);

    isPlaying = true;
    playIcon.textContent = "❚❚";
  }

  function stopSlideshow() {
    clearInterval(slideshowInterval);
    isPlaying = false;
    playIcon.textContent = "▶";
    progressBar.style.width = '0%';
  }

  // Open
  imgArray.forEach((img, index) => {
    img.addEventListener('click', () => {
      currentIndex = index;
      showImage(currentIndex);
      lightbox.style.display = 'flex';
    });
  });

  // Navigation
  nextBtn.onclick = () => showImage(currentIndex + 1);
  prevBtn.onclick = () => showImage(currentIndex - 1);

  // Play/Pause
  playPauseBtn.onclick = () => {
    if (isPlaying) {
      stopSlideshow();
    } else {
      startSlideshow();
    }
  };

  // Close
  closeBtn.onclick = () => {
    lightbox.style.display = 'none';
    stopSlideshow();
  };

  lightbox.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if (e.target === lightbox) {
      lightbox.style.display = 'none';
      stopSlideshow();
    }
  });

  // Keyboard
  document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (lightbox.style.display === 'flex') {
      if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') showImage(currentIndex + 1);
      if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') showImage(currentIndex - 1);
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        lightbox.style.display = 'none';
        stopSlideshow();
      }
    }
  });

});
</script>

			<div class="left_title_border mt-4 mb-2">
           <h3 class="br_title text_blue fw-bold"><span></span>Placement Process</h3> 
        </div>
				
	  <p>All III Year Under Graduate Students and II Year Post Graduate Students are eligible to apply to be part of the Placement Process. All II Year UG and PG students are eligible to apply for the Pre-Placement Process (Training). Following are the Steps to apply for Placement Services.</p>
        <br/>
        <div class="table-responsive">
                         <table class="table table-responsive table-bordered align-middle fee-table table-col-compact">
                         <tbody>
                             <tr class="table-light">
                               <th scope="row">STEP 1</th>
                               <td>Register for the 30 Hours Skill Development Training in the College Office and collect a Receipt (note the receipt Number)</td>
                              
                             </tr>
                             <tr>
                               <th scope="row">STEP 2</th>
                               <td>Download the Placement Application Form</td>
                             
                               
                             </tr>
                             <tr class="table-light">
                               <th scope="row">STEP 3</th>
                               <td>Submit the copy of the Confirmation Sheet to the Placement Officer</td>
                             
                             </tr>
                             <tr class="table-light">
                               <th scope="row">STEP 4</th>
                               <td> Retain One Copy for yourself.</td>
                             
                             </tr>
                           </tbody>
                         </table>
              </div>
				
				<h5>Placement Season:</h5>
<p>Official Placements will begin from July until March</p>
				<br/>
				
				<h4>How does the Placement Process work?</h4>
				
        <div class="table-responsive">
                         <table class="table table-responsive table-bordered align-middle fee-table table-col-compact">
                         <tbody>
                             <tr class="table-light">
                               <th scope="row">STEP 1</th>
                               <td>HR of a company contacts College or Placement Officer contacts the company</td>
                              
                             </tr>
                             <tr>
                               <th scope="row">STEP 2</th>
                               <td>Announcement is made of a Placement Drive, JD, CTC is announced to students</td>
                             
                               
                             </tr>
                             <tr class="table-light">
                               <th scope="row">STEP 3</th>
                               <td>Placement Representative is contacted with details with regards to Date and Timing</td>
                             
                             </tr>
                             <tr class="table-light">
                               <th scope="row">STEP 4</th>
                               <td> Students are required to Sign-Up for the Placement Drive</td>
                             
                             </tr>
							 
							<tr class="table-light">
                               <th scope="row">STEP 5</th>
                               <td>Companies Confirm the Drive with Infrastructure Details</td>
                             
                           </tr> 
							 <tr class="table-light">
                               <th scope="row">STEP 6</th>
                               <td> Students participate in the Placement Drive (Pre-Placement Talk, Test/Personal Interview)</td>
                             
                             </tr>
							 <tr class="table-light">
                               <th scope="row">STEP 7</th>
                               <td>Short-listed Candidates are announced</td>
                             
                             </tr>
							 
                           </tbody>
                         </table>
              </div>
				<br><br>
				
				<div class="left_title_border mt-4 mb-2">
           <h3 class="br_title text_blue fw-bold"><span></span>Selection</h3> 
        </div>		
				<ul class="language-list mt-2 p-0" style="list-style-type:none;">
                       <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-arrow-right me-2"></i>Each student is allotted a maximum of ONE Offer letter only.</li>
                       <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-arrow-right me-2"></i>You must communicate with the company only via the Placement centre ONLY</li>
					<li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-arrow-right me-2"></i>List of selected students will be put up on the notice board.</li>
                       <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-arrow-right me-2"></i>After having accepted a job offer, if you do not wish to join the company due to genuine reasons, then you must inform the Placement Office.</li>
              </ul>
                      
				<br><br>
				
				<h6><strong>Students, who want to pursue higher studies, do refrain from Placement process.</strong></h6>
				<br><br>
					<div class="left_title_border mt-4 mb-2">
           <h3 class="br_title text_blue fw-bold"><span></span>General Advice</h3> 
        </div>			
				
				<ul class="language-list mt-2 p-0" style="list-style-type:none;">
                       <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-arrow-right me-2"></i>Remember you are representing the college; therefore you will act responsibly and not convey any negative image about the college to companies' officials.</li>

                   <div class="modal-body dean-modal-content">
                     <h4>
                       What makes the School of Business at St Joseph's University different from others?
                     </h4>
                     <p>The world today is changing at such an accelerated rate and we as educators need to pause and reflect on this entire system of education. Are our institutions well equipped to prepare our 
                        students to face the challenges that the future holds? Questions such as these are factors that motivate us to go through a continuous process of reflection and hence we at the School of Business
                        work at implementing a well-balanced curriculum to ensure that the students who walk into the portals of our University will not just love their student life but truly be prepared to face life's 
                        challenges. Since its inception, the School has not only focused on the academic excellence of its students but also has nurtured their potential by providing holistic education.</p>
                        <p>In order to equip the students to assume diverse roles in the corporate world the pedagogy adopted by the School comprises games, role plays, quizzes, industrial visits, and group exercises
                        in addition to lectures, seminars, and case methods. The School also arranges interaction with industry/business executives, management consultants, leaders from NGOs and civil societies, and
                        reputed academicians for the benefit of students to impart practical orientation. Students are evaluated through continuous internal components of class tests, presentations, and assignments; 
                        and the end term exams. Students are trained to think creatively and to develop the right mindset to meet the challenges of the globalised business environment, through value-based education, 
                        interpersonal relations, and outreach programmes.</p>
                     <p>
                       <strong>I welcome aspiring youth to join the Josephite family and become agents of change to serve the ever-changing global needs in the field of commerce and society at large.</strong>
                     </p>

                       <span class=" text_blue fw-bold">â Dr Christo Selvan V</span><br>
                       <span class="text-warning mb-3">Dean, School of Business</span>
                     </p>
                   </div>

                  <?php
                   
                         // Define potential paths for the configuration file
    // Define potential paths for the configuration file
                           $config_paths = [
        '/home/sjubedu/config.php',
        __DIR__ . '/../config.php',
        __DIR__ . '/../../config.php',
        __DIR__ . '/../../../config.php'
    ];

    $config_loaded = false;

    // Loop through paths and load the first one that exists
    foreach ($config_paths as $path) {
        if (file_exists($path)) {
            require_once $path;
            $config_loaded = true;
            break;
        }
    }

    if (!$config_loaded) {
        die("Error: Configuration file not found.");
    }

    // Fetch the specific Form ID from the array in your config.php
    $form_id = isset($FORM_IDS['phd']) ? $FORM_IDS['phd'] : '';

    if (empty($form_id)) {
        die("Error: PhD Form ID is missing from the configuration.");
    }

    // Dynamically insert the Form ID into the Linways API URL
    $api_url = "https://sjuv4.linways.com/api/v1/exat2/forms/reports/{$form_id}/ALL?departmentId=59";

    $api_ch = curl_init();
    curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_URL, $api_url);
    curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
    // $API_TOKEN is also pulled from the loaded config.php file
    curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, ["Authorization: $API_TOKEN", "Accept: application/json"]);
    curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, false);
    $response_data = curl_exec($api_ch);
    $response_data = json_decode($response_data, true);
    curl_close($api_ch); 
?>

                      <table class="table table-responsive table-bordered align-middle api_table">

                                  <th>Supervisor Profile</th>
                                  <th>Status of the Thesis</th>
                              </tr>
                          </thead>
                          <tbody>
                          <?php
                          $cnt = 0;

                          if (!empty($response_data['data'])) {

                              // Sort date
                              usort($response_data['data'], function($a, $b) {
                              $dateA = strtotime($a['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');
                              $dateB = strtotime($b['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');

                              // First sort by date (latest first)
                              if ($dateA != $dateB) {
                                  return $dateB - $dateA;
                              }

                              // If dates are same, sort by name alphabetically
                              return strcmp(
                                  $a['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '',
                                  $b['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? ''
                              );
                            });

                              foreach ($response_data['data'] as $row) {
                                  $cnt++;
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo $cnt; ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '') ?></td>

                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Area of Research'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Title of the Thesis (Provisional)'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top">
                                  <?php if (!empty($row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor'])) { ?>
                                      <a class="fw-semibold text-primary text-decoration-none"
                                         href="<?php echo $row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor']; ?>"
                                         target="_blank">
                                         View Profile
                                      </a>
                                  <?php } ?>
                              </td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Status of the Thesis'] ?? '') ?></td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                              }

                          } else {
                          ?>

  <div class="container"> 
  
    <?php

$API_TOKEN='YOUR_API_TOKEN';

$api_url = "https://sjuv4.linways.com/api/v1/exat2/forms/reports/36rBxCwiGkjZ2aBi2/ALL?departmentId=$department_id";

$api_ch = curl_init();
curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_URL, $api_url);
curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, ["Authorization: $API_TOKEN", "Accept: application/json"]);
curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, false);

$response_data = curl_exec($api_ch);
$response_data = json_decode($response_data, true);
curl_close($api_ch);

?>
<div class="table-responsive" id="publicationTable-<?php echo $report_id; ?>">

<table class="table table-bordered align-middle api_table">

<thead>
<tr>
<th>Sl. no.</th>
<th>Name of Faculty</th>
<th>Title</th>
<th>Name of Journal</th>
<th>Year</th>
<th>DOI/URL</th>
</tr>
</thead>

<tbody id="tableBody-<?php echo $report_id; ?>">

<?php
$cnt=0;

if (!empty($response_data['data'])) {

usort($response_data['data'], function($a, $b) {

$dateA = strtotime($a['Year'] ?? '');
$dateB = strtotime($b['Year'] ?? '');

if ($dateA != $dateB) {
return $dateB - $dateA;
}

return strcmp(
$a['Name of Faculty'] ?? '',
$b['Name of Faculty'] ?? ''
);

});

foreach ($response_data['data'] as $row) {

$cnt++;
?>

<tr>

<td><?php echo $cnt;?></td>

<td><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Name of Faculty'] ?? '') ?></td>

<td><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Title'] ?? '') ?></td>

<td><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Name of Journal'] ?? '') ?></td>

<td><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Year'] ?? '') ?></td>

<td>

<?php if (!empty($row['DOI/URL'])) { ?>

<a class="fw-semibold text-primary text-decoration-none"
href="<?php echo $row['DOI/URL']; ?>" target="_blank">
View More
</a>

<?php } ?>

</td>

</tr>

<?php
}
}
?>

</tbody>
</table>

<nav class="mt-4">
<ul id="pagination-<?php echo $report_id; ?>" class="pagination justify-content-center"></ul>
</nav>

</div>
  </div>
</section>

          the regular BBA programme and BBA Strategic Finance, a programme embedded with Certified Management Accountant (CMA) programme. The Department has ensured an industry-driven and updated
          syllabus that constantly evolves according to the present needs of the market. The faculty comprises well-qualified experts in various fields, working on various research projects to
          further their knowledge about the world of Business.</p>

          <p>The Department believes in holistic development and encourages our students to take part in various institution-level and department-level activities as well as participate in 
          intercollegiate events. An association unique to the Department, the âBusiness Association' conducts fests and competitions for the students to upskill them with practical approaches
          to problem-solving. Students are also encouraged to take part in various social service activities; they are taught to work towards the upliftment of society, working as men and women
          for others.</p>

          <p>Guest lecturers and interactions with entrepreneurs and known leaders are conducted by the Department to give students a more in-depth look at the practical working of the different
          sectors of Industries. Students are also taken on study tours and industrial visits to bring out in them the spirit of innovation and invention, through a close-up look at the production,
          and running of business organisations. The Department continuously strives towards creating better leaders and future agents of change.</p>

                     <h4>
                       What makes the School of Business at St Joseph's University different from others?
                     </h4>
                     <p>The world today is changing at such an accelerated rate and we as educators need to pause and reflect on this entire system of education. Are our institutions well equipped to prepare our 
                        students to face the challenges that the future holds? Questions such as these are factors that motivate us to go through a continuous process of reflection and hence we at the School of Business
                        work at implementing a well-balanced curriculum to ensure that the students who walk into the portals of our University will not just love their student life but truly be prepared to face life's 
                        challenges. Since its inception, the School has not only focused on the academic excellence of its students but also has nurtured their potential by providing holistic education.</p>
                        <p>In order to equip the students to assume diverse roles in the corporate world the pedagogy adopted by the School comprises games, role plays, quizzes, industrial visits, and group exercises
                        in addition to lectures, seminars, and case methods. The School also arranges interaction with industry/business executives, management consultants, leaders from NGOs and civil societies, and
                        reputed academicians for the benefit of students to impart practical orientation. Students are evaluated through continuous internal components of class tests, presentations, and assignments; 
                        and the end term exams. Students are trained to think creatively and to develop the right mindset to meet the challenges of the globalised business environment, through value-based education, 
                        interpersonal relations, and outreach programmes.</p>
                     <p>
                       <strong>I welcome aspiring youth to join the Josephite family and become agents of change to serve the ever-changing global needs in the field of commerce and society at large.</strong>
                     </p>

                     </p>

                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, false);
                         $response_data = curl_exec($api_ch);
                         $response_data = json_decode($response_data, true);
                         curl_close($api_ch); 
                      ?>

                    <div class="table-responsive">
                      <table class="table table-responsive table-bordered align-middle api_table">
                          <thead>
                              <tr>
                                  <th>Sl. no.</th>
                                  <th>Name of Research Scholar</th>
                                  <th>Date of Enrollment for Coursework at SJU</th>
                                  <th>Area of Research</th>
                                  <th>Title of the Thesis (Provisional)</th>
                                  <th>Supervisor Profile</th>
                                  <th>Status of the Thesis</th>
                              </tr>
                          </thead>
                          <tbody>
                          <?php
                          $cnt = 0;

                          if (!empty($response_data['data'])) {
                              
                              // Sort date
                              usort($response_data['data'], function($a, $b) {
                              $dateA = strtotime($a['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');
                              $dateB = strtotime($b['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');

                              // First sort by date (latest first)
                              if ($dateA != $dateB) {
                                  return $dateB - $dateA;
                              }

                              // If dates are same, sort by name alphabetically
                              return strcmp(
                                  $a['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '',
                                  $b['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? ''
                              );
                            });
                            
                              foreach ($response_data['data'] as $row) {
                                  $cnt++;
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo $cnt; ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '') ?></td>

                                      <a class="fw-semibold text-primary text-decoration-none"
                                         href="<?php echo $row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor']; ?>"
                                         target="_blank">
                                         View Profile
                                      </a>
                                  <?php } ?>
                              </td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Status of the Thesis'] ?? '') ?></td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                              }

                          } else {
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td colspan="7" class="text-center fw-semibold py-4">
                                  No records found
                              </td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                          }
                          ?>

        work at implementing a well-balanced curriculum to ensure that the students who walk into the portals of our University will not just love their student life but truly be prepared to face life's 
        challenges. Since its inception, the School has not only focused on the academic excellence of its students but also has nurtured their potential by providing holistic education.</p>
        <p>In order to equip the students to assume diverse roles in the corporate world the pedagogy adopted by the School comprises games, role plays, quizzes, industrial visits, and group exercises
        in addition to lectures, seminars, and case methods. The School also arranges interaction with industry/business executives, management consultants, leaders from NGOs and civil societies, and
        reputed academicians for the benefit of students to impart practical orientation. Students are evaluated through continuous internal components of class tests, presentations, and assignments; 
        and the end term exams. Students are trained to think creatively and to develop the right mindset to meet the challenges of the globalised business environment, through value-based education, 
        interpersonal relations, and outreach programmes.</p>

           <div class="title-area"><h2 class="fw-bold text-blue mb-3">About</h2></div>
          <p><strong>Origin :</strong> Seven out of the eight programme combinations in the Department of Chemistry were in combination with Life Sciences programmes. The management felt that 
          introducing UG Biochemistry programme would benefit students who would be interested in pursuing a career in Life Sciences. The Department of Biochemistry was 
          established in the year 2020.</p>
          <h5>Objectives :</h5>
          <ul class="language-list mt-3 p-0" style="list-style-type:none;">
             <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2"></i>To build a strong curriculum to suit the latest trends in Biochemistry education and research.</li>
             <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2"></i>To cater to all students and pay special attention to weaker students.</li>
             <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2"></i>To promote self-learning in students and hone their analytical thinking skills.</li>
             <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2"></i>To train students to think, innovate and be independent.</li>
             <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2"></i>To introduce Master's (MSc) and Research (PhD) Programmes and make the Department a vibrant and funded research centre in the near future.</li>
          </ul>
        </article>

               <!-- Section Title -->
               <div class="mb-5">
                 <h2 class="fw-bold text_blue mb-1">Message from the <span class="fw-bold text-warning mb-3">Dean</span></h2>
               </div>
               <div class="row">
                 <!-- Image Column -->
                 <div class="col-lg-4 mb-3 dean_col">
                   <div class="dean-image-wrap">
                     <img src="https://sjub.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/Chemical+Sciences/Chemistry/Dr_Nalini_G_Sundaram.webp" alt="School of Chemical Sciences St Joseph's University" class="img-fluid dean-img" loading="lazy" />
                   </div>
                   <h4 class="dean-name mt-3">Dr Nalini G Sundaram</h4>
                   <a href="mailto:dean.chemicalsciences@sju.edu.in" class="dean-email">dean.chemicalsciences@sju.edu.in</a>
                 </div>
                 <!-- Content Column -->
                 <div class="col-lg-8">
                   <p class="dean-excerpt">
                     The School of Chemical Sciences comprises of the Department of Chemistry and the Department of Biochemistry. The Department of Chemistry was established in 1927, and the Department 
                     of Biochemistry was started in 2020. The School offers Undergraduate, Postgraduate Chemistry (Organic and Analytical), and Ph.D. programmes in Chemistry and Undergraduate programme 
                     in Biochemistry. Together, the School has built up its reputation as one among the best in the country, in imparting quality education in the domain of Chemical sciences.
                   </p>
                   <p>The school is proud of its richly experienced, well qualified and highly dedicated faculty. The syllabi of all the courses are carefully designed and modified periodically to help students 
                   develop analytical thinking. The implementation of RBPT (research-based pedagogical tools) and project work for PG and UG students have created great interest and creative thinking in Chemistry, 
                   putting education into action. Many of the student projects have been published in reputed journals and/or presented at National / International conferences.</p>

                   <div class="modal-body dean-modal-content">
                      <p>The School of Chemical Sciences comprises of the Department of Chemistry and the Department of Biochemistry. The Department of Chemistry was established in 1927, and the Department of
                      Biochemistry was started in 2020. The School offers Undergraduate, Postgraduate Chemistry (Organic and Analytical), and Ph.D. programmes in Chemistry and Undergraduate programme in Biochemistry. 
                      Together, the School has built up its reputation as one among the best in the country, in imparting quality education in the domain of Chemical sciences.</p>

                      <p>The school is proud of its richly experienced, well qualified and highly dedicated faculty. The syllabi of all the courses are carefully designed and modified periodically to help students 
                      develop analytical thinking. The implementation of RBPT (research-based pedagogical tools) and project work for PG and UG students have created great interest and creative thinking in Chemistry, 
                      putting education into action. Many of the student projects have been published in reputed journals and/or presented at National/International conferences.</p>

                      <p>The School truly stands out in research and has well-established research labs equipped with modern scientific instruments. The School is proud of having analytical facilities which include 
                      UV, IR, AAS, GC, HPLC, PXRD, IC, AFM, spectrometers, emission spectrometer, electrochemical work station, turbidimeter, rotavapors, high speed centrifuge, cold room, semi auto biochemistry 
                      analyzer and many others. The ongoing research areas include catalysis, materials chemistry, electrochemistry, organic synthesis, protein chemistry, and other areas of biochemistry as well. 
                      Our distinguished faculty have been publishing their work in reputed national and international journals of high impact factor. The total number of research articles published is over 200.
                      Over the past 25 years, the faculty have received financial assistance for their research work from local industries as well as from the Government funding bodies such as UGC, DST, SERB, CSIR 
                      and BRNS. The department has been recognized by DBT and DST and been awarded DBT- STAR status and DST-FIST funding.</p>

                      <p>The school has established research collaborations with national and international laboratories and institutes. St. Joseph's University has also established a tie-up with chemical 
                      and analytical industries and signed an MOU recently, adding strength to the department. Many alumni of the department are performing exceedingly well in the fields of academics, research 
                      and industry within India and abroad as well.</p>

                      <p>The school boasts of vibrant UG Chemical and Biochemical Societies, PG Chemical Society as well which are always abuzz with co-curricular activities such as organizing seminars 
                      and lecture programmes by eminent scientists like Prof. CNR Rao and Nobel laureate Prof. Venkatraman Ramakrishnan, inter-collegiate chemistry festivals, educational trips, science exhibitions 
                      and outreach activities.</p>

                      <p>The school aims to achieve global standards of quality in maintaining academic excellence by being proactive and open to new opportunities and challenges in frontier 
                      fields. The endeavour of the school is to prepare brilliant young chemists, who by their scientific knowledge skills, creativity, leadership and social commitment, would 
                      act as catalysts to bring about positive changes for the benefit of humanity.</p>

                         $api_url = "https://sjuv4.linways.com/api/v1/exat2/forms/reports/KkAkaWwi5XkbQiiDs/ALL?departmentId=117";
 
                         $api_ch = curl_init();
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_URL, $api_url);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, ["Authorization: $API_TOKEN", "Accept: application/json"]);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, false);
                         $response_data = curl_exec($api_ch);
                         $response_data = json_decode($response_data, true);
                         curl_close($api_ch);

                    <div class="table-responsive">

                          <?php
                          $cnt = 0;

                          if (!empty($response_data['data'])) {
                              
                              // Sort date
                              usort($response_data['data'], function($a, $b) {
                              $dateA = strtotime($a['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');
                              $dateB = strtotime($b['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');

                              // First sort by date (latest first)
                              if ($dateA != $dateB) {
                                  return $dateB - $dateA;
                              }

                              // If dates are same, sort by name alphabetically
                              return strcmp(
                                  $a['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '',
                                  $b['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? ''
                              );
                            });

                              foreach ($response_data['data'] as $row) {
                                  $cnt++;
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo $cnt; ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '') ?></td>

                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Area of Research'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Title of the Thesis (Provisional)'] ?? '') ?></td>

                                  <?php if (!empty($row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor'])) { ?>

                                         href="<?php echo $row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor']; ?>"
                                         target="_blank">
                                         View Profile
                                      </a>
                                  <?php } ?>
                              </td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Status of the Thesis'] ?? '') ?></td>

                              }

           <div class="title-area"><h2 class="fw-bold text-blue mb-3">About</h2></div>
          <p>The Department of Chemistry of SJU, established in 1927, is the largest science department in the Institution. Over the last nine decades, the Department has built 
          up its reputation as one of the best in its field as far as imparting education in Chemistry is concerned. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate and PhD programmes in 
          Chemistry. The Department has vastly experienced, well-qualified and highly dedicated faculty to mentor students and guide them.</p>
          <p>The Department has a well-established research centre equipped with modern scientific instruments. Some of the analytical facilities, the Department is proud of 
          having, includes AAS, GC, HPLC, PXRD, IC, AFM, spectrometers, emission spectrometers and electrochemical workstations.</p>

                   <h4 class="dean-name mt-3">Dr Nalini G Sundaram</h4>
