                 </div>
                 <!-- Content Column -->
                 <div class="col-lg-8">
                   <p class="dean-excerpt">
                     The School of Chemical Sciences comprises of the Department of Chemistry and the Department of Biochemistry. The Department of Chemistry was established in 1927, and the Department 
                     of Biochemistry was started in 2020. The School offers Undergraduate, Postgraduate Chemistry (Organic and Analytical), and Ph.D. programmes in Chemistry and Undergraduate programme 
                     in Biochemistry. Together, the School has built up its reputation as one among the best in the country, in imparting quality education in the domain of Chemical sciences.
                   </p>
                   <p>The school is proud of its richly experienced, well qualified and highly dedicated faculty. The syllabi of all the courses are carefully designed and modified periodically to help students 
                   develop analytical thinking. The implementation of RBPT (research-based pedagogical tools) and project work for PG and UG students have created great interest and creative thinking in Chemistry, 
                   putting education into action. Many of the student projects have been published in reputed journals and/or presented at National / International conferences.</p>
                   <button class="btn btn-readmore" data-bs-toggle="modal" data-bs-target="#deanMessageModal" >
                     Read more â'
                   </button>
                 </div>
                </div>
             </div>
 
             <div class="modal fade" id="deanMessageModal" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="deanMessageLabel" aria-hidden="true">
               <div class="modal-dialog modal-dialog-centered modal-lg modal-dialog-scrollable">
                 <div class="modal-content">
                   <div class="modal-header">
                     <h5 class="modal-title" id="deanMessageLabel">
                       Message from the Dean
                     </h5>
                     <button type="button"  class="custom-close" data-bs-dismiss="modal"  aria-label="Close" >
                        <svg width="25" height="25" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" >
                          <line x1="18" y1="6" x2="6" y2="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/>
                          <line x1="6" y1="6" x2="18" y2="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/>
                        </svg>
                     </button>
                   </div>
                   <div class="modal-body dean-modal-content">
                      <p>The School of Chemical Sciences comprises of the Department of Chemistry and the Department of Biochemistry. The Department of Chemistry was established in 1927, and the Department of
                      Biochemistry was started in 2020. The School offers Undergraduate, Postgraduate Chemistry (Organic and Analytical), and Ph.D. programmes in Chemistry and Undergraduate programme in Biochemistry. 
                      Together, the School has built up its reputation as one among the best in the country, in imparting quality education in the domain of Chemical sciences.</p>

                      <p>The school is proud of its richly experienced, well qualified and highly dedicated faculty. The syllabi of all the courses are carefully designed and modified periodically to help students 
                      develop analytical thinking. The implementation of RBPT (research-based pedagogical tools) and project work for PG and UG students have created great interest and creative thinking in Chemistry, 
                      putting education into action. Many of the student projects have been published in reputed journals and/or presented at National/International conferences.</p>

                      <p>The School truly stands out in research and has well-established research labs equipped with modern scientific instruments. The School is proud of having analytical facilities which include 
                      UV, IR, AAS, GC, HPLC, PXRD, IC, AFM, spectrometers, emission spectrometer, electrochemical work station, turbidimeter, rotavapors, high speed centrifuge, cold room, semi auto biochemistry 
                      analyzer and many others. The ongoing research areas include catalysis, materials chemistry, electrochemistry, organic synthesis, protein chemistry, and other areas of biochemistry as well. 
                      Our distinguished faculty have been publishing their work in reputed national and international journals of high impact factor. The total number of research articles published is over 200.
                      Over the past 25 years, the faculty have received financial assistance for their research work from local industries as well as from the Government funding bodies such as UGC, DST, SERB, CSIR 
                      and BRNS. The department has been recognized by DBT and DST and been awarded DBT- STAR status and DST-FIST funding.</p>

                      <p>The school has established research collaborations with national and international laboratories and institutes. St. Joseph's University has also established a tie-up with chemical 
                      and analytical industries and signed an MOU recently, adding strength to the department. Many alumni of the department are performing exceedingly well in the fields of academics, research 
                      and industry within India and abroad as well.</p>

                      <p>The school boasts of vibrant UG Chemical and Biochemical Societies, PG Chemical Society as well which are always abuzz with co-curricular activities such as organizing seminars 
                      and lecture programmes by eminent scientists like Prof. CNR Rao and Nobel laureate Prof. Venkatraman Ramakrishnan, inter-collegiate chemistry festivals, educational trips, science exhibitions 
                      and outreach activities.</p>

                      <p>The school aims to achieve global standards of quality in maintaining academic excellence by being proactive and open to new opportunities and challenges in frontier 
                      fields. The endeavour of the school is to prepare brilliant young chemists, who by their scientific knowledge skills, creativity, leadership and social commitment, would 
                      act as catalysts to bring about positive changes for the benefit of humanity.</p>
                    </div>
                 </div>
               </div>
             </div>

                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_URL, $api_url);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, ["Authorization: $API_TOKEN", "Accept: application/json"]);

                          $cnt = 0;

                              // Sort date
                              usort($response_data['data'], function($a, $b) {
                              $dateA = strtotime($a['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');
                              $dateB = strtotime($b['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');

                              // First sort by date (latest first)
                              if ($dateA != $dateB) {
                                  return $dateB - $dateA;
                              }

                              // If dates are same, sort by name alphabetically
                              return strcmp(
                                  $a['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '',
                                  $b['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? ''
                              );
                            });

                              foreach ($response_data['data'] as $row) {
                                  $cnt++;
                          ?>

                                         target="_blank">

document.getElementById('chemistryDropdown').addEventListener('change', function () {

  // hide all
  document.querySelectorAll('.chem-content').forEach(content => {
    content.classList.add('d-none');
  });

  // show selected
  const selected = this.value;
  document.getElementById(selected).classList.remove('d-none');

});

          The School of Chemical Sciences comprises of the Department of Chemistry and the Department of Biochemistry. The Department of Chemistry was established in 1927, and the Department 
          of Biochemistry was started in 2020. The School offers Undergraduate, Postgraduate Chemistry (Organic and Analytical), and Ph.D. programmes in Chemistry and Undergraduate programme 
          in Biochemistry. Together, the School has built up its reputation as one among the best in the country, in imparting quality education in the domain of Chemical sciences.
        </p>
        <p>The school is proud of its richly experienced, well qualified and highly dedicated faculty. The syllabi of all the courses are carefully designed and modified periodically to help students

        putting education into action. Many of the student projects have been published in reputed journals and/or presented at National / International conferences.</p>

      <div class="modal-body dean-modal-content">
        <p>The School of Chemical Sciences comprises of the Department of Chemistry and the Department of Biochemistry. The Department of Chemistry was established in 1927, and the Department of
        Biochemistry was started in 2020. The School offers Undergraduate, Postgraduate Chemistry (Organic and Analytical), and Ph.D. programmes in Chemistry and Undergraduate programme in Biochemistry. 
        Together, the School has built up its reputation as one among the best in the country, in imparting quality education in the domain of Chemical sciences.</p>

        <p>The school is proud of its richly experienced, well qualified and highly dedicated faculty. The syllabi of all the courses are carefully designed and modified periodically to help students 
        develop analytical thinking. The implementation of RBPT (research-based pedagogical tools) and project work for PG and UG students have created great interest and creative thinking in Chemistry, 
        putting education into action. Many of the student projects have been published in reputed journals and/or presented at National/International conferences.</p>

        <p>The School truly stands out in research and has well-established research labs equipped with modern scientific instruments. The School is proud of having analytical facilities which include 
        UV, IR, AAS, GC, HPLC, PXRD, IC, AFM, spectrometers, emission spectrometer, electrochemical work station, turbidimeter, rotavapors, high speed centrifuge, cold room, semi auto biochemistry 
        analyzer and many others. The ongoing research areas include catalysis, materials chemistry, electrochemistry, organic synthesis, protein chemistry, and other areas of biochemistry as well. 
        Our distinguished faculty have been publishing their work in reputed national and international journals of high impact factor. The total number of research articles published is over 200.
        Over the past 25 years, the faculty have received financial assistance for their research work from local industries as well as from the Government funding bodies such as UGC, DST, SERB, CSIR 
        and BRNS. The department has been recognized by DBT and DST and been awarded DBT- STAR status and DST-FIST funding.</p>

        <p>The school has established research collaborations with national and international laboratories and institutes. St. Joseph's University has also established a tie-up with chemical 
        and analytical industries and signed an MOU recently, adding strength to the department. Many alumni of the department are performing exceedingly well in the fields of academics, research 
        and industry within India and abroad as well.</p>

        <p>The school boasts of vibrant UG Chemical and Biochemical Societies, PG Chemical Society as well which are always abuzz with co-curricular activities such as organizing seminars 
        and lecture programmes by eminent scientists like Prof. CNR Rao and Nobel laureate Prof. Venkatraman Ramakrishnan, inter-collegiate chemistry festivals, educational trips, science exhibitions 
        and outreach activities.</p>

        <p>The school aims to achieve global standards of quality in maintaining academic excellence by being proactive and open to new opportunities and challenges in frontier 
        fields. The endeavour of the school is to prepare brilliant young chemists, who by their scientific knowledge skills, creativity, leadership and social commitment, would 
        act as catalysts to bring about positive changes for the benefit of humanity.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

                     Addressing this reality, the School of Communication & Media Studies (SCMS) strives to train our students become effective communication managers, 
                     who manage communication content meaningfully and efficaciously.</p>

                     <p class="dean-excerpt">To this effect, currently we have five dedicated communication programs â three at the under graduate (UG) level and two 
                     at the post graduate (PG) or masters. The UG programs â Bachelor of Art in Visual Communication (BA-VC or BVC for short), Bachelor of Vocation 
                     in Visual Arts and Filmmaking (BVoc-VMF), and Bachelor of Vocation in Digital Arts and Animation (BVoc-DMA) deal in contemporary media technologies 
                     and platforms, bringing in the best academically and professionally. We have best of teachers from academia and industry. They go out of their way 
                     to accompany you in your academic, professional, and human endeavors.</p>

                     they produce information and they feed on information. More appropriately, it is a Communication Society, in which everything 
                     is molded in terms of communication. If you are not a communication worker, at least in your own little way, you don't belong 
                     to the 21st century. Addressing this reality, the School of Communication & Media Studies (SCMS) strives to train our students 
                     become effective communication managers, who manage communication content meaningfully and efficaciously.</p>

                     <p class="dean-excerpt">To this effect, currently we have five dedicated communication programs â three at the under graduate (UG) level and two at the post graduate (PG) 
                     or masters. The UG programs â Bachelor of Art in Visual Communication (BA-VC or BVC for short), Bachelor of Vocation in Visual Arts and Filmmaking (BVoc-VMF), and Bachelor 
                     of Vocation in Digital Arts and Animation (BVoc-DMA) deal in contemporary media technologies and platforms, bringing in the best academically and professionally. 
                     We have best of teachers from academia and industry. They go out of their way to accompany you in your academic, professional, and human endeavors. No doubt our 
                     students have won laurels at the national and international level. These students are our ambassadors. You check it out! The two PG Programs (the senior most of 
                     our Communication offerings - MA in Journalism & Mass Communication, and the junior most of them - MA in Advertising & Public Relations) are very special. While 
                     the former has consistently been rated one of the top PG programs in Journalism and Communication in the country, the latter became a sensation among students 
                     all over India in its very first year. It is a one-its-kind program in the entire country, for it is entirely taught and anchored by the industry professionals 
                     as adjunct faculty. And you know what it can do you when the academia works so closely with the industry! That is the miracle you see here in SCMS. Welcome then, 
                     be a part of SCMS and the University; take shelter under the wings of our âcool teachers,â be guided by their friendly care and concern; take lessons from our 
                     industry professionals in animation, film, photography, graphic design, journalism, advertising, public relations, and be challenged. Know that you have redefined 
                     the field of communication. Welcome.</p>

                <div class="data-card">
                    <?php
                         $API_TOKEN='eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJhSWQiOiI0NTNlMzRjNWY1NDU5ZDMxNjg5OCIsImNJZCI6IjYyMDgiLCJvSWQiOiI1IiwiaWF0IjoxNzI0OTE1ODI2fQ.WSAp2aF6p0EiS0kjBzlSvE-1QcLnue8eEvYya0-r4ds';
                         $api_url = "https://sjuv4.linways.com/api/v1/exat2/forms/reports/KkAkaWwi5XkbQiiDs/ALL?departmentId=68";
 
                         $api_ch = curl_init();
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_URL, $api_url);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, ["Authorization: $API_TOKEN", "Accept: application/json"]);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, false);
                         $response_data = curl_exec($api_ch);
                         $response_data = json_decode($response_data, true);
                         curl_close($api_ch); 
                      ?>
                      
                    <div class="table-responsive">
                      <table class="table table-responsive table-bordered align-middle api_table">
                          <thead>
                              <tr>
                                  <th>Sl. no.</th>
                                  <th>Name of Research Scholar</th>
                                  <th>Date of Enrollment for Coursework at SJU</th>
                                  <th>Area of Research</th>
                                  <th>Title of the Thesis (Provisional)</th>
                                  <th>Supervisor Profile</th>
                                  <th>Status of the Thesis</th>
                              </tr>
                          </thead>
                          <tbody>
                          <?php
                          $cnt = 0;

                          if (!empty($response_data['data'])) {

                              // Sort date
                              usort($response_data['data'], function($a, $b) {
                              $dateA = strtotime($a['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');
                              $dateB = strtotime($b['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');

                              // First sort by date (latest first)
                              if ($dateA != $dateB) {
                                  return $dateB - $dateA;
                              }

                              // If dates are same, sort by name alphabetically
                              return strcmp(
                                  $a['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '',
                                  $b['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? ''
                              );
                            });

                              foreach ($response_data['data'] as $row) {
                                  $cnt++;
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo $cnt; ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Area of Research'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Title of the Thesis (Provisional)'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top">
                                  <?php if (!empty($row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor'])) { ?>
                                      <a class="fw-semibold text-primary text-decoration-none"
                                         href="<?php echo $row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor']; ?>"
                                         target="_blank">
                                         View Profile
                                      </a>
                                  <?php } ?>
                              </td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Status of the Thesis'] ?? '') ?></td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                              }

                          } else {
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td colspan="7" class="text-center fw-semibold py-4">
                                  No records found
                              </td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                          }
                          ?>
                       </tbody>
                    </table>

<script>


/*MODAL*/
document.querySelectorAll('.read-more-btn').forEach(btn => {
  btn.addEventListener('click', function () {

    const card = this.closest('.testimonial-card');

    // Get data
    const content = card.querySelector('.full-content').innerHTML;
    const img = card.querySelector('img').src;
    const name = card.querySelector('h5').textContent;
    const course = card.querySelector('span').textContent;

    // Inject into modal
    document.getElementById('modalTitle').textContent = name;

    document.getElementById('feeContent').innerHTML = `
      <div class="text-center mb-3">
        <img src="${img}" style="width:80px;height:80px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;border:3px solid #c8a951;">
        <h5 class="mt-2">${name}</h5>
        <span style="color:#c8a951;">${course}</span>
      </div>
      ${content}
    `;

    // Open Bootstrap modal
    const modal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('feeModal'));
    modal.show();

  });
});
</script>

        our Communication offerings - MA in Journalism & Mass Communication, and the junior most of them - MA in Advertising & Public Relations) are very special. While

        all over India in its very first year. It is a one-its-kind program in the entire country, for it is entirely taught and anchored by the industry professionals 
        as adjunct faculty. And you know what it can do you when the academia works so closely with the industry! That is the miracle you see here in SCMS. Welcome then,

        <article id="about" class="dept-section department_tab">
           <div class="title-area"><h2 class="fw-bold text-blue mb-3">About</h2></div>
          <p>The Department of Economics was established in 1882 and is as old as the Institution itself. Economics was a subject at the intermediate level till 1923 and once the Institution became 
          a First Grade College in 1923, Economics became one among the major subjects of study for the degree students. The Department today offers both Undergraduate and Postgraduate programmes. 
          The Postgraduate programme was started in 2006.</p>

          <p>âThe Department is committed to generating interest in the discipline of Economics among students by imparting sound theoretical knowledge and developing quantitative skills to 
          analyse economic behaviour. We are engaged in creating responsible citizens with critical thinking, right human values and attitudes which help one become an agent of change for our society.'</p>

          <p>âPostgraduate programme in Economics aims at building human capital in the discipline of Economics for teaching, training, and research and for employment in various sectors of the economy. 
          The Department will remain focused on forming Economists who will be sensitive to the economic realities and become change agents for our developing economy.â</p>

          <p>Our alumni, both graduates and postgraduates are well placed in various jobs such as researchers in leading national and international academic and research institutions, as college and 
          school teachers, in the corporate sector, in private and nationalised banks, NGOs, civil services, in the government and as leaders in political parties.</p>

          <p>Faculty from the Department have completed major and minor research projects from UGC and ICSSR. The Department regularly organises student seminars and has also organised 
          national-level seminars.</p>

          <p>Some PG Economics classes are supported by DataCamp, an intuitive learning platform for Data Science and Analytics. Learn any time, anywhere and become an expert in R, 
          Python, SQL, and more. DataCamp's learn-by-doing methodology combines short, expert videos and hands-on-the-keyboard exercises to help learners retain knowledge.</p>
        </article>

                   <div class="modal-body dean-modal-content">
                      <h4>Greetings and a warm welcome from the School of Humanities!</h4>

                      <p>The School of Humanities, under St Joseph's University was created to provide learning spaces, with 7 departments and an associate department, the Department of Physical 
                      Education. Of the 7 departments, 5 departments have antecedent of more than 140 years in contributing to the motto of the Institution 'Fide et Labore'- meaning faith and toil.</p>

                      <p>As a stakeholder remotely or distantly you may be interested to know about School of Humanities and the Departments with the School. This message of mine provides you a 
                      glimpse of how we instil passion for excellence that helps our students to create a better tomorrow.</p>


                      <p>Do you know what inspiration, motivation, encouragement, and enthusiasm have in common? These are all without price tags, which are always provided at the School of 
                      Humanities both within and beyond classroom and the result being the students who graduated from this School emerge as a different person â more mature, shaped and inspired.</p>

                      <p>As the Dean, School of Humanities, I'm proud to say that all my colleagues both Associate and Assistant Professors are always ready with passion to inspire hope among 
                      the students; they eagerly help the students to ignite their imagination, and instil love of learning. Our Associate and Assistant Professors set the tone of their 
                      classrooms-they build a warm environment, mentor and nurture the students.</p>

                      <p>Along with the professors, students are helped by amazing group of Mentors, and this will make the School of Humanities a second home for the graduating students.</p>


                      <p>Each Department in the School has academic associations and also non-academic associations which help the students in character formation and also career mapping.</p>

                      <p>Students who wish to join our School, rest assured we will support you in every step of your formation years of 3/ 4-year UG programme or 1/ 2 years of PG programme and 
                      also the Research programme. Your academic success and wellbeing are as important to us, as they are to you.</p>


                      <p>Opportunities provided in the School of Humanities, St Josephs University, Bengaluru, is more than a pathway to a Degree; it is a pathway to discover the purpose of life.</p>

                      <p><strong>Good wishes on your journey at the School of Humanities.</strong></p>

        <article id="about" class="dept-section department_tab">
           <div class="title-area"><h2 class="fw-bold text-blue mb-3">About</h2></div>
          <p>The Department of Economics was established in 1882 and is as old as the Institution itself. Economics was a subject at the intermediate level till 1923 and once the Institution became 
          a First Grade College in 1923, Economics became one among the major subjects of study for the degree students. The Department today offers both Undergraduate and Postgraduate programmes. 
          The Postgraduate programme was started in 2006.</p>

          <p>âThe Department is committed to generating interest in the discipline of Economics among students by imparting sound theoretical knowledge and developing quantitative skills to 
          analyse economic behaviour. We are engaged in creating responsible citizens with critical thinking, right human values and attitudes which help one become an agent of change for our society.'</p>

          <p>âPostgraduate programme in Economics aims at building human capital in the discipline of Economics for teaching, training, and research and for employment in various sectors of the economy. 
          The Department will remain focused on forming Economists who will be sensitive to the economic realities and become change agents for our developing economy.â</p>

          <p>Our alumni, both graduates and postgraduates are well placed in various jobs such as researchers in leading national and international academic and research institutions, as college and 
          school teachers, in the corporate sector, in private and nationalised banks, NGOs, civil services, in the government and as leaders in political parties.</p>

          <p>Faculty from the Department have completed major and minor research projects from UGC and ICSSR. The Department regularly organises student seminars and has also organised 
          national-level seminars.</p>

          <p>Some PG Economics classes are supported by DataCamp, an intuitive learning platform for Data Science and Analytics. Learn any time, anywhere and become an expert in R, 
          Python, SQL, and more. DataCamp's learn-by-doing methodology combines short, expert videos and hands-on-the-keyboard exercises to help learners retain knowledge.</p>
        </article>

                      <h4>Greetings and a warm welcome from the School of Humanities!</h4>

                      <p>The School of Humanities, under St Joseph's University was created to provide learning spaces, with 7 departments and an associate department, the Department of Physical 
                      Education. Of the 7 departments, 5 departments have antecedent of more than 140 years in contributing to the motto of the Institution 'Fide et Labore'- meaning faith and toil.</p>

                      <p>As a stakeholder remotely or distantly you may be interested to know about School of Humanities and the Departments with the School. This message of mine provides you a 
                      glimpse of how we instil passion for excellence that helps our students to create a better tomorrow.</p>


                      <p>Do you know what inspiration, motivation, encouragement, and enthusiasm have in common? These are all without price tags, which are always provided at the School of 
                      Humanities both within and beyond classroom and the result being the students who graduated from this School emerge as a different person â more mature, shaped and inspired.</p>

                      <p>As the Dean, School of Humanities, I'm proud to say that all my colleagues both Associate and Assistant Professors are always ready with passion to inspire hope among 
                      the students; they eagerly help the students to ignite their imagination, and instil love of learning. Our Associate and Assistant Professors set the tone of their 
                      classrooms-they build a warm environment, mentor and nurture the students.</p>

                      <p>Along with the professors, students are helped by amazing group of Mentors, and this will make the School of Humanities a second home for the graduating students.</p>


                      <p>Each Department in the School has academic associations and also non-academic associations which help the students in character formation and also career mapping.</p>

                      <p>Students who wish to join our School, rest assured we will support you in every step of your formation years of 3/ 4-year UG programme or 1/ 2 years of PG programme and 
                      also the Research programme. Your academic success and wellbeing are as important to us, as they are to you.</p>


                      <p>Opportunities provided in the School of Humanities, St Josephs University, Bengaluru, is more than a pathway to a Degree; it is a pathway to discover the purpose of life.</p>

                      <p><strong>Good wishes on your journey at the School of Humanities.</strong></p>

                <div class="data-card">
                    <?php
                         $API_TOKEN='eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJhSWQiOiI0NTNlMzRjNWY1NDU5ZDMxNjg5OCIsImNJZCI6IjYyMDgiLCJvSWQiOiI1IiwiaWF0IjoxNzI0OTE1ODI2fQ.WSAp2aF6p0EiS0kjBzlSvE-1QcLnue8eEvYya0-r4ds';
                         $api_url = "https://sjuv4.linways.com/api/v1/exat2/forms/reports/KkAkaWwi5XkbQiiDs/ALL?departmentId=64";
 
                         $api_ch = curl_init();
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_URL, $api_url);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, ["Authorization: $API_TOKEN", "Accept: application/json"]);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, false);
                         $response_data = curl_exec($api_ch);
                         $response_data = json_decode($response_data, true);
                         curl_close($api_ch); 
                      ?>
                      
                    <div class="table-responsive">
                      <table class="table table-responsive table-bordered align-middle api_table">
                          <thead>
                              <tr>
                                  <th>Sl. no.</th>
                                  <th>Name of Research Scholar</th>
                                  <th>Date of Enrollment for Coursework at SJU</th>
                                  <th>Area of Research</th>
                                  <th>Title of the Thesis (Provisional)</th>
                                  <th>Supervisor Profile</th>
                                  <th>Status of the Thesis</th>
                              </tr>
                          </thead>
                          <tbody>
                          <?php
                          $cnt = 0;

                          if (!empty($response_data['data'])) {
                              
                              // Sort date
                              usort($response_data['data'], function($a, $b) {
                              $dateA = strtotime($a['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');
                              $dateB = strtotime($b['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');

                              // First sort by date (latest first)
                              if ($dateA != $dateB) {
                                  return $dateB - $dateA;
                              }

                              // If dates are same, sort by name alphabetically
                              return strcmp(
                                  $a['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '',
                                  $b['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? ''
                              );
                            });

                              foreach ($response_data['data'] as $row) {
                                  $cnt++;
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo $cnt; ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Area of Research'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Title of the Thesis (Provisional)'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top">
                                  <?php if (!empty($row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor'])) { ?>
                                      <a class="fw-semibold text-primary text-decoration-none"
                                         href="<?php echo $row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor']; ?>"
                                         target="_blank">
                                         View Profile
                                      </a>
                                  <?php } ?>
                              </td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Status of the Thesis'] ?? '') ?></td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                              }

                          } else {
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td colspan="7" class="text-center fw-semibold py-4">
                                  No records found
                              </td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                          }
                          ?>
                       </tbody>
                    </table>
                  </div>
                 </div>
                </div>

        <article id="about" class="dept-section department_tab">
           <div class="title-area"><h2 class="fw-bold text-blue mb-3">About</h2></div>
          <p>The Department of History is one of the first departments started in the Institution dating back to the 1930s. The students 
          tend to be heterogeneous, ranging from those well-read, who possess a good deal of insight and have a clear goal as to what they 
          want to do in life to the larger percentage in the class who for reasons academic, economic, and social, need basic assistance, 
          encouragement and follow up.  In this context, the Department does a lot of remedial work to help academically weaker students 
          perform better. Students tend to be varied, ranging from those who are well-read, possess a great deal of insight, and have a 
          well-defined life objective to the majority of the class who, for academic, economic, and social reasons, require basic input, 
          support, encouragement, and follow-up. The Department strives to make history instruction engaging, informative, and pertinent. 
          Consistent use of audiovisuals is employed to supplement the information. While conducting a class, efforts to inculcate a spirit 
          of inquiry among the students are encouraged. Wall maps, models, pictures, etc., are used to supplement data. The Department runs 
          a History Association titled âParishodhana'. Through its own newsletter, 'The Pendulum,' the Department encourages students to 
          explore with their research abilities. The Department of History also conducts its annual 60 hour Certificate Credit Course on 
          âGleaning India's History through Numismatics'. </p>
        </article>

                      <h4>Greetings and a warm welcome from the School of Humanities!</h4>

                      <p>The School of Humanities, under St Joseph's University was created to provide learning spaces, with 7 departments and an associate department, the Department of Physical 
                      Education. Of the 7 departments, 5 departments have antecedent of more than 140 years in contributing to the motto of the Institution 'Fide et Labore'- meaning faith and toil.</p>

                      <p>As a stakeholder remotely or distantly you may be interested to know about School of Humanities and the Departments with the School. This message of mine provides you a 
                      glimpse of how we instil passion for excellence that helps our students to create a better tomorrow.</p>


                      <p>Do you know what inspiration, motivation, encouragement, and enthusiasm have in common? These are all without price tags, which are always provided at the School of 
                      Humanities both within and beyond classroom and the result being the students who graduated from this School emerge as a different person â more mature, shaped and inspired.</p>

                      <p>As the Dean, School of Humanities, I'm proud to say that all my colleagues both Associate and Assistant Professors are always ready with passion to inspire hope among 
                      the students; they eagerly help the students to ignite their imagination, and instil love of learning. Our Associate and Assistant Professors set the tone of their 
                      classrooms-they build a warm environment, mentor and nurture the students.</p>

                      <p>Along with the professors, students are helped by amazing group of Mentors, and this will make the School of Humanities a second home for the graduating students.</p>


                      <p>Each Department in the School has academic associations and also non-academic associations which help the students in character formation and also career mapping.</p>

                      <p>Students who wish to join our School, rest assured we will support you in every step of your formation years of 3/ 4-year UG programme or 1/ 2 years of PG programme and 
                      also the Research programme. Your academic success and wellbeing are as important to us, as they are to you.</p>


                      <p>Opportunities provided in the School of Humanities, St Josephs University, Bengaluru, is more than a pathway to a Degree; it is a pathway to discover the purpose of life.</p>

                      <p><strong>Good wishes on your journey at the School of Humanities.</strong></p>

           <div class="title-area"><h2 class="fw-bold text-blue mb-3">About</h2></div>
          <p>The Department of History is one of the first departments started in the Institution dating back to the 1930s. The students 
          tend to be heterogeneous, ranging from those well-read, who possess a good deal of insight and have a clear goal as to what they 
          want to do in life to the larger percentage in the class who for reasons academic, economic, and social, need basic assistance, 
          encouragement and follow up.  In this context, the Department does a lot of remedial work to help academically weaker students 
          perform better. Students tend to be varied, ranging from those who are well-read, possess a great deal of insight, and have a 
          well-defined life objective to the majority of the class who, for academic, economic, and social reasons, require basic input, 
          support, encouragement, and follow-up. The Department strives to make history instruction engaging, informative, and pertinent. 
          Consistent use of audiovisuals is employed to supplement the information. While conducting a class, efforts to inculcate a spirit 
          of inquiry among the students are encouraged. Wall maps, models, pictures, etc., are used to supplement data. The Department runs 
          a History Association titled âParishodhana'. Through its own newsletter, 'The Pendulum,' the Department encourages students to 
          explore with their research abilities. The Department of History also conducts its annual 60 hour Certificate Credit Course on 
          âGleaning India's History through Numismatics'. </p>

                         $api_url = "https://sjuv4.linways.com/api/v1/exat2/forms/reports/KkAkaWwi5XkbQiiDs/ALL?departmentId=107";
 
                         $api_ch = curl_init();
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_URL, $api_url);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, ["Authorization: $API_TOKEN", "Accept: application/json"]);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, false);

                          <?php
                          $cnt = 0;

                          if (!empty($response_data['data'])) {

                              // Sort date
                              usort($response_data['data'], function($a, $b) {
                              $dateA = strtotime($a['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');
                              $dateB = strtotime($b['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');

                              // First sort by date (latest first)
                              if ($dateA != $dateB) {
                                  return $dateB - $dateA;
                              }

                              // If dates are same, sort by name alphabetically
                              return strcmp(
                                  $a['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '',
                                  $b['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? ''
                              );
                            });

                              foreach ($response_data['data'] as $row) {
                                  $cnt++;
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo $cnt; ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '') ?></td>

        <article id="about" class="dept-section department_tab">
           <div class="title-area"><h2 class="fw-bold text-blue mb-3">About</h2></div>
          <p>The Department of International Relations, Peace and Public Policy at St Joseph's University offers a distinctive curriculum that balances theory and practice. 
          With our programmes offering super specialisations within the larger field of Political Science in the disciplines of International Relations, Public Policy and Peace 
          and Conflict Studies, our Department aims to develop a cohort that is prepared for diverse careers in academia, research, administration and government.</p>

          <p>Through our carefully designed curriculums, we strive to inculcate the ideals of peaceful conflict resolution, teach the importance of understanding the 
          root causes of conflict, and pursue non-violent means to transform societies. We aim to cultivate critical thinking with theoretical and conceptual insights 
          to bring socio-economic transformation through policy-making machineries. With this comprehensive approach, we provide our students with the space and opportunity 
          to develop academic rigour and scope for greater learning.</p>

          <p>Today, in an era of globalisation, the world is experiencing new-age challenges like civil unrest, unconventional violence, conflicts, climate change, 
          terrorism, refugee crisis, and human rights violations, among many others. Simultaneously, we are also in an era of rapid growth, change, and never before 
          seen opportunity for India, on both domestic and international levels, where it is becoming the need of the hour for there to be policies that equip India 
          both on a global and domestic realm to use these opportunities and tackle the new age challenges.</p>

          <p>Through our distinctive programmes, we are committed to preparing our students with the knowledge and tools required to develop a deeper understanding 
          to critically interpret the complexities of contemporary global and domestic challenges and identify policy solutions and avenues of cooperation, thus 
          equipping the students in contributing to address these global challenges and be a part of the change.</p>
        </article>

                              <h2>Mission</h2>
                       </header>
                       <ul class="language-list mt-3 p-0">
                           <li class="pb-1">The Department of Industrial Relations aims to familiarize students with the structure and dynamics of Industrial Organization 
                           and the Tri-partite nature of Industrial Relations.</li>

                      classrooms-they build a warm environment, mentor and nurture the students.</p>

        <article id="about" class="dept-section department_tab">
           <div class="title-area"><h2 class="fw-bold text-blue mb-3">About</h2></div>
          <p>The Department of International Relations, Peace and Public Policy at St Joseph's University offers a distinctive curriculum that balances theory and practice. 
          With our programmes offering super specialisations within the larger field of Political Science in the disciplines of International Relations, Public Policy and Peace 
          and Conflict Studies, our Department aims to develop a cohort that is prepared for diverse careers in academia, research, administration and government.</p>

          <p>Through our carefully designed curriculums, we strive to inculcate the ideals of peaceful conflict resolution, teach the importance of understanding the 
          root causes of conflict, and pursue non-violent means to transform societies. We aim to cultivate critical thinking with theoretical and conceptual insights 
          to bring socio-economic transformation through policy-making machineries. With this comprehensive approach, we provide our students with the space and opportunity 
          to develop academic rigour and scope for greater learning.</p>

          <p>Today, in an era of globalisation, the world is experiencing new-age challenges like civil unrest, unconventional violence, conflicts, climate change, 
          terrorism, refugee crisis, and human rights violations, among many others. Simultaneously, we are also in an era of rapid growth, change, and never before 
          seen opportunity for India, on both domestic and international levels, where it is becoming the need of the hour for there to be policies that equip India 
          both on a global and domestic realm to use these opportunities and tackle the new age challenges.</p>

          <p>Through our distinctive programmes, we are committed to preparing our students with the knowledge and tools required to develop a deeper understanding 
          to critically interpret the complexities of contemporary global and domestic challenges and identify policy solutions and avenues of cooperation, thus 
          equipping the students in contributing to address these global challenges and be a part of the change.</p>
        </article>

                      <h4>Greetings and a warm welcome from the School of Humanities!</h4>

                      <p>The School of Humanities, under St Joseph's University was created to provide learning spaces, with 7 departments and an associate department, the Department of Physical 
                      Education. Of the 7 departments, 5 departments have antecedent of more than 140 years in contributing to the motto of the Institution 'Fide et Labore'- meaning faith and toil.</p>

                      <p>As a stakeholder remotely or distantly you may be interested to know about School of Humanities and the Departments with the School. This message of mine provides you a 
                      glimpse of how we instil passion for excellence that helps our students to create a better tomorrow.</p>


                      <p>Do you know what inspiration, motivation, encouragement, and enthusiasm have in common? These are all without price tags, which are always provided at the School of 
                      Humanities both within and beyond classroom and the result being the students who graduated from this School emerge as a different person â more mature, shaped and inspired.</p>

                      <p>As the Dean, School of Humanities, I'm proud to say that all my colleagues both Associate and Assistant Professors are always ready with passion to inspire hope among 
                      the students; they eagerly help the students to ignite their imagination, and instil love of learning. Our Associate and Assistant Professors set the tone of their 
                      classrooms-they build a warm environment, mentor and nurture the students.</p>

                      <p>Along with the professors, students are helped by amazing group of Mentors, and this will make the School of Humanities a second home for the graduating students.</p>


                      <p>Each Department in the School has academic associations and also non-academic associations which help the students in character formation and also career mapping.</p>

                      <p>Students who wish to join our School, rest assured we will support you in every step of your formation years of 3/ 4-year UG programme or 1/ 2 years of PG programme and 
                      also the Research programme. Your academic success and wellbeing are as important to us, as they are to you.</p>


                      <p>Opportunities provided in the School of Humanities, St Josephs University, Bengaluru, is more than a pathway to a Degree; it is a pathway to discover the purpose of life.</p>

                              $dateB = strtotime($b['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');

                              // First sort by date (latest first)
                              if ($dateA != $dateB) {
                                  return $dateB - $dateA;

                              // If dates are same, sort by name alphabetically

        <article id="about" class="dept-section department_tab">
           <div class="title-area"><h2 class="fw-bold text-blue mb-3">About</h2></div>
          <p>The BA degree programme was started in erstwhile St Joseph's College, in the year 1926. The students were admitted to BA programme in 
          July 1926. Fr J Argaunt, Principal of the College during the years (1924-1926), played a key role in the introduction of BA programme.</p>

          <p>During the early 1920s, different subjects were taught under the nomenclature of History, Economics, Political Science and Logic. 
          All these subjects were under the Department of Social Sciences. The Department of Social Sciences was headed by a single professor 
          for a long time. The last professor to hold such a position was Prof S Asirvatham. The Department system came into existence only in 
          the year 1962, with each Department headed by a professor. The Department of Political Science came into existence the same year.</p>

          <p>The Department of Political Science during the last ninety-five years has been served by eminent  Professors like PM Francis, Michael, 
          S Clement, Balakrishna, Dr Benny Peters, Fr Ambrose Pinto SJ, Fr Francis D'Almeda SJ, Prof Jerome Nirmal Raj and many others. Dr Benny Peters 
          secured PhD degree in the year 1993 and has the unique honor of being the first PhD holder to teach in the Humanities section.</p>
        </article>

                       </header>
                       <p>The programmes in Political Science aim to:</p>

                      <h4>Greetings and a warm welcome from the School of Humanities!</h4>

                      <p>The School of Humanities, under St Joseph's University was created to provide learning spaces, with 7 departments and an associate department, the Department of Physical 
                      Education. Of the 7 departments, 5 departments have antecedent of more than 140 years in contributing to the motto of the Institution 'Fide et Labore'- meaning faith and toil.</p>

                      <p>As a stakeholder remotely or distantly you may be interested to know about School of Humanities and the Departments with the School. This message of mine provides you a 
                      glimpse of how we instil passion for excellence that helps our students to create a better tomorrow.</p>


                      <p>Do you know what inspiration, motivation, encouragement, and enthusiasm have in common? These are all without price tags, which are always provided at the School of 
                      Humanities both within and beyond classroom and the result being the students who graduated from this School emerge as a different person â more mature, shaped and inspired.</p>

                      <p>As the Dean, School of Humanities, I'm proud to say that all my colleagues both Associate and Assistant Professors are always ready with passion to inspire hope among 
                      the students; they eagerly help the students to ignite their imagination, and instil love of learning. Our Associate and Assistant Professors set the tone of their 
                      classrooms-they build a warm environment, mentor and nurture the students.</p>

                      <p>Along with the professors, students are helped by amazing group of Mentors, and this will make the School of Humanities a second home for the graduating students.</p>


                      <p>Each Department in the School has academic associations and also non-academic associations which help the students in character formation and also career mapping.</p>

                      <p>Students who wish to join our School, rest assured we will support you in every step of your formation years of 3/ 4-year UG programme or 1/ 2 years of PG programme and

                <div class="data-card">
                     <?php
                         $API_TOKEN='eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJhSWQiOiI0NTNlMzRjNWY1NDU5ZDMxNjg5OCIsImNJZCI6IjYyMDgiLCJvSWQiOiI1IiwiaWF0IjoxNzI0OTE1ODI2fQ.WSAp2aF6p0EiS0kjBzlSvE-1QcLnue8eEvYya0-r4ds';
                         $api_url = "https://sjuv4.linways.com/api/v1/exat2/forms/reports/KkAkaWwi5XkbQiiDs/ALL?departmentId=65";
 
                         $api_ch = curl_init();
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_URL, $api_url);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, ["Authorization: $API_TOKEN", "Accept: application/json"]);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, false);
                         $response_data = curl_exec($api_ch);
                         $response_data = json_decode($response_data, true);
                         curl_close($api_ch); 
                      ?>
                      
                    <div class="table-responsive">
                      <table class="table table-responsive table-bordered align-middle api_table">
                          <thead>
                              <tr>
                                  <th>Sl. no.</th>
                                  <th>Name of Research Scholar</th>
                                  <th>Date of Enrollment for Coursework at SJU</th>
                                  <th>Area of Research</th>
                                  <th>Title of the Thesis (Provisional)</th>
                                  <th>Supervisor Profile</th>
                                  <th>Status of the Thesis</th>
                              </tr>
                          </thead>
                          <tbody>
                          <?php
                          $cnt = 0;

                          if (!empty($response_data['data'])) {

                              // Sort date
                              usort($response_data['data'], function($a, $b) {
                              $dateA = strtotime($a['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');
                              $dateB = strtotime($b['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');

                              // First sort by date (latest first)
                              if ($dateA != $dateB) {
                                  return $dateB - $dateA;
                              }

                              // If dates are same, sort by name alphabetically
                              return strcmp(
                                  $a['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '',
                                  $b['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? ''
                              );
                            });

                              foreach ($response_data['data'] as $row) {
                                  $cnt++;
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo $cnt; ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Area of Research'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Title of the Thesis (Provisional)'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top">
                                  <?php if (!empty($row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor'])) { ?>
                                      <a class="fw-semibold text-primary text-decoration-none"
                                         href="<?php echo $row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor']; ?>"
                                         target="_blank">
                                         View Profile
                                      </a>
                                  <?php } ?>
                              </td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Status of the Thesis'] ?? '') ?></td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                              }

                          } else {
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td colspan="7" class="text-center fw-semibold py-4">
                                  No records found
                              </td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                          }
                          ?>
                       </tbody>
                    </table>
                  </div>

        <article id="about" class="dept-section department_tab">
           <div class="title-area"><h2 class="fw-bold text-blue mb-3">About</h2></div>
          <p>The Department of Psychology was established in the year 2013. The Department aims to help students develop a deep understanding of the multifaceted nature 
          of the human personality, the wellsprings of motivation and interpersonal relationships so as to be able to contribute to the well-being of humanity. 
          The mission of the Department is to achieve excellence that generates new knowledge through research and internships, and also to make students emotionally 
          mature and creative in their responses to life situations. The Department offers both Undergraduate and Postgraduate programmes.</p>

          <p>The Department has passionate faculty engaged in counselling, training and research. Students are involved in internships, field visits, and certificate courses and are 
          given broad exposure to the subject in order to gain an understanding of the cultural context of Psychology and mental health. The Department had signed a Memorandum of 
          Understanding with International Universities; the students have visited Singapore, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, presented papers on the theme of Mental Health literacy, and 
          students also visited the Green School in Bali to gain global exposure in the past two years. The Department has also collaborated with various organisations around the 
          country to offer our students a wide variety of certificate courses and internship opportunities. The Department organises international and national conferences, seminars, 
          workshops, and webinars on the themes of mental health, gender issues, neurodiversity, LGBTQIA, child sexual abuse and intimate partner violence.</p>
        </article>

                      <h4>Greetings and a warm welcome from the School of Humanities!</h4>

                      <p>The School of Humanities, under St Joseph's University was created to provide learning spaces, with 7 departments and an associate department, the Department of Physical 
                      Education. Of the 7 departments, 5 departments have antecedent of more than 140 years in contributing to the motto of the Institution 'Fide et Labore'- meaning faith and toil.</p>

                      <p>As a stakeholder remotely or distantly you may be interested to know about School of Humanities and the Departments with the School. This message of mine provides you a

                      <p>Do you know what inspiration, motivation, encouragement, and enthusiasm have in common? These are all without price tags, which are always provided at the School of 
                      Humanities both within and beyond classroom and the result being the students who graduated from this School emerge as a different person â more mature, shaped and inspired.</p>

                      <p>As the Dean, School of Humanities, I'm proud to say that all my colleagues both Associate and Assistant Professors are always ready with passion to inspire hope among 
                      the students; they eagerly help the students to ignite their imagination, and instil love of learning. Our Associate and Assistant Professors set the tone of their 
                      classrooms-they build a warm environment, mentor and nurture the students.</p>

                      <p>Along with the professors, students are helped by amazing group of Mentors, and this will make the School of Humanities a second home for the graduating students.</p>


                      <p>Each Department in the School has academic associations and also non-academic associations which help the students in character formation and also career mapping.</p>

                      <p>Students who wish to join our School, rest assured we will support you in every step of your formation years of 3/ 4-year UG programme or 1/ 2 years of PG programme and 
                      also the Research programme. Your academic success and wellbeing are as important to us, as they are to you.</p>


                      <p>Opportunities provided in the School of Humanities, St Josephs University, Bengaluru, is more than a pathway to a Degree; it is a pathway to discover the purpose of life.</p>

                     <?php
                         $API_TOKEN='eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJhSWQiOiI0NTNlMzRjNWY1NDU5ZDMxNjg5OCIsImNJZCI6IjYyMDgiLCJvSWQiOiI1IiwiaWF0IjoxNzI0OTE1ODI2fQ.WSAp2aF6p0EiS0kjBzlSvE-1QcLnue8eEvYya0-r4ds';
                         $api_url = "https://sjuv4.linways.com/api/v1/exat2/forms/reports/KkAkaWwi5XkbQiiDs/ALL?departmentId=69";
 
                         $api_ch = curl_init();
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_URL, $api_url);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, ["Authorization: $API_TOKEN", "Accept: application/json"]);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, false);
                         $response_data = curl_exec($api_ch);
                         $response_data = json_decode($response_data, true);
                         curl_close($api_ch); 
                      ?>
                      
                    <div class="table-responsive">
                      <table class="table table-responsive table-bordered align-middle api_table">
                          <thead>
                              <tr>
                                  <th>Sl. no.</th>
                                  <th>Name of Research Scholar</th>
                                  <th>Date of Enrollment for Coursework at SJU</th>
                                  <th>Area of Research</th>
                                  <th>Title of the Thesis (Provisional)</th>
                                  <th>Supervisor Profile</th>
                                  <th>Status of the Thesis</th>
                              </tr>
                          </thead>
                          <tbody>
                          <?php
                          $cnt = 0;

                          if (!empty($response_data['data'])) {

                              // Sort date
                              usort($response_data['data'], function($a, $b) {
                              $dateA = strtotime($a['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');
                              $dateB = strtotime($b['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');

                              // First sort by date (latest first)
                              if ($dateA != $dateB) {
                                  return $dateB - $dateA;
                              }

                              // If dates are same, sort by name alphabetically
                              return strcmp(
                                  $a['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '',
                                  $b['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? ''
                              );
                            });

                              foreach ($response_data['data'] as $row) {
                                  $cnt++;
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo $cnt; ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Area of Research'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Title of the Thesis (Provisional)'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top">
                                  <?php if (!empty($row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor'])) { ?>
                                      <a class="fw-semibold text-primary text-decoration-none"
                                         href="<?php echo $row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor']; ?>"
                                         target="_blank">
                                         View Profile
                                      </a>
                                  <?php } ?>
                              </td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Status of the Thesis'] ?? '') ?></td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                              }

                          } else {
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td colspan="7" class="text-center fw-semibold py-4">
                                  No records found
                              </td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                          }

           <div class="title-area"><h2 class="fw-bold text-blue mb-3">About</h2></div>
          <p>The Department of Psychology was established in the year 2013. The Department aims to help students develop a deep understanding of the multifaceted nature 
          of the human personality, the wellsprings of motivation and interpersonal relationships so as to be able to contribute to the well-being of humanity. 
          The mission of the Department is to achieve excellence that generates new knowledge through research and internships, and also to make students emotionally 
          mature and creative in their responses to life situations. The Department offers both Undergraduate and Postgraduate programmes.</p>

          <p>The Department has passionate faculty engaged in counselling, training and research. Students are involved in internships, field visits, and certificate courses and are 
          given broad exposure to the subject in order to gain an understanding of the cultural context of Psychology and mental health. The Department had signed a Memorandum of 
          Understanding with International Universities; the students have visited Singapore, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, presented papers on the theme of Mental Health literacy, and 
          students also visited the Green School in Bali to gain global exposure in the past two years. The Department has also collaborated with various organisations around the 
          country to offer our students a wide variety of certificate courses and internship opportunities. The Department organises international and national conferences, seminars, 
          workshops, and webinars on the themes of mental health, gender issues, neurodiversity, LGBTQIA, child sexual abuse and intimate partner violence.</p>

                      <h4>Greetings and a warm welcome from the School of Humanities!</h4>

                      <p>The School of Humanities, under St Joseph's University was created to provide learning spaces, with 7 departments and an associate department, the Department of Physical 
                      Education. Of the 7 departments, 5 departments have antecedent of more than 140 years in contributing to the motto of the Institution 'Fide et Labore'- meaning faith and toil.</p>

                      <p>As a stakeholder remotely or distantly you may be interested to know about School of Humanities and the Departments with the School. This message of mine provides you a 
                      glimpse of how we instil passion for excellence that helps our students to create a better tomorrow.</p>


                      <p>Do you know what inspiration, motivation, encouragement, and enthusiasm have in common? These are all without price tags, which are always provided at the School of 
                      Humanities both within and beyond classroom and the result being the students who graduated from this School emerge as a different person â more mature, shaped and inspired.</p>

                      <p>As the Dean, School of Humanities, I'm proud to say that all my colleagues both Associate and Assistant Professors are always ready with passion to inspire hope among 
                      the students; they eagerly help the students to ignite their imagination, and instil love of learning. Our Associate and Assistant Professors set the tone of their 
                      classrooms-they build a warm environment, mentor and nurture the students.</p>

                      <p>Along with the professors, students are helped by amazing group of Mentors, and this will make the School of Humanities a second home for the graduating students.</p>


                      <p>Each Department in the School has academic associations and also non-academic associations which help the students in character formation and also career mapping.</p>

                      <p>Students who wish to join our School, rest assured we will support you in every step of your formation years of 3/ 4-year UG programme or 1/ 2 years of PG programme and 
                      also the Research programme. Your academic success and wellbeing are as important to us, as they are to you.</p>


                      <p>Opportunities provided in the School of Humanities, St Josephs University, Bengaluru, is more than a pathway to a Degree; it is a pathway to discover the purpose of life.</p>

                      <p><strong>Good wishes on your journey at the School of Humanities.</strong></p>
                    </div>

        <article id="about" class="dept-section department_tab">
           <div class="title-area"><h2 class="fw-bold text-blue mb-3">About</h2></div>
          <p>The Undergraduate Department of Sociology was started in the year 1959. It was initially offered with Economics and Political Science, and 
          Economics and Industrial Relations under the Triple Major Scheme. With the introduction of the New Education Policy, Sociology is offered in BA 
          under the double major scheme with Economics, Political Science, and History.</p>

          <p>A subject in much demand for aspirants of Civil Services, the papers offered are of much use for students aspiring for higher studies and a 
          career in Civil Services, Social Work, Law, Academics, etc. The Department also offers a Certificate Course in Medical Sociology.</p>

          <p>Well-known Indian Sociologists from Bengaluru- Dr. N. Jayaram, Dr. Y Narayana Chetty, and Dr. Chandan Gowda are Alumni of the Department.</p>
        </article>
