                      <h4>Greetings and a warm welcome from the School of Humanities!</h4>

                      <p>The School of Humanities, under St Joseph's University was created to provide learning spaces, with 7 departments and an associate department, the Department of Physical 
                      Education. Of the 7 departments, 5 departments have antecedent of more than 140 years in contributing to the motto of the Institution 'Fide et Labore'- meaning faith and toil.</p>

                      <p>As a stakeholder remotely or distantly you may be interested to know about School of Humanities and the Departments with the School. This message of mine provides you a 
                      glimpse of how we instil passion for excellence that helps our students to create a better tomorrow.</p>


                      <p>Do you know what inspiration, motivation, encouragement, and enthusiasm have in common? These are all without price tags, which are always provided at the School of 
                      Humanities both within and beyond classroom and the result being the students who graduated from this School emerge as a different person â more mature, shaped and inspired.</p>

                      <p>As the Dean, School of Humanities, I'm proud to say that all my colleagues both Associate and Assistant Professors are always ready with passion to inspire hope among 
                      the students; they eagerly help the students to ignite their imagination, and instil love of learning. Our Associate and Assistant Professors set the tone of their 
                      classrooms-they build a warm environment, mentor and nurture the students.</p>

                      <p>Along with the professors, students are helped by amazing group of Mentors, and this will make the School of Humanities a second home for the graduating students.</p>


                      <p>Each Department in the School has academic associations and also non-academic associations which help the students in character formation and also career mapping.</p>

                      <p>Students who wish to join our School, rest assured we will support you in every step of your formation years of 3/ 4-year UG programme or 1/ 2 years of PG programme and 
                      also the Research programme. Your academic success and wellbeing are as important to us, as they are to you.</p>


                      <p>Opportunities provided in the School of Humanities, St Josephs University, Bengaluru, is more than a pathway to a Degree; it is a pathway to discover the purpose of life.</p>

                      <p><strong>Good wishes on your journey at the School of Humanities.</strong></p>

            <h4>Greetings and a warm welcome from the School of Humanities!</h4>
            <p>The School of Humanities, under St Joseph's University was created to provide learning spaces, with 7 departments and an associate department, the Department of Physical Education. 
            Of the 7 departments, 5 departments have antecedent of more than 140 years in contributing to the motto of the Institution 'Fide et Labore'- meaning faith and toil.</p>

            <p>As a stakeholder remotely or distantly you may be interested to know about School of Humanities and the Departments with the School. This message of mine provides you a glimpse 
            of how we instil passion for excellence that helps our students to create a better tomorrow.</p>

            <p>Do you know what inspiration, motivation, encouragement, and enthusiasm have in common? These are all without price tags, which are always provided at the School of Humanities 
            both within and beyond classroom and the result being the students who graduated from this School emerge as a different person â more mature, shaped and inspired.</p>

            <p>As the Dean, School of Humanities, I'm proud to say that all my colleagues both Associate and Assistant Professors are always ready with passion to inspire hope among the students; 
            they eagerly help the students to ignite their imagination, and instil love of learning. Our Associate and Assistant Professors set the tone of their classrooms-they build a warm 
            environment, mentor and nurture the students.</p>

            <p>Along with the professors, students are helped by amazing group of Mentors, and this will make the School of Humanities a second home for the graduating students.</p>

            <p>Each Department in the School has academic associations and also non-academic associations which help the students in character formation and also career mapping.</p>

            <p>Students who wish to join our School, rest assured we will support you in every step of your formation years of 3/ 4-year UG programme or 1/ 2 years of PG programme and also the 
            Research programme. Your academic success and wellbeing are as important to us, as they are to you.</p>

            <p>Opportunities provided in the School of Humanities, St Josephs University, Bengaluru, is more than a pathway to a Degree; it is a pathway to discover the purpose of life.</p>

            <p><strong>Good wishes on your journey at the School of Humanities.</strong></p>
        </div>

        <article id="about" class="dept-section department_tab">
           <div class="title-area"><h2 class="fw-bold text-blue mb-3">About</h2></div>
          <p>The Department was established in 2016 with the initiation of a 2-year postgraduate programme in Big Data Analytics. 
          In 2020, the Department introduced a 1-year postgraduate Diploma in Cyber Security in collaboration with HKCS Foundation 
          and an Undergraduate programme BCA(Data Analytics). In 2021, the Department introduced a 1-year postgraduate Diploma in Data Science.</p>

          <p>The MSc (Big Data Analytics) programme enjoys the support and patronage of Tata Consultancy Services Ltd.(TCS), and is built around a state-of-the-art 
          laboratory established with TCS. Professor Bimal Kumar Roy, the eminent academic and researcher, former Director of Indian Statistical Institute (ISI), 
          and Padma Shri awardee, is the guiding spirit and adviser of this program.</p>

          <p>The Department's lab, that can accommodate 60 students and work for extended hours, has a high-speed computing infrastructure to handle big data loads, 
          and a high-definition Cisco video conferencing facility for students and faculty to interact with industry experts, in academic and consulting roles.</p>

          <p>The Department's M.Sc.(Big Data Analytics) program has been an unqualified success; over 300 students have completed the program, and today work in India's 
          top IT establishments, including TCS, in a variety of professional roles undertaking complex projects and assignments in statistical modeling and inference, 
          Machine Learning, Deep Learning and AI.</p>
        </article>

                    <?php
                         $API_TOKEN='eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJhSWQiOiI0NTNlMzRjNWY1NDU5ZDMxNjg5OCIsImNJZCI6IjYyMDgiLCJvSWQiOiI1IiwiaWF0IjoxNzI0OTE1ODI2fQ.WSAp2aF6p0EiS0kjBzlSvE-1QcLnue8eEvYya0-r4ds';
                         $api_url = "https://sjuv4.linways.com/api/v1/exat2/forms/reports/KkAkaWwi5XkbQiiDs/ALL?departmentId=88";
 
                         $api_ch = curl_init();
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_URL, $api_url);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, ["Authorization: $API_TOKEN", "Accept: application/json"]);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, false);
                         $response_data = curl_exec($api_ch);
                         $response_data = json_decode($response_data, true);
                         curl_close($api_ch); 
                      ?>
                      
                    <div class="table-responsive">
                      <table class="table table-responsive table-bordered align-middle api_table">
                          <thead>
                              <tr>
                                  <th>Sl. no.</th>
                                  <th>Name of Research Scholar</th>
                                  <th>Date of Enrollment for Coursework at SJU</th>
                                  <th>Area of Research</th>
                                  <th>Title of the Thesis (Provisional)</th>
                                  <th>Supervisor Profile</th>
                                  <th>Status of the Thesis</th>
                              </tr>
                          </thead>
                          <tbody>
                          <?php
                          $cnt = 0;

                          if (!empty($response_data['data'])) {

                              // Sort date
                              usort($response_data['data'], function($a, $b) {
                              $dateA = strtotime($a['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');
                              $dateB = strtotime($b['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');

                              // First sort by date (latest first)
                              if ($dateA != $dateB) {
                                  return $dateB - $dateA;
                              }

                              // If dates are same, sort by name alphabetically
                              return strcmp(
                                  $a['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '',
                                  $b['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? ''
                              );
                            });

                              foreach ($response_data['data'] as $row) {
                                  $cnt++;
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo $cnt; ?></td>

        <article id="about" class="dept-section department_tab">
           <div class="title-area"><h2 class="fw-bold text-blue mb-3">About</h2></div>
          <p>The Department was founded in 1986, offering BSc in Computer Science along with Physics and Mathematics. Continuous programmes were developed and 
          administered, serving the needs of industrial computer scientists, researchers, and computer application specialists for whom the discipline of computing 
          sciences provides indispensable tools with newer programmes being added.</p>

          <p>The Department conducts a Board of Studies every year and offers the syllabus according to the Industry requirements and demands. BCA is an undergraduate 
          programme for candidates wishing to delve into the world of Computer Languages. Being one of the most popular options to get started with a career in Information 
          Technology, this programme gives you an insight into the world of computers and their applications.</p>

          <p>MSc Computer Science is a postgraduate programme provisioning to a group of candidates drawn to probe deeper into the realm of computer science. 
          It aims to prepare young professionals for challenging business opportunities in the IT sector.</p>

          <p>The Department also assists research scholars at various universities such as Bharathiar University, Sri KrishnaDevaraya University, and Mother Teresa University. 
          All faculty members have completed their MPhil and are on the verge of completing their PhD. Both members of the staff and students are actively involved in the research. 
          The students are required to prepare a term paper that is a culmination of a certain amount of research performed by the student on a topic of their choice as approved by 
          the Department. The student is guided continuously during the process by the teachers. All final-year students will have to develop and complete a project for an organisation 
          outside the College. The students need to have a deep awareness of the existing environment and produce workable solutions, ensuring that they have sufficient exposure and 
          preparedness for a challenging career in the field. The Department organises conferences, workshops, Intercollegiate IT fests, FDPs, Guest lectures, Expert talks, and Panel 
          discussions on new trends in computer science and Information technology.</p>
        </article>

                      <p><strong>The Vision of the Department is to ensure that our students have a deep and analytical understanding of the field and to enable them to use their 
                      immense potential to enhance the quality of human life by contributing to the field of Technology , preparing them for their Career in the Industry , 
                      and to the needs of the Society with Ethical responsibilities.</strong></p> 
                      <p class="dean-excerpt">The Department offers quality education in the Science of Computing by providing courses with Computer Applications, Courses 
                      in combination with Physical Science and Courses with Specialization and by focusing on the Personal, Emotional and Character development.</p>

                      <p class="dean-excerpt">The Department conducts a Board of Studies every year and offers the syllabus according to the Industry requirements and demands. 
                      BCA is a three-year undergraduate degree program for candidates wishing to delve into the world of Computer languages. Being one of the most popular options 
                      to get started with a career in Information Technology, this course gives you an insight into the world of computers and its applications. M.Sc. Computer Science 
                      is a two-year postgraduate program provisioning to the group of candidates drawn to probe deeper into the realm of computer science. It aims to prepare young 
                      professionals for challenging business opportunities in the IT sector. The Department also assists research scholars of various universities such as Bharathiar University, 
                      Sri KrishnaDevaraya University, and Mother Teresa University. The Department has 14 staff members. All faculty members have completed their MPhil and are on the verge of 
                      completing their P.hD. Both members of the staff and students are actively involved in the research. The students ought to prepare a term paper that is a culmination of a 
                      certain amount of research performed by the student on a topic of their choice as approved by the Department. The student is guided continuously during the process by the 
                      teachers. All final year students will have to develop and complete a project for an organization outside the College. The students need to have a deep awareness of the 
                      existing environment and produce workable solutions, ensuring that they have sufficient exposure and preparedness for a challenging career in the field. The Department 
                      organizes conferences, workshops, Intercollegiate IT fests, FDP's, Guest lectures, Expert talks, Panel discussion on new trends in computer science and Information technology.</p>

                      </p>

                    <?php
                         $API_TOKEN='eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJhSWQiOiI0NTNlMzRjNWY1NDU5ZDMxNjg5OCIsImNJZCI6IjYyMDgiLCJvSWQiOiI1IiwiaWF0IjoxNzI0OTE1ODI2fQ.WSAp2aF6p0EiS0kjBzlSvE-1QcLnue8eEvYya0-r4ds';
                         $api_url = "https://sjuv4.linways.com/api/v1/exat2/forms/reports/KkAkaWwi5XkbQiiDs/ALL?departmentId=54";
 
                         $api_ch = curl_init();
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_URL, $api_url);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, ["Authorization: $API_TOKEN", "Accept: application/json"]);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, false);
                         $response_data = curl_exec($api_ch);
                         $response_data = json_decode($response_data, true);
                         curl_close($api_ch); 
                      ?>
                      
                    <div class="table-responsive">
                      <table class="table table-responsive table-bordered align-middle api_table">
                          <thead>
                              <tr>
                                  <th>Sl. no.</th>
                                  <th>Name of Research Scholar</th>
                                  <th>Date of Enrollment for Coursework at SJU</th>
                                  <th>Area of Research</th>
                                  <th>Title of the Thesis (Provisional)</th>
                                  <th>Supervisor Profile</th>
                                  <th>Status of the Thesis</th>
                              </tr>
                          </thead>
                          <tbody>
                          <?php
                          $cnt = 0;

                          if (!empty($response_data['data'])) {

                              // Sort date
                              usort($response_data['data'], function($a, $b) {
                              $dateA = strtotime($a['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');
                              $dateB = strtotime($b['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');

                              // First sort by date (latest first)
                              if ($dateA != $dateB) {
                                  return $dateB - $dateA;
                              }

                              // If dates are same, sort by name alphabetically
                              return strcmp(
                                  $a['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '',
                                  $b['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? ''
                              );
                            });

                              foreach ($response_data['data'] as $row) {
                                  $cnt++;
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo $cnt; ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Area of Research'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Title of the Thesis (Provisional)'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top">
                                  <?php if (!empty($row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor'])) { ?>
                                      <a class="fw-semibold text-primary text-decoration-none"
                                         href="<?php echo $row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor']; ?>"
                                         target="_blank">
                                         View Profile
                                      </a>
                                  <?php } ?>
                              </td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Status of the Thesis'] ?? '') ?></td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                              }

                          } else {
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td colspan="7" class="text-center fw-semibold py-4">
                                  No records found
                              </td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                          }
                          ?>
                       </tbody>
                    </table>
                  </div>

    <div class="container">
       <div class="p-4 p-md-4 bg-white rounded-4 shadow-sm border">
        <p>“Coming together is a beginning. Keeping together is progress. Working together is success.”- Henry Ford.</p>
        <p>TECHNOPHITE is an association founded by the Department of Computer Science (PG). It comprises of a team of 
        passionate and organized youth who are interested in expanding their knowledge as well as their skills. The objective 
        of the Technophite association is to widen the perspectives of Josephite's and to provide a platform for students to 
        discuss, share and update their knowledge in various domains of information technology thereby encouraging them to 
        undertake a multitude of curricular as well as extracurricular activities.</p>
        </p>
     </div>
   </div>

    <div class="container title-area pb-2">

                    <div class="info-card vision-card w-100">
                        <h4>Vision</h4>
                       <p>To actively organize and engage in various events that will update the students of 
                       the college with the plethora of technological advancements that transpire in ways that are fun and rewarding.</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="col-lg-6 d-flex">
                    <div class="info-card vision-card w-100">
                        <h4>Mission</h4>
                       <p>To engage and connect the postgraduate computer science students of our college and the ones across 
                       institutions all over India by active participation with in this community and to attend events, to volunteer ,to learn ,to grow and to contribute to the greatness of our institution.</p>
                    </div>
                </div>

              <ol>
                  <li class="pb-3"><strong>Inter collegiate fest :</strong> An inter-collegiate fest “SYNTAXIA” is organized by the first and second year post graduate students. The fest included both on-stage 
                  as well as off-stage events that helped students to showcase their skills and their talents.</li>

                  <li class="pb-3"><strong>National Level Quiz :</strong> “Fact & Furious”, a National Level Quiz is held every year. The association receives an overwhelming response of over atleast 50 to 100 
                  teams from colleges all over the country.</li>

                  <li class="pb-3"><strong>Workshops and Seminars : </strong>Various workshops were conducted by the association to provide students with the current industrial insights and hands on experience.</li>

                  <li class="pb-3"><strong>Technical communities :</strong> Technical communities provide a platform for the students to discuss, share and update their knowledge in various domains of information technology.</li>

                  <li class="pb-3"><strong>Social outreach programmes :</strong> This programme provides the students an opportunity to recognize their social responsibility to give back and contribute to 
                  the development of the society.</li>

                  <li class="pb-3"><strong>Future Events : </strong>The association plans on conducting future technical and non technical events such as alumni sessions, workshops, guest lectures, gaming events etc.<br>
                  As a whole, Technophite is a gateway that allows the students to expand their horizons by enhancing their skills and providing vast opportunities.</li>
              </ol>

         <p><strong>The Vision of the Department is to ensure that our students have a deep and analytical understanding of the field and to enable them to use their 
        immense potential to enhance the quality of human life by contributing to the field of Technology , preparing them for their Career in the Industry , 
        and to the needs of the Society with Ethical responsibilities.</strong></p> 
        <p class="dean-excerpt">The Department offers quality education in the Science of Computing by providing courses with Computer Applications, Courses 
        in combination with Physical Science and Courses with Specialization and by focusing on the Personal, Emotional and Character development.</p>

        <p class="dean-excerpt">The Department conducts a Board of Studies every year and offers the syllabus according to the Industry requirements and demands. 
        BCA is a three-year undergraduate degree program for candidates wishing to delve into the world of Computer languages. Being one of the most popular options 
        to get started with a career in Information Technology, this course gives you an insight into the world of computers and its applications. M.Sc. Computer Science 
        is a two-year postgraduate program provisioning to the group of candidates drawn to probe deeper into the realm of computer science. It aims to prepare young 
        professionals for challenging business opportunities in the IT sector. The Department also assists research scholars of various universities such as Bharathiar University, 
        Sri KrishnaDevaraya University, and Mother Teresa University. The Department has 14 staff members. All faculty members have completed their MPhil and are on the verge of 
        completing their P.hD. Both members of the staff and students are actively involved in the research. The students ought to prepare a term paper that is a culmination of a 
        certain amount of research performed by the student on a topic of their choice as approved by the Department. The student is guided continuously during the process by the 
        teachers. All final year students will have to develop and complete a project for an organization outside the College. The students need to have a deep awareness of the 
        existing environment and produce workable solutions, ensuring that they have sufficient exposure and preparedness for a challenging career in the field. The Department 
        organizes conferences, workshops, Intercollegiate IT fests, FDP's, Guest lectures, Expert talks, Panel discussion on new trends in computer science and Information technology.</p>

        <article id="about" class="dept-section department_tab">
           <div class="title-area"><h2 class="fw-bold text-blue mb-3">About</h2></div>
          <p>The Department of English was established in 1882, and is thus one of the oldest departments in the University. It has been home to stalwarts like Professors 
          TRH Peck,  PK Venkata Rao, T Balasubramaniam, Fr. Julian Fernandez SJ,  Fr. Devasagayam SJ, PS Balasubramaniam, Fr. Hedwig Da Costa SJ , Barbra Naidu, Cheriyan Alexander, 
          John Zachariah, and Etienne Rassendren.</p>

          <p>The Department has over the years conceived many innovations in English teaching and was the first to adopt and explore the certificate course model in the 1990s. 
          The streamed syllabus approach was introduced in 2005 to ensure that students from diverse backgrounds found inspiration to improve their language skills. 
          A âlived experience' model is employed for General English, based on a lively interrogation of context and social relationships through reading and writing. 
          Additional English has been offered since 1998 for the benefit of students unable to pursue an Indian language.</p>

          <p>In 2005, St. Josephs College (Autonomous)  began offering an MA in English. In 2013, the EJP (English, Journalism, Psychology) programme was started 
          and the Department began offering Optional English whilst also collaborating on a unique inter-disciplinary approach to Journalism. A Communicative English 
          programme was introduced through the BA-CPE programme from 2016 onward. Bangalore University recognised the Department as a Research Centre offering Ph.D 
          programmes in 2018. The Department opened another interdisciplinary collaboration in Journalism for the BA-JIP programme in 2019, with a new focus on the 
          ethical practice of journalism in the global context. In 2020, despite the many disruptions of the pandemic, the Department began an multi-disciplinary 
          Theatre & Performance Studies course as part of the BA-TEP programme. The existing three-major BAs have resolved into two-major programmes following the 
          adoption of NEP in Karnataka in 2021.</p>

          <p>The student-centred focus of the Department's work is visible in the five associations it runsâThe Literary Society, The Quiz Club, The Performing Arts 
          Society, Nous and The Linguistics Society. Each Association runs a flagship festival: Meta by the Literary Society, Upstage by Performing Arts, Blue Pencil by 
          Nous, Tie Grab by the Quiz Club, and Some-Antics by the Linguistics Society. Apart from festivals, these associations run workshops, guest lectures, screenings 
          and a social justice film festival, and other regular intramural activities. The Department also runs an alumni networking service titled JEAN, or Joseph's English Alumni Network.</p>

          <p>The Department brings out an occasional newsletter titled EngCompass, and two print magazines devoted to student writing titled EngSter and SoupÃ§on. 
          It runs a website for student journalism titled Open Dosa and also maintains the Rohith Vemula Archive for documenting the educational and social experiences 
          of students from underprivileged communities.</p>

          <p>The Department has held a national conference devoted to new textualities titled Writing Worlds, Worlds Writing since 2020.</p>
        </article>

                <div class="data-card">
                    <?php
                         $API_TOKEN='eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJhSWQiOiI0NTNlMzRjNWY1NDU5ZDMxNjg5OCIsImNJZCI6IjYyMDgiLCJvSWQiOiI1IiwiaWF0IjoxNzI0OTE1ODI2fQ.WSAp2aF6p0EiS0kjBzlSvE-1QcLnue8eEvYya0-r4ds';
                         $api_url = "https://sjuv4.linways.com/api/v1/exat2/forms/reports/KkAkaWwi5XkbQiiDs/ALL?departmentId=55";
 
                         $api_ch = curl_init();
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_URL, $api_url);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, ["Authorization: $API_TOKEN", "Accept: application/json"]);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, false);
                         $response_data = curl_exec($api_ch);
                         $response_data = json_decode($response_data, true);
                         curl_close($api_ch); 
                      ?>
                      
                    <div class="table-responsive">
                      <table class="table table-responsive table-bordered align-middle api_table">
                          <thead>
                              <tr>
                                  <th>Sl. no.</th>
                                  <th>Name of Research Scholar</th>
                                  <th>Date of Enrollment for Coursework at SJU</th>
                                  <th>Area of Research</th>
                                  <th>Title of the Thesis (Provisional)</th>
                                  <th>Supervisor Profile</th>
                                  <th>Status of the Thesis</th>
                              </tr>
                          </thead>
                          <tbody>
                          <?php
                          $cnt = 0;

                          if (!empty($response_data['data'])) {

                              // Sort date
                              usort($response_data['data'], function($a, $b) {
                              $dateA = strtotime($a['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');
                              $dateB = strtotime($b['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');

                              // First sort by date (latest first)
                              if ($dateA != $dateB) {
                                  return $dateB - $dateA;
                              }

                              // If dates are same, sort by name alphabetically
                              return strcmp(
                                  $a['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '',
                                  $b['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? ''
                              );
                            });

                              foreach ($response_data['data'] as $row) {
                                  $cnt++;
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo $cnt; ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Area of Research'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Title of the Thesis (Provisional)'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top">
                                  <?php if (!empty($row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor'])) { ?>
                                      <a class="fw-semibold text-primary text-decoration-none"
                                         href="<?php echo $row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor']; ?>"
                                         target="_blank">
                                         View Profile
                                      </a>
                                  <?php } ?>
                              </td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Status of the Thesis'] ?? '') ?></td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                              }

                          } else {
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td colspan="7" class="text-center fw-semibold py-4">
                                  No records found
                              </td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                          }
                          ?>
                       </tbody>
                    </table>

                    on the Sumana social media handles, posting new educational content every week. Some of the events scheduled are workshops on child psychology, 
                    clinical psychology and hypnotherapy. The team looks forward to organizing many more events and continuing to provide a platform for students to 
                    be able to interact with professionals from diverse fields of psychology and grow their understanding of the subject.</p>

           <div class="title-area"><h2 class="fw-bold text-blue mb-3">About</h2></div>
          <p>The Department of French, established in 1882 by the Jesuits (originally from France) has been offering French as a second language option to undergraduate students 
          right from the start. Since 2012, French has been offered at the beginner level (A1- I and II semesters) and at the intermediate levels (A2 â III and IV semesters) 
          corresponding with the FLE (French as Foreign Language) syllabus framed under the guidelines of âCommon European Framework of Reference' for languages (CEFR).</p>

          <p>For students interested in exploring a different culture, the French language is the ideal choice as it helps them not only learn a new language but also get a 
          glimpse of French music, literature, cuisine, and cinema. The objective of the Department is to help students to understand basic information, questions about 
          shopping/immediate environment and successfully communicate about simple tasks, familiar topics, and matters of immediate need. On completing four semesters, 
          students traveling to a Francophone country for higher studies or professional purposes will be able to cope with basic repetitive tasks like navigating a menu 
          in a restaurant, booking a hotel, writing a short e-mail, filling out application forms, etc.</p> 
        </article>

              <div class="col-lg-12 col-md-12 col-sm-12 data-item" data-category="phd-scholars">
                <div class="data-card">
                    <?php
                         $API_TOKEN='eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJhSWQiOiI0NTNlMzRjNWY1NDU5ZDMxNjg5OCIsImNJZCI6IjYyMDgiLCJvSWQiOiI1IiwiaWF0IjoxNzI0OTE1ODI2fQ.WSAp2aF6p0EiS0kjBzlSvE-1QcLnue8eEvYya0-r4ds';
                         $api_url = "https://sjuv4.linways.com/api/v1/exat2/forms/reports/KkAkaWwi5XkbQiiDs/ALL?departmentId=103";
 
                         $api_ch = curl_init();
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_URL, $api_url);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, ["Authorization: $API_TOKEN", "Accept: application/json"]);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, false);
                         $response_data = curl_exec($api_ch);
                         $response_data = json_decode($response_data, true);
                         curl_close($api_ch); 
                      ?>
                      
                    <div class="table-responsive">
                      <table class="table table-responsive table-bordered align-middle api_table">
                          <thead>
                              <tr>
                                  <th>Sl. no.</th>
                                  <th>Name of Research Scholar</th>
                                  <th>Date of Enrollment for Coursework at SJU</th>
                                  <th>Area of Research</th>
                                  <th>Title of the Thesis (Provisional)</th>
                                  <th>Supervisor Profile</th>
                                  <th>Status of the Thesis</th>
                              </tr>
                          </thead>
                          <tbody>
                          <?php
                          $cnt = 0;

                          if (!empty($response_data['data'])) {

                              // Sort date
                              usort($response_data['data'], function($a, $b) {
                              $dateA = strtotime($a['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');
                              $dateB = strtotime($b['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');

                              // First sort by date (latest first)
                              if ($dateA != $dateB) {
                                  return $dateB - $dateA;
                              }

                              // If dates are same, sort by name alphabetically
                              return strcmp(
                                  $a['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '',
                                  $b['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? ''
                              );
                            });

                              foreach ($response_data['data'] as $row) {
                                  $cnt++;
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo $cnt; ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Area of Research'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Title of the Thesis (Provisional)'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top">
                                  <?php if (!empty($row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor'])) { ?>
                                      <a class="fw-semibold text-primary text-decoration-none"
                                         href="<?php echo $row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor']; ?>"
                                         target="_blank">
                                         View Profile
                                      </a>
                                  <?php } ?>
                              </td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Status of the Thesis'] ?? '') ?></td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                              }

                          } else {
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td colspan="7" class="text-center fw-semibold py-4">
                                  No records found
                              </td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                          }
                          ?>
                       </tbody>
                    </table>

        <article id="about" class="dept-section department_tab">
           <div class="title-area"><h2 class="fw-bold text-blue mb-3">About</h2></div>
          <p>The Department of Hindi of St Joseph's University, Bengaluru, is one of the oldest and leading Departments in South India. 
          It was started in the year 1951. At present, the Department offers Hindi as a second language paper for BA, BSc, BCom, BBA & BCA students. 
          Keeping in view, the present challenges, both at the national and global levels the Undergraduate programme is designed to give a more 
          inclusive and expansive approach to Hindi literature and functional aspects of the Hindi language.</p>

          <p>The Hindi Parishad is a cultural association, which was started in the year 1951. The college had become autonomous in the year of 
          2006 and it also became co-educative. The strength of the Hindi students had increased by leaps and bounds. The present strength of the 
          students is 1200. The department is looking to provide a syllabus that is relevant and job oriented while at the same time making the students 
          feel at ease. Also, the department has organised state-level, national-level seminars, webinars, and workshops to promote the Hindi language among the students.</p>

          <p>The faculties who have given their great contribution to the progress of the Department of Hindi are Shri V. Krishna Murthy Iyengar (1951-1968), 
          Mr. Amar Chand Verma (1968-1998), Dr. Parmanand Gupta (1976-1994),  Dr. Fariyal Shaikh(1989-2018),  Dr. Sajida Ahmed (1994-2000, 2018-2022), 
          Mr. Nagarajan. E. M (1995-2018), Dr. Pathan Hasan (2016 onwards).</p>

           
        </article>

                     <?php
                         $API_TOKEN='eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJhSWQiOiI0NTNlMzRjNWY1NDU5ZDMxNjg5OCIsImNJZCI6IjYyMDgiLCJvSWQiOiI1IiwiaWF0IjoxNzI0OTE1ODI2fQ.WSAp2aF6p0EiS0kjBzlSvE-1QcLnue8eEvYya0-r4ds';
                         $api_url = "https://sjuv4.linways.com/api/v1/exat2/forms/reports/KkAkaWwi5XkbQiiDs/ALL?departmentId=103";
 
                         $api_ch = curl_init();
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_URL, $api_url);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, ["Authorization: $API_TOKEN", "Accept: application/json"]);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, false);
                         $response_data = curl_exec($api_ch);
                         $response_data = json_decode($response_data, true);
                         curl_close($api_ch); 
                      ?>
                      
                    <div class="table-responsive">
                      <table class="table table-responsive table-bordered align-middle api_table">
                          <thead>
                              <tr>
                                  <th>Sl. no.</th>
                                  <th>Name of Research Scholar</th>
                                  <th>Date of Enrollment for Coursework at SJU</th>
                                  <th>Area of Research</th>
                                  <th>Title of the Thesis (Provisional)</th>
                                  <th>Supervisor Profile</th>
                                  <th>Status of the Thesis</th>
                              </tr>
                          </thead>
                          <tbody>
                          <?php
                          $cnt = 0;

                          if (!empty($response_data['data'])) {

                              // Sort date
                              usort($response_data['data'], function($a, $b) {
                              $dateA = strtotime($a['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');
                              $dateB = strtotime($b['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');

                              // First sort by date (latest first)
                              if ($dateA != $dateB) {
                                  return $dateB - $dateA;
                              }

                              // If dates are same, sort by name alphabetically
                              return strcmp(
                                  $a['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '',
                                  $b['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? ''
                              );
                            });

                              foreach ($response_data['data'] as $row) {
                                  $cnt++;
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo $cnt; ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Area of Research'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Title of the Thesis (Provisional)'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top">
                                  <?php if (!empty($row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor'])) { ?>
                                      <a class="fw-semibold text-primary text-decoration-none"
                                         href="<?php echo $row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor']; ?>"
                                         target="_blank">
                                         View Profile
                                      </a>
                                  <?php } ?>
                              </td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Status of the Thesis'] ?? '') ?></td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                              }

                          } else {
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td colspan="7" class="text-center fw-semibold py-4">
                                  No records found
                              </td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                          }
                          ?>
                       </tbody>
                    </table>
                  </div>

        <!--<article id="about" class="dept-section department_tab">
           <div class="title-area"><h2 class="fw-bold text-blue mb-3">About</h2></div>
          <p>The Department of English was established in 1882, and is thus one of the oldest departments in the University. It has been home to stalwarts like Professors 
          TRH Peck,  PK Venkata Rao, T Balasubramaniam, Fr. Julian Fernandez SJ,  Fr. Devasagayam SJ, PS Balasubramaniam, Fr. Hedwig Da Costa SJ , Barbra Naidu, Cheriyan Alexander, 
          John Zachariah, and Etienne Rassendren.</p>

          <p>The Department has over the years conceived many innovations in English teaching and was the first to adopt and explore the certificate course model in the 1990s. 
          The streamed syllabus approach was introduced in 2005 to ensure that students from diverse backgrounds found inspiration to improve their language skills. 
          A âlived experience' model is employed for General English, based on a lively interrogation of context and social relationships through reading and writing. 
          Additional English has been offered since 1998 for the benefit of students unable to pursue an Indian language.</p>

          <p>In 2005, St. Josephs College (Autonomous)  began offering an MA in English. In 2013, the EJP (English, Journalism, Psychology) programme was started 
          and the Department began offering Optional English whilst also collaborating on a unique inter-disciplinary approach to Journalism. A Communicative English 
          programme was introduced through the BA-CPE programme from 2016 onward. Bangalore University recognised the Department as a Research Centre offering Ph.D 
          programmes in 2018. The Department opened another interdisciplinary collaboration in Journalism for the BA-JIP programme in 2019, with a new focus on the 
          ethical practice of journalism in the global context. In 2020, despite the many disruptions of the pandemic, the Department began an multi-disciplinary 
          Theatre & Performance Studies course as part of the BA-TEP programme. The existing three-major BAs have resolved into two-major programmes following the 
          adoption of NEP in Karnataka in 2021.</p>

          <p>The student-centred focus of the Department's work is visible in the five associations it runsâThe Literary Society, The Quiz Club, The Performing Arts 
          Society, Nous and The Linguistics Society. Each Association runs a flagship festival: Meta by the Literary Society, Upstage by Performing Arts, Blue Pencil by 
          Nous, Tie Grab by the Quiz Club, and Some-Antics by the Linguistics Society. Apart from festivals, these associations run workshops, guest lectures, screenings 
          and a social justice film festival, and other regular intramural activities. The Department also runs an alumni networking service titled JEAN, or Joseph's English Alumni Network.</p>

          <p>The Department brings out an occasional newsletter titled EngCompass, and two print magazines devoted to student writing titled EngSter and SoupÃ§on. 
          It runs a website for student journalism titled Open Dosa and also maintains the Rohith Vemula Archive for documenting the educational and social experiences 
          of students from underprivileged communities.</p>

          <p>The Department has held a national conference devoted to new textualities titled Writing Worlds, Worlds Writing since 2020.</p>
        </article>-->

                         $api_url = "https://sjuv4.linways.com/api/v1/exat2/forms/reports/KkAkaWwi5XkbQiiDs/ALL?departmentId=129";
 
                         $api_ch = curl_init();
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_URL, $api_url);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, ["Authorization: $API_TOKEN", "Accept: application/json"]);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, false);

                          <?php
                          $cnt = 0;

                          if (!empty($response_data['data'])) {

                              // Sort date
                              usort($response_data['data'], function($a, $b) {
                              $dateA = strtotime($a['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');
                              $dateB = strtotime($b['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');

                              // First sort by date (latest first)
                              if ($dateA != $dateB) {
                                  return $dateB - $dateA;
                              }

                              // If dates are same, sort by name alphabetically
                              return strcmp(
                                  $a['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '',
                                  $b['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? ''
                              );
                            });

                              foreach ($response_data['data'] as $row) {
                                  $cnt++;
                          ?>

                                         target="_blank">

                                      </a>

                              </td>

                <div class="data-card">
                   <?php
                         $API_TOKEN='eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJhSWQiOiI0NTNlMzRjNWY1NDU5ZDMxNjg5OCIsImNJZCI6IjYyMDgiLCJvSWQiOiI1IiwiaWF0IjoxNzI0OTE1ODI2fQ.WSAp2aF6p0EiS0kjBzlSvE-1QcLnue8eEvYya0-r4ds';
                         $api_url = "https://sjuv4.linways.com/api/v1/exat2/forms/reports/KkAkaWwi5XkbQiiDs/ALL?departmentId=103";
 
                         $api_ch = curl_init();
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_URL, $api_url);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, ["Authorization: $API_TOKEN", "Accept: application/json"]);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, false);
                         $response_data = curl_exec($api_ch);
                         $response_data = json_decode($response_data, true);
                         curl_close($api_ch); 
                      ?>
                      
                    <div class="table-responsive">
                      <table class="table table-responsive table-bordered align-middle api_table">
                          <thead>
                              <tr>
                                  <th>Sl. no.</th>
                                  <th>Name of Research Scholar</th>
                                  <th>Date of Enrollment for Coursework at SJU</th>
                                  <th>Area of Research</th>
                                  <th>Title of the Thesis (Provisional)</th>
                                  <th>Supervisor Profile</th>
                                  <th>Status of the Thesis</th>
                              </tr>
                          </thead>
                          <tbody>
                          <?php
                          $cnt = 0;

                          if (!empty($response_data['data'])) {

                              // Sort date
                              usort($response_data['data'], function($a, $b) {
                              $dateA = strtotime($a['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');
                              $dateB = strtotime($b['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');

                              // First sort by date (latest first)
                              if ($dateA != $dateB) {
                                  return $dateB - $dateA;
                              }

                              // If dates are same, sort by name alphabetically
                              return strcmp(
                                  $a['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '',
                                  $b['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? ''
                              );
                            });

                              foreach ($response_data['data'] as $row) {
                                  $cnt++;
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo $cnt; ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Area of Research'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Title of the Thesis (Provisional)'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top">
                                  <?php if (!empty($row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor'])) { ?>
                                      <a class="fw-semibold text-primary text-decoration-none"
                                         href="<?php echo $row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor']; ?>"
                                         target="_blank">
                                         View Profile
                                      </a>
                                  <?php } ?>
                              </td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Status of the Thesis'] ?? '') ?></td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                              }

                          } else {
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td colspan="7" class="text-center fw-semibold py-4">
                                  No records found
                              </td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                          }
                          ?>
                       </tbody>
                    </table>
                  </div>
                 </div>

        <article id="about" class="dept-section department_tab">
           <div class="title-area"><h2 class="fw-bold text-blue mb-3">About</h2></div>
          <p>Sanskrit as a language competed with numerous, less exact vernacular Indian languages called Prakritic languages . 
          The term prakrta literally means "original, natural, normal, artless", states Franklin Southworth. The relationship between 
          Prakrit and Sanskrit is found in Indian texts dated to the 1st millennium CE. PataÃ±jali acknowledged that Prakrit is the first 
          language, one instinctively adopted by every child with all its imperfections and later leads to the problems of interpretation 
          and misunderstanding. The purifying structure of the Sanskrit language removes these imperfections.</p>

          <p>The Department has held a national conference devoted to new textualities titled Writing Worlds, Worlds Writing since 2020.</p>
        </article>

        <article id="dean-message" class="dept-section department_tab mt-5 mb-5">
           <div class="dean-message-section py-5 container-fluid">
               <!-- Section Title -->
               <div class="mb-5">
                 <h2 class="fw-bold text_blue mb-1">Message from the <span class="fw-bold text-warning mb-3">Dean</span></h2>
               </div>
               <div class="row">
                 <!-- Image Column -->
                 <div class="col-lg-4 mb-3 dean_col">
                   <div class="dean-image-wrap">
                     <img src="https://sjub.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/language%20and%20Lit/English/Dr_Arul_Mani.webp" alt="school-of-languages-and-literatures" class="img-fluid dean-img" loading="lazy" />
                   </div>
                   <h4 class="dean-name mt-3">Dr Arul Mani</h4>
                   <a href="mailto:arul.mani@sju.edu.in" class="dean-email">arul.mani@sju.edu.in</a>
                 </div>
                 <!-- Content Column -->
                 <div class="col-lg-8">

                <div class="row g-4 mt-2">
              <div class="col-lg-12 col-md-12 col-sm-12 data-item" data-category="phd-scholars">
                <div class="data-card">
                    <?php
                         $API_TOKEN='eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJhSWQiOiI0NTNlMzRjNWY1NDU5ZDMxNjg5OCIsImNJZCI6IjYyMDgiLCJvSWQiOiI1IiwiaWF0IjoxNzI0OTE1ODI2fQ.WSAp2aF6p0EiS0kjBzlSvE-1QcLnue8eEvYya0-r4ds';
                         $api_url = "https://sjuv4.linways.com/api/v1/exat2/forms/reports/KkAkaWwi5XkbQiiDs/ALL?departmentId=103";
 
                         $api_ch = curl_init();
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_URL, $api_url);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, ["Authorization: $API_TOKEN", "Accept: application/json"]);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, false);
                         $response_data = curl_exec($api_ch);
                         $response_data = json_decode($response_data, true);
                         curl_close($api_ch); 
                      ?>
                      
                    <div class="table-responsive">
                      <table class="table table-responsive table-bordered align-middle api_table">
                          <thead>
                              <tr>
                                  <th>Sl. no.</th>
                                  <th>Name of Research Scholar</th>
                                  <th>Date of Enrollment for Coursework at SJU</th>
                                  <th>Area of Research</th>
                                  <th>Title of the Thesis (Provisional)</th>
                                  <th>Supervisor Profile</th>
                                  <th>Status of the Thesis</th>
                              </tr>
                          </thead>
                          <tbody>
                          <?php
                          $cnt = 0;

                          if (!empty($response_data['data'])) {

                              // Sort date
                              usort($response_data['data'], function($a, $b) {
                              $dateA = strtotime($a['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');
                              $dateB = strtotime($b['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');

                              // First sort by date (latest first)
                              if ($dateA != $dateB) {
                                  return $dateB - $dateA;
                              }

                              // If dates are same, sort by name alphabetically
                              return strcmp(
                                  $a['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '',
                                  $b['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? ''
                              );
                            });

                              foreach ($response_data['data'] as $row) {
                                  $cnt++;
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo $cnt; ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Area of Research'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Title of the Thesis (Provisional)'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top">
                                  <?php if (!empty($row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor'])) { ?>
                                      <a class="fw-semibold text-primary text-decoration-none"
                                         href="<?php echo $row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor']; ?>"
                                         target="_blank">
                                         View Profile
                                      </a>
                                  <?php } ?>
                              </td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Status of the Thesis'] ?? '') ?></td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                              }

                          } else {
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td colspan="7" class="text-center fw-semibold py-4">
                                  No records found
                              </td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                          }
                          ?>
                       </tbody>
                    </table>
                  </div>
                 </div>

        <p>Samskruta Tarangini is the Sanskrit Association of St. Joseph's College. The association is led by Prof. Prasanna SB, HOD, Department of Sanskrit, 
         St.Joseph's College. Sanskrit is one of the ancient and oldest languages if not the oldest. The significance of Sanskrit in Indian mythology, 
         its religious and spiritual heritage, and its history cannot be overstated. The association's goal is to spread this knowledge in the best way possible.</p>

        The association also has a book sharing programme where members can share books and discuss about them with others. The association organises both intra 
        and inter collegiate fests with events like Riddles, Dance, Quiz, Anthyakshari, Singing, Pictionary and Kantha Paatha (Recitation); all related to Sanskrit. 
        The association has many more exciting programmes planned! So STAY TUNED!</p>

        <article id="about" class="dept-section department_tab">
           <div class="title-area"><h2 class="fw-bold text-blue mb-3">About</h2></div>
          <p>Tamil is a classical language. Being a part of the Tamil department, our responsibility is to impart this to our students in an effective manner. 
          Therefore, the syllabus is designed in such a way as to include all types of literature in Tamil. Moreover, the Tamil department focuses on developing 
          attributes such as learning ability, analysing, and creativity in their students.</p>
          <p>We have an association exclusive for Tamil enthusiasts called âTamil Sangamâ. Every year through Tamil Sangam inter-collegiate competitions, cultural programs, 
          the Pongal festival, and such other activities are conducted. In the years to come, the Tamil department can assure that it will excel in all aspects.</p>

          <p>The Department has held a national conference devoted to new textualities titled Writing Worlds, Worlds Writing since 2020.</p>
        </article>

                              $dateA = strtotime($a['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');
                              $dateB = strtotime($b['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');

                              // First sort by date (latest first)
                              if ($dateA != $dateB) {
                                  return $dateB - $dateA;
                              }

                              // If dates are same, sort by name alphabetically
                              return strcmp(
                                  $a['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '',
                                  $b['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? ''

        <article id="about" class="dept-section department_tab">
           <div class="title-area"><h2 class="fw-bold text-blue mb-3">About</h2>
           </div>
          <p>The Department of Biology is a brand new Department formed on 21 May 2024 under the School of Life Sciences. Programmes in Biology were introduced in 2022 with the implementation of NEP but the Department itself was constituted in 2024. The Department comprises PhD qualified faculty members with expertise in both Botany and Zoology.</p>
<p>
The proposal to form the Department was put forward in November 2023 considering that Biology is at the heart of some of the biggest challenges facing humanity and our planet. From improving human health to tackling climate change, and enhancing agriculture to conserving the environment, biologists play an important role. Biology, being the science of all life and a vast eclectic science, was also found to be a necessary course due to its interdisciplinary nature. A major in Biology combines courses from Botany and Zoology to provide a strong foundation in biological principles with the flexibility to explore a variety of topics.</p>
        </article>

                 </div>
                 <!-- Content Column -->
                 <div class="col-lg-8">
                  
                   <p class="dean-excerpt">
                     At the School of Life Sciences, St Joseph's University, we believe in the power of asking questions. Questions that stem from observing and pondering about the world around us, questions about biomolecules and ecosystems, questions that continue to nurture curiosity, imagination, and a spirit of exploration.

Our mission is to spark a lasting interest and joy in learning, discovery and research, while equipping students with the skills and confidence to excel in academia, industry, and society. We strive to create an environment that is intellectually engaging, collaborative, and supportive - one that helps every student to continue asking interesting questions, and forge meaningful paths.
                   </p>
                   <button class="btn btn-readmore" data-bs-toggle="modal" data-bs-target="#deanMessageModal" >
                     Read more â'
                   </button>

             <div class="modal fade" id="deanMessageModal" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="deanMessageLabel" aria-hidden="true">
               <div class="modal-dialog modal-dialog-centered modal-lg modal-dialog-scrollable">
                 <div class="modal-content">
                   <div class="modal-header">
                     <h5 class="modal-title" id="deanMessageLabel">
                       Message from the Dean
                     </h5>
                     <button type="button"  class="custom-close" data-bs-dismiss="modal"  aria-label="Close" >
                        <svg width="25" height="25" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" >
                          <line x1="18" y1="6" x2="6" y2="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/>
                          <line x1="6" y1="6" x2="18" y2="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/>
                        </svg>
                     </button>
                   </div>
                   <div class="modal-body dean-modal-content">
                     
                     <p>At the School of Life Sciences, St Joseph's University, we believe in the power of asking questions. Questions that stem from observing and pondering about the world around us, questions about biomolecules and ecosystems, questions that continue to nurture curiosity, imagination, and a spirit of exploration.</p>

 <p>Our mission is to spark a lasting interest and joy in learning, discovery and research, while equipping students with the skills and confidence to excel in academia, industry, and society. We strive to create an environment that is intellectually engaging, collaborative, and supportive - one that helps every student to continue asking interesting questions, and forge meaningful paths.</p>

 <p>The School of Life Sciences is an interdisciplinary centre focusing on fundamental biology and applied fields. It comprises the Departments of Botany, Zoology, Environmental Science, Microbiology, Biotechnology, Food Science and Technology, and Biology. The School offers highly ranked graduate and postgraduate programs deeply rooted in scientific and rational pedagogical approaches.</p>

 <p>Learning at the School of Life Sciences extends far beyond classroom lectures and textbooks. Our faculty are trained in research-based pedagogical approaches, and ensure that the learning experience is holistic and relevant. Our programs are designed with a strong emphasis on experiential learning: hands-on practical training, interactive lectures, field-based learning, research-driven projects, regular expert lectures and workshops, and visits to academic and industry labs. Our students participate in International and national level programs like the prestigious DBT-Khorana Program, the Science Academies' Summer Fellowship program, and other fellowships and programs offered by premier research institutions in the country. Combined with the experience gained in our laboratories, these opportunities ensure our graduates are well-prepared to meet the demands of both professional and academic careers.
</p>
 <p>The School also harbours a vibrant research community-from undergraduate through graduate levels- dedicated to fundamental and socially relevant research in life sciences. Our alumni are placed in significant positions in the industry and academia, and make impactful contributions in various spheres, while also sustaining engagement with our programs at the School of Life Sciences.</p>
                     <p>
                       <strong>More on what is happening at the School of Life Sciences, SJU can be found here: <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/school-of-life-sciences-2a5928377/">School of Life Sciences | LinkedIn</a></strong>
                     </p>
                     <p class="mt-4">
                       <span class=" text_blue fw-bold">â Dr Susan Mary Philip</span><br>
                       <span class="text-warning mb-3"></span>
                     </p>

                <div class="data-card">
                    <?php
                         $API_TOKEN='eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJhSWQiOiI0NTNlMzRjNWY1NDU5ZDMxNjg5OCIsImNJZCI6IjYyMDgiLCJvSWQiOiI1IiwiaWF0IjoxNzI0OTE1ODI2fQ.WSAp2aF6p0EiS0kjBzlSvE-1QcLnue8eEvYya0-r4ds';
                         $api_url = "https://sjuv4.linways.com/api/v1/exat2/forms/reports/KkAkaWwi5XkbQiiDs/ALL?departmentId=127";
 
                         $api_ch = curl_init();
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_URL, $api_url);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, ["Authorization: $API_TOKEN", "Accept: application/json"]);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, false);
                         $response_data = curl_exec($api_ch);
                         $response_data = json_decode($response_data, true);
                         curl_close($api_ch); 
                      ?>
                      
                    <div class="table-responsive">
                      <table class="table table-responsive table-bordered align-middle api_table">
                          <thead>
                              <tr>
                                  <th>Sl. no.</th>
                                  <th>Name of Research Scholar</th>
                                  <th>Date of Enrollment for Coursework at SJU</th>
                                  <th>Area of Research</th>
                                  <th>Title of the Thesis (Provisional)</th>
                                  <th>Supervisor Profile</th>
                                  <th>Status of the Thesis</th>
                              </tr>
                          </thead>
                          <tbody>
                          <?php
                          $cnt = 0;

                          if (!empty($response_data['data'])) {

                              // Sort date
                              usort($response_data['data'], function($a, $b) {
                              $dateA = strtotime($a['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');
                              $dateB = strtotime($b['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');

                              // First sort by date (latest first)
                              if ($dateA != $dateB) {
                                  return $dateB - $dateA;
                              }

                              // If dates are same, sort by name alphabetically
                              return strcmp(
                                  $a['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '',
                                  $b['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? ''
                              );
                            });

                              foreach ($response_data['data'] as $row) {
                                  $cnt++;
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo $cnt; ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Area of Research'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Title of the Thesis (Provisional)'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top">
                                  <?php if (!empty($row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor'])) { ?>
                                      <a class="fw-semibold text-primary text-decoration-none"
                                         href="<?php echo $row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor']; ?>"
                                         target="_blank">
                                         View Profile
                                      </a>
                                  <?php } ?>
                              </td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Status of the Thesis'] ?? '') ?></td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                              }

                          } else {
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td colspan="7" class="text-center fw-semibold py-4">
                                  No records found
                              </td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                          }
                          ?>
                       </tbody>
                    </table>
                  </div>
                 </div>
                </div>
