        <article id="about" class="dept-section department_tab">
           <div class="title-area"><h2 class="fw-bold text-blue mb-3">About</h2>
           </div>
          <p>If you want to discover what Biotechnology is all about, you are at the right place. We at St Joseph's have established state-of-the-art laboratories, supported by a strong curriculum. Our students are offered organised lectures, innovatively designed practical sessions, interesting lesson plans, self-learning activities, science-based co-curricular activities, credit courses, workshops, and International collaborative courses. All in all, this makes Biotechnology learning fun and helps our students integrate this into future careers.  We have come 20 years since inception and have been funded by the DBT (Dept. of Biotechnology, Government of India) Star College scheme since 2014 and have been elevated to Star College Status grants in 2018. The Department is also funded by the Govt of Karnataka Vision Group for Science and Technology (VGST) through the Centre of Innovation in Science, Engineering and Education (CISEE) Grant's project to augment science teaching at the undergraduate level. The laboratory is well equipped to conduct research in microbial screening and identification, plant phytochemistry, plant tissue culture, molecular marker technology, Drosophila-based assays and Bioinformatics. Our staff are highly accomplished and dedicated in supporting our students' learning needs. We strongly believe in focusing our students on target-oriented learning outcomes. Our postgraduate programme has an exclusive curriculum. If your dream is to fulfil a journey from an undergraduate to a postgraduate Biotechnologist, we would love to have you here.</p>
        </article>

                              <h2>Mission</h2>
                       </header>
						<ul><li>The Department of Biotechnology, through its curricular and research-based pedagogical approaches, aims to engage students in conversations about basic concepts and advances in the field of Biotechnology.</li>
<li>The Department strives to provide students with authentic learning experiences that encompass a spirit of enquiry, research, problem-solving, and entrepreneurship.</li>
<li>The Department is also invested in creating among its students a strong awareness of social and environmental problems at both local and global scales, mentoring them to identify meaningful academic and career opportunities, whilst inculcating them a strong sense of academic and personal integrity.</li>

                     At the School of Life Sciences, St Joseph's University, we believe in the power of asking questions. Questions that stem from observing and pondering about the world around us, questions about biomolecules and ecosystems, questions that continue to nurture curiosity, imagination, and a spirit of exploration.

Our mission is to spark a lasting interest and joy in learning, discovery and research, while equipping students with the skills and confidence to excel in academia, industry, and society. We strive to create an environment that is intellectually engaging, collaborative, and supportive - one that helps every student to continue asking interesting questions, and forge meaningful paths.

                 <div class="modal-content">
                   <div class="modal-header">
                     <h5 class="modal-title" id="deanMessageLabel">
                       Message from the Dean
                     </h5>
                     <button type="button"  class="custom-close" data-bs-dismiss="modal"  aria-label="Close" >
                        <svg width="25" height="25" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" >

                     </button>

                   <div class="modal-body dean-modal-content">
                     
                     <p>At the School of Life Sciences, St Joseph's University, we believe in the power of asking questions. Questions that stem from observing and pondering about the world around us, questions about biomolecules and ecosystems, questions that continue to nurture curiosity, imagination, and a spirit of exploration.</p>

 <p>Our mission is to spark a lasting interest and joy in learning, discovery and research, while equipping students with the skills and confidence to excel in academia, industry, and society. We strive to create an environment that is intellectually engaging, collaborative, and supportive - one that helps every student to continue asking interesting questions, and forge meaningful paths.</p>

 <p>The School of Life Sciences is an interdisciplinary centre focusing on fundamental biology and applied fields. It comprises the Departments of Botany, Zoology, Environmental Science, Microbiology, Biotechnology, Food Science and Technology, and Biology. The School offers highly ranked graduate and postgraduate programs deeply rooted in scientific and rational pedagogical approaches.</p>

 <p>Learning at the School of Life Sciences extends far beyond classroom lectures and textbooks. Our faculty are trained in research-based pedagogical approaches, and ensure that the learning experience is holistic and relevant. Our programs are designed with a strong emphasis on experiential learning: hands-on practical training, interactive lectures, field-based learning, research-driven projects, regular expert lectures and workshops, and visits to academic and industry labs. Our students participate in International and national level programs like the prestigious DBT-Khorana Program, the Science Academies' Summer Fellowship program, and other fellowships and programs offered by premier research institutions in the country. Combined with the experience gained in our laboratories, these opportunities ensure our graduates are well-prepared to meet the demands of both professional and academic careers.
</p>
 <p>The School also harbours a vibrant research community-from undergraduate through graduate levels- dedicated to fundamental and socially relevant research in life sciences. Our alumni are placed in significant positions in the industry and academia, and make impactful contributions in various spheres, while also sustaining engagement with our programs at the School of Life Sciences.</p>
                     <p>
                       <strong>More on what is happening at the School of Life Sciences, SJU can be found here: <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/school-of-life-sciences-2a5928377/">School of Life Sciences | LinkedIn</a></strong>
                     </p>
                     <p class="mt-4">
                       <span class=" text_blue fw-bold">â Dr Susan Mary Philip</span><br>
                       <span class="text-warning mb-3"></span>
                     </p>
                   </div>
                 </div>

                         $api_url = "https://sjuv4.linways.com/api/v1/exat2/forms/reports/KkAkaWwi5XkbQiiDs/ALL?departmentId=81";
 
                         $api_ch = curl_init();
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_URL, $api_url);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, ["Authorization: $API_TOKEN", "Accept: application/json"]);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, false);
                         $response_data = curl_exec($api_ch);
                         $response_data = json_decode($response_data, true);
                         curl_close($api_ch); 
                      ?>

                      <table class="table table-responsive table-bordered align-middle api_table">
                          <thead>

                          <?php
                          $cnt = 0;

                          if (!empty($response_data['data'])) {

                              // Sort date
                              usort($response_data['data'], function($a, $b) {
                              $dateA = strtotime($a['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');
                              $dateB = strtotime($b['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');

                              // First sort by date (latest first)
                              if ($dateA != $dateB) {
                                  return $dateB - $dateA;
                              }

                              // If dates are same, sort by name alphabetically
                              return strcmp(
                                  $a['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '',
                                  $b['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? ''
                              );
                            });

                              foreach ($response_data['data'] as $row) {
                                  $cnt++;
                          ?>

                              <td class="align-top">
                                  <?php if (!empty($row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor'])) { ?>
                                      <a class="fw-semibold text-primary text-decoration-none"
                                         href="<?php echo $row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor']; ?>"
                                         target="_blank">

                                      </a>

                              </td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Status of the Thesis'] ?? '') ?></td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                              }

                          }

        <article id="about" class="dept-section department_tab">
           <div class="title-area"><h2 class="fw-bold text-blue mb-3">About</h2>
           </div>
          <p>Plants are an integral part of human life as they provide food, shelter, health and wealth besides oxygen. Botany is one of the fundamental disciplines of science dealing with the study of plant life. It is also the key to the development of biofuels such as biomass and methane gas that are used as alternatives to fossil fuels. It is important in the area of economic productivity of the nation, as it is involved in the study of crops and ideal growing techniques that help farmers increase crop yield. The study of plants is also important in the conservation of nature and natural resources, which has become crucial, especially on account of global warming and climate change. There is a paradigm shift in the approach of this branch. There is a shift from a qualitative approach to a quantitative approach. The Botany syllabi of both UG and PG programmes have been developed, keeping in mind the needs of the environment, society and also industry. The syllabi are constantly updated and upgraded by introducing modern techniques and recent advancements.</p>

<p>The Department of Botany was established in 1954 and it was once headed by the towering botanist, Late Rev Fr Dr Cecil J Saldanha, whose achievements have inspired hundreds of students and continue to be a guiding light to the Department and the Institution to this day. Since 2021, following the introduction of NEP, the Department Of Botany has been offering five UG programmes and one PG programme. Now the Department also offers a PhD. It is mandatory for all the postgraduate students to work on a short-term project in the second year (3rd and 4th semesters). Advanced Plant Physiology, Plant Tissue Culture, Plant Systematics and Microbiology are the fields of specialisation offered to the students. The PG programme also includes an educational plant collection tour each year.</p>

<p>The Department of Botany promotes a culture of academics and research amongst its students. Keeping this in mind, students are encouraged to take up various research topics of their interest and present their work at National and International conferences and publish papers as well. The Research Centre is also actively involved in guiding students for their doctoral degrees.  Some of the present staff are recognised research guides. The staff who retired in the recent past are also involved in guiding students for their MPhil and PhD. Over 32 PhD degrees have been awarded under the guidance of the Botany staff.</p>

<p>It has been the tradition of the Department of Botany to organise seminars, workshops, conferences and knowledge-sharing platforms throughout the year. An International Conference on âGreen Technologies for Sustainable Ecosystems and Trade Showâ was organised by the Department of Botany on 26th and 27th, February 2016 in association with Hong Kong University, Durham University, UK, Ministry of External Affairs, Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, Govt of India, Ministry of Environment and Forests, Govt. of Karnataka and UGC. The Department also organised an International Conference on Cancer and Genetics, on 26-27 February 2021 in association with Agarwal Hospitals, Bengaluru.</p>

<p>The Department publishes an International Open Access Journal âBiovistas- International Journal of Biological Research (IJBR)â, ISSN -2321-0524 . Botanical Society and Centre for Molecular and Computational Biology are the two dynamic associations of the Department. Botany laboratories are equipped with major instruments for research â PCR machine, GEL doc, stereo zoom microscope, binocular phase contrast microscope with photomicrographic attachment, UV-VIS spectrophotometer etc along with a well-established plant tissue culture lab and taxonomy lab. Web-based interactive smart classes for theory and practicals are conducted along the traditional chalk and talk method. Stereo zoom microscopes with luminous focusing system interfaced with LCD projectors and binocular microscopes with built-in cameras are available to enable students for in-depth observations and photography.</p>

<p>Plant taxonomy practical sessions are conducted through an online connection to the JCB Herbarium (<a href="http://flora-peninsula-indica.ces.iisc.ac.in/">http://flora-peninsula-indica.ces.iisc.ac.in</a>) of the Indian Institute of Science, which is a digital herbarium based on the monumental work of Dr Cecil J Saldanha's âKarnataka flora''. The Department maintains a greenhouse for research purposes. Currently, funds from Research Projects (from various funding agencies), and College of Excellence (CE) Grants have been used to procure a few instruments and renovate some labs. The Department is also funded by DBT for Star College Status. Since 2017, the Department has also been receiving grants from FIST. </p>
        </article>

                   <div class="modal-body dean-modal-content">
                     
                     <p>At the School of Life Sciences, St Joseph's University, we believe in the power of asking questions. Questions that stem from observing and pondering about the world around us, questions about biomolecules and ecosystems, questions that continue to nurture curiosity, imagination, and a spirit of exploration.</p>

 <p>Our mission is to spark a lasting interest and joy in learning, discovery and research, while equipping students with the skills and confidence to excel in academia, industry, and society. We strive to create an environment that is intellectually engaging, collaborative, and supportive - one that helps every student to continue asking interesting questions, and forge meaningful paths.</p>

 <p>The School of Life Sciences is an interdisciplinary centre focusing on fundamental biology and applied fields. It comprises the Departments of Botany, Zoology, Environmental Science, Microbiology, Biotechnology, Food Science and Technology, and Biology. The School offers highly ranked graduate and postgraduate programs deeply rooted in scientific and rational pedagogical approaches.</p>

 <p>Learning at the School of Life Sciences extends far beyond classroom lectures and textbooks. Our faculty are trained in research-based pedagogical approaches, and ensure that the learning experience is holistic and relevant. Our programs are designed with a strong emphasis on experiential learning: hands-on practical training, interactive lectures, field-based learning, research-driven projects, regular expert lectures and workshops, and visits to academic and industry labs. Our students participate in International and national level programs like the prestigious DBT-Khorana Program, the Science Academies' Summer Fellowship program, and other fellowships and programs offered by premier research institutions in the country. Combined with the experience gained in our laboratories, these opportunities ensure our graduates are well-prepared to meet the demands of both professional and academic careers.
</p>
 <p>The School also harbours a vibrant research community-from undergraduate through graduate levels- dedicated to fundamental and socially relevant research in life sciences. Our alumni are placed in significant positions in the industry and academia, and make impactful contributions in various spheres, while also sustaining engagement with our programs at the School of Life Sciences.</p>
                     <p>
                       <strong>More on what is happening at the School of Life Sciences, SJU can be found here: <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/school-of-life-sciences-2a5928377/">School of Life Sciences | LinkedIn</a></strong>
                     </p>

                         $API_TOKEN='eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJhSWQiOiI0NTNlMzRjNWY1NDU5ZDMxNjg5OCIsImNJZCI6IjYyMDgiLCJvSWQiOiI1IiwiaWF0IjoxNzI0OTE1ODI2fQ.WSAp2aF6p0EiS0kjBzlSvE-1QcLnue8eEvYya0-r4ds';
                         $api_url = "https://sjuv4.linways.com/api/v1/exat2/forms/reports/KkAkaWwi5XkbQiiDs/ALL?departmentId=77";
 
                         $api_ch = curl_init();
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_URL, $api_url);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, ["Authorization: $API_TOKEN", "Accept: application/json"]);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, false);
                         $response_data = curl_exec($api_ch);
                         $response_data = json_decode($response_data, true);
                         curl_close($api_ch);

                    <div class="table-responsive">
                      <table class="table table-responsive table-bordered align-middle api_table">
                          <thead>
                              <tr>
                                  <th>Sl. no.</th>

                                  <th>Area of Research</th>

                                  <th>Supervisor Profile</th>
                                  <th>Status of the Thesis</th>
                              </tr>
                          </thead>
                          <tbody>
                          <?php
                          $cnt = 0;

                          if (!empty($response_data['data'])) {

                              // Sort date
                              usort($response_data['data'], function($a, $b) {
                              $dateA = strtotime($a['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');
                              $dateB = strtotime($b['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');

                              // First sort by date (latest first)
                              if ($dateA != $dateB) {
                                  return $dateB - $dateA;
                              }

                              // If dates are same, sort by name alphabetically
                              return strcmp(
                                  $a['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '',
                                  $b['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? ''
                              );
                            });

                              foreach ($response_data['data'] as $row) {
                                  $cnt++;
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo $cnt; ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Area of Research'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Title of the Thesis (Provisional)'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top">
                                  <?php if (!empty($row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor'])) { ?>
                                      <a class="fw-semibold text-primary text-decoration-none"
                                         href="<?php echo $row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor']; ?>"
                                         target="_blank">
                                         View Profile
                                      </a>
                                  <?php } ?>
                              </td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Status of the Thesis'] ?? '') ?></td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                              }

                          } else {
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td colspan="7" class="text-center fw-semibold py-4">
                                  No records found
                              </td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                          }

        <article id="about" class="dept-section department_tab">
           <div class="title-area"><h2 class="fw-bold text-blue mb-3">About</h2>
           </div>
          <p>The Department of Environmental Science was started in 1983. We are the pioneers in Asia to offer this interdisciplinary programme at the Undergraduate level.</p>

<h4>Values</h4>

<p>Environmental Science is a value-based education, which involves the process of understanding the holistic nature of the environment, clarifying concepts that allow students to explore environmental issues, learning how to weigh various facets of an issue through critical thinking, engaging in problem-solving, and taking action to maintain or improve the environment and stand for environmental justice. As a result, individuals develop a deeper understanding of the environment and its issues and have the skills to make responsible decisions and provide sustainable solutions.</p>
        </article>

               <!-- Section Title -->

                 <h2 class="fw-bold text_blue mb-1">Message from the <span class="fw-bold text-warning mb-3">Dean</span></h2>
               </div>
               <div class="row">
                 <!-- Image Column -->
                 <div class="col-lg-4 mb-3">
                   <div class="dean-image-wrap">
                     <img src="https://sjub.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/Life+Science/Biotechnology/Dr_Susan_Mary_Philip.webp" alt="Dr Susan Mary Philip" class="img-fluid dean-img" loading="lazy" />
                   </div>
                   <h4 class="dean-name mt-3">Dr Susan Mary Philip</h4>
                   <a href="mailto:dean.lifesciences@sju.edu.in" class="dean-email">dean.lifesciences@sju.edu.in</a>
                 </div>
                 <!-- Content Column -->
                 <div class="col-lg-8">
                  
                   <p class="dean-excerpt">
                     At the School of Life Sciences, St Joseph's University, we believe in the power of asking questions. Questions that stem from observing and pondering about the world around us, questions about biomolecules and ecosystems, questions that continue to nurture curiosity, imagination, and a spirit of exploration.

Our mission is to spark a lasting interest and joy in learning, discovery and research, while equipping students with the skills and confidence to excel in academia, industry, and society. We strive to create an environment that is intellectually engaging, collaborative, and supportive - one that helps every student to continue asking interesting questions, and forge meaningful paths.
                   </p>
                   <button class="btn btn-readmore" data-bs-toggle="modal" data-bs-target="#deanMessageModal" >
                     Read more â'
                   </button>
                 </div>

               </div>
             </div>
 
             <div class="modal fade" id="deanMessageModal" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="deanMessageLabel" aria-hidden="true">
               <div class="modal-dialog modal-dialog-centered modal-lg modal-dialog-scrollable">
                 <div class="modal-content">
                   <div class="modal-header">
                     <h5 class="modal-title" id="deanMessageLabel">
                       Message from the Dean
                     </h5>
                     <button type="button"  class="custom-close" data-bs-dismiss="modal"  aria-label="Close" >
                        <svg width="25" height="25" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" >
                          <line x1="18" y1="6" x2="6" y2="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/>
                          <line x1="6" y1="6" x2="18" y2="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/>
                        </svg>
                     </button>
                   </div>
                   <div class="modal-body dean-modal-content">
                     
                     <p>At the School of Life Sciences, St Joseph's University, we believe in the power of asking questions. Questions that stem from observing and pondering about the world around us, questions about biomolecules and ecosystems, questions that continue to nurture curiosity, imagination, and a spirit of exploration.</p>

 <p>Our mission is to spark a lasting interest and joy in learning, discovery and research, while equipping students with the skills and confidence to excel in academia, industry, and society. We strive to create an environment that is intellectually engaging, collaborative, and supportive - one that helps every student to continue asking interesting questions, and forge meaningful paths.</p>

 <p>The School of Life Sciences is an interdisciplinary centre focusing on fundamental biology and applied fields. It comprises the Departments of Botany, Zoology, Environmental Science, Microbiology, Biotechnology, Food Science and Technology, and Biology. The School offers highly ranked graduate and postgraduate programs deeply rooted in scientific and rational pedagogical approaches.</p>

 <p>Learning at the School of Life Sciences extends far beyond classroom lectures and textbooks. Our faculty are trained in research-based pedagogical approaches, and ensure that the learning experience is holistic and relevant. Our programs are designed with a strong emphasis on experiential learning: hands-on practical training, interactive lectures, field-based learning, research-driven projects, regular expert lectures and workshops, and visits to academic and industry labs. Our students participate in International and national level programs like the prestigious DBT-Khorana Program, the Science Academies' Summer Fellowship program, and other fellowships and programs offered by premier research institutions in the country. Combined with the experience gained in our laboratories, these opportunities ensure our graduates are well-prepared to meet the demands of both professional and academic careers.
</p>
 <p>The School also harbours a vibrant research community-from undergraduate through graduate levels- dedicated to fundamental and socially relevant research in life sciences. Our alumni are placed in significant positions in the industry and academia, and make impactful contributions in various spheres, while also sustaining engagement with our programs at the School of Life Sciences.</p>
                     <p>
                       <strong>More on what is happening at the School of Life Sciences, SJU can be found here: <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/school-of-life-sciences-2a5928377/">School of Life Sciences | LinkedIn</a></strong>
                     </p>
                     <p class="mt-4">
                       <span class=" text_blue fw-bold">â Dr Susan Mary Philip</span><br>
                       <span class="text-warning mb-3"></span>
                     </p>
                   </div>
                 </div>

                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_URL, $api_url);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, ["Authorization: $API_TOKEN", "Accept: application/json"]);

                          <?php
                          $cnt = 0;

                          if (!empty($response_data['data'])) {

                              // Sort date
                              usort($response_data['data'], function($a, $b) {
                              $dateA = strtotime($a['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');
                              $dateB = strtotime($b['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');

                              // First sort by date (latest first)
                              if ($dateA != $dateB) {
                                  return $dateB - $dateA;
                              }

                              // If dates are same, sort by name alphabetically
                              return strcmp(
                                  $a['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '',
                                  $b['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? ''
                              );
                            });

                              foreach ($response_data['data'] as $row) {
                                  $cnt++;
                          ?>

                                         target="_blank">

                                      </a>
                                  <?php } ?>
                              </td>

                     At the School of Life Sciences, St Joseph's University, we believe in the power of asking questions. Our mission is to spark a lasting interest and joy in learning, discovery and research, while equipping students with the skills and confidence to excel in academia, industry, and society.                      </h5>
                     <button type="button"  class="custom-close" data-bs-dismiss="modal"  aria-label="Close" >

                   <div class="modal-body dean-modal-content">
                     
                     <p>At the School of Life Sciences, St Joseph's University, we believe in the power of asking questions. Questions that stem from observing and pondering about the world around us, questions about biomolecules and ecosystems, questions that continue to nurture curiosity, imagination, and a spirit of exploration.</p>

 <p>Our mission is to spark a lasting interest and joy in learning, discovery and research, while equipping students with the skills and confidence to excel in academia, industry, and society. We strive to create an environment that is intellectually engaging, collaborative, and supportive - one that helps every student to continue asking interesting questions, and forge meaningful paths.</p>

 <p>The School of Life Sciences is an interdisciplinary centre focusing on fundamental biology and applied fields. It comprises the Departments of Botany, Zoology, Environmental Science, Microbiology, Biotechnology, Food Science and Technology, and Biology. The School offers highly ranked graduate and postgraduate programs deeply rooted in scientific and rational pedagogical approaches.</p>

 <p>Learning at the School of Life Sciences extends far beyond classroom lectures and textbooks. Our faculty are trained in research-based pedagogical approaches, and ensure that the learning experience is holistic and relevant. Our programs are designed with a strong emphasis on experiential learning: hands-on practical training, interactive lectures, field-based learning, research-driven projects, regular expert lectures and workshops, and visits to academic and industry labs. Our students participate in International and national level programs like the prestigious DBT-Khorana Program, the Science Academies' Summer Fellowship program, and other fellowships and programs offered by premier research institutions in the country. Combined with the experience gained in our laboratories, these opportunities ensure our graduates are well-prepared to meet the demands of both professional and academic careers.
</p>
 <p>The School also harbours a vibrant research community-from undergraduate through graduate levels- dedicated to fundamental and socially relevant research in life sciences. Our alumni are placed in significant positions in the industry and academia, and make impactful contributions in various spheres, while also sustaining engagement with our programs at the School of Life Sciences.</p>
                     <p>
                       <strong>More on what is happening at the School of Life Sciences, SJU can be found here: <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/school-of-life-sciences-2a5928377/">School of Life Sciences | LinkedIn</a></strong>
                     </p>

                         $api_url = "https://sjuv4.linways.com/api/v1/exat2/forms/reports/KkAkaWwi5XkbQiiDs/ALL?departmentId=105";
 
                         $api_ch = curl_init();
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_URL, $api_url);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, ["Authorization: $API_TOKEN", "Accept: application/json"]);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, false);
                         $response_data = curl_exec($api_ch);
                         $response_data = json_decode($response_data, true);
                         curl_close($api_ch); 
                      ?>
                      
                    <div class="table-responsive">
                      <table class="table table-responsive table-bordered align-middle api_table">
                          <thead>
                              <tr>

                          <tbody>
                          <?php
                          $cnt = 0;

                          if (!empty($response_data['data'])) {

                              // Sort date
                              usort($response_data['data'], function($a, $b) {
                              $dateA = strtotime($a['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');
                              $dateB = strtotime($b['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');

                              // First sort by date (latest first)
                              if ($dateA != $dateB) {
                                  return $dateB - $dateA;
                              }

                              // If dates are same, sort by name alphabetically
                              return strcmp(
                                  $a['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '',
                                  $b['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? ''
                              );
                            });

                              foreach ($response_data['data'] as $row) {
                                  $cnt++;
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo $cnt; ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Area of Research'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Title of the Thesis (Provisional)'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top">
                                  <?php if (!empty($row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor'])) { ?>
                                      <a class="fw-semibold text-primary text-decoration-none"
                                         href="<?php echo $row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor']; ?>"
                                         target="_blank">
                                         View Profile
                                      </a>
                                  <?php } ?>
                              </td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Status of the Thesis'] ?? '') ?></td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                              }

                          } else {
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td colspan="7" class="text-center fw-semibold py-4">
                                  No records found
                              </td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                          }

        <article id="about" class="dept-section department_tab">
           <div class="title-area"><h2 class="fw-bold text-blue mb-3">About</h2>
           </div>

           <p>The inception of the Department of Microbiology was in the year 1988. Since then, the department has made remarkable progress and has grown in considerable ways. Since its inception, the department has been offering a three-year undergraduate programme in Microbiology with various combinations, currently we are offering state of the art combinations with Biochemistry, Biology (BCYM); Biochemistry Zoology (BCMZ); Chemistry, Biotechnology (CMBT) and Chemistry, Biology (CMBY). </p>
          <p>In 1998, a postgraduate programme was instituted. Both the programmes are well designed keeping in mind the practical, theoretical, and research skills required. Under each programme, we offer a broad spectrum of courses that enable students to critically think, apply, analyze, evaluate, and create. The programmes are taught by highly qualified faculty with excellent credentials, international exposure and are engaged in active research.</p>
          </p>
           <p>The Department of Microbiology aims at identifying one's potential to become a centre for augmenting and contributing continuously to the vibrant field of Microbiology. We strive to create and provide an ambient learning atmosphere and prepare students for academia, industry and entrepreneurship. </p>
          <p>The associations of the department are Microcosm â managed by the undergraduate students and Microbiological Society run by the students from the postgraduate section. The associations aimed at holistic development of all its members, making the pursuit of life sciences fun and exciting. Over the years, the associations have organized numerous seminars, hands-on workshops, webinars and fests, all intricately linked to Microbiology
          </p>

                 <!-- Content Column -->
                 <div class="col-lg-8">
                  
                   <p class="dean-excerpt">
                     At the School of Life Sciences, St Joseph's University, we believe in the power of asking questions. Questions that stem from observing and pondering about the world around us, questions about biomolecules and ecosystems, questions that continue to nurture curiosity, imagination, and a spirit of exploration.

Our mission is to spark a lasting interest and joy in learning, discovery and research, while equipping students with the skills and confidence to excel in academia, industry, and society. We strive to create an environment that is intellectually engaging, collaborative, and supportive - one that helps every student to continue asking interesting questions, and forge meaningful paths.
                   </p>
                   <button class="btn btn-readmore" data-bs-toggle="modal" data-bs-target="#deanMessageModal" >
                     Read more â'
                   </button>

             <div class="modal fade" id="deanMessageModal" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="deanMessageLabel" aria-hidden="true">
               <div class="modal-dialog modal-dialog-centered modal-lg modal-dialog-scrollable">
                 <div class="modal-content">
                   <div class="modal-header">
                     <h5 class="modal-title" id="deanMessageLabel">
                       Message from the Dean
                     </h5>
                     <button type="button"  class="custom-close" data-bs-dismiss="modal"  aria-label="Close" >
                        <svg width="25" height="25" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" >

                   <div class="modal-body dean-modal-content">
                     
                     <p>At the School of Life Sciences, St Joseph's University, we believe in the power of asking questions. Questions that stem from observing and pondering about the world around us, questions about biomolecules and ecosystems, questions that continue to nurture curiosity, imagination, and a spirit of exploration.</p>

 <p>Our mission is to spark a lasting interest and joy in learning, discovery and research, while equipping students with the skills and confidence to excel in academia, industry, and society. We strive to create an environment that is intellectually engaging, collaborative, and supportive - one that helps every student to continue asking interesting questions, and forge meaningful paths.</p>

 <p>The School of Life Sciences is an interdisciplinary centre focusing on fundamental biology and applied fields. It comprises the Departments of Botany, Zoology, Environmental Science, Microbiology, Biotechnology, Food Science and Technology, and Biology. The School offers highly ranked graduate and postgraduate programs deeply rooted in scientific and rational pedagogical approaches.</p>

 <p>Learning at the School of Life Sciences extends far beyond classroom lectures and textbooks. Our faculty are trained in research-based pedagogical approaches, and ensure that the learning experience is holistic and relevant. Our programs are designed with a strong emphasis on experiential learning: hands-on practical training, interactive lectures, field-based learning, research-driven projects, regular expert lectures and workshops, and visits to academic and industry labs. Our students participate in International and national level programs like the prestigious DBT-Khorana Program, the Science Academies' Summer Fellowship program, and other fellowships and programs offered by premier research institutions in the country. Combined with the experience gained in our laboratories, these opportunities ensure our graduates are well-prepared to meet the demands of both professional and academic careers.
</p>
 <p>The School also harbours a vibrant research community-from undergraduate through graduate levels- dedicated to fundamental and socially relevant research in life sciences. Our alumni are placed in significant positions in the industry and academia, and make impactful contributions in various spheres, while also sustaining engagement with our programs at the School of Life Sciences.</p>
                     <p>
                       <strong>More on what is happening at the School of Life Sciences, SJU can be found here: <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/school-of-life-sciences-2a5928377/">School of Life Sciences | LinkedIn</a></strong>
                     </p>
                     <p class="mt-4">
                       <span class=" text_blue fw-bold">â Dr Susan Mary Philip</span><br>
                       <span class="text-warning mb-3"></span>
                     </p>

                    <?php
                         $API_TOKEN='eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJhSWQiOiI0NTNlMzRjNWY1NDU5ZDMxNjg5OCIsImNJZCI6IjYyMDgiLCJvSWQiOiI1IiwiaWF0IjoxNzI0OTE1ODI2fQ.WSAp2aF6p0EiS0kjBzlSvE-1QcLnue8eEvYya0-r4ds';
                         $api_url = "https://sjuv4.linways.com/api/v1/exat2/forms/reports/KkAkaWwi5XkbQiiDs/ALL?departmentId=80";
 
                         $api_ch = curl_init();
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_URL, $api_url);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, ["Authorization: $API_TOKEN", "Accept: application/json"]);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, false);
                         $response_data = curl_exec($api_ch);
                         $response_data = json_decode($response_data, true);
                         curl_close($api_ch); 
                      ?>
                      
                    <div class="table-responsive">
                      <table class="table table-responsive table-bordered align-middle api_table">
                          <thead>
                              <tr>
                                  <th>Sl. no.</th>
                                  <th>Name of Research Scholar</th>
                                  <th>Date of Enrollment for Coursework at SJU</th>
                                  <th>Area of Research</th>
                                  <th>Title of the Thesis (Provisional)</th>
                                  <th>Supervisor Profile</th>
                                  <th>Status of the Thesis</th>
                              </tr>
                          </thead>
                          <tbody>
                          <?php
                          $cnt = 0;

                          if (!empty($response_data['data'])) {

                              // Sort date
                              usort($response_data['data'], function($a, $b) {
                              $dateA = strtotime($a['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');
                              $dateB = strtotime($b['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');

                              // First sort by date (latest first)
                              if ($dateA != $dateB) {
                                  return $dateB - $dateA;
                              }

                              // If dates are same, sort by name alphabetically
                              return strcmp(
                                  $a['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '',
                                  $b['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? ''
                              );
                            });

                              foreach ($response_data['data'] as $row) {
                                  $cnt++;
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo $cnt; ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Area of Research'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Title of the Thesis (Provisional)'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top">
                                  <?php if (!empty($row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor'])) { ?>
                                      <a class="fw-semibold text-primary text-decoration-none"
                                         href="<?php echo $row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor']; ?>"
                                         target="_blank">
                                         View Profile
                                      </a>
                                  <?php } ?>
                              </td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Status of the Thesis'] ?? '') ?></td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                              }

                          } else {
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td colspan="7" class="text-center fw-semibold py-4">
                                  No records found
                              </td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                          }
                          ?>
                       </tbody>
                    </table>

        <article id="about" class="dept-section department_tab">
           <div class="title-area"><h2 class="fw-bold text-blue mb-3">About</h2>
           </div>
          <p>The Department of Zoology ever since its inception in 1957 was actively involved in teaching Zoology for undergraduate degree programmes in combination with other disciplines viz., Chemistry, Botany, Zoology (CBZ); Microbiology, Chemistry, Zoology (MCZ); Chemistry, Environmental Science, Zoology (CEZ), Chemistry, Zoology, Biotechnology (CZBT) and Biochemistry, Botany and Zoology (BBZ). Now the Department offers Zoology in combination with Botany, Biochemistry, and Chemistry. The Faculty unites the disciplines of General Zoology, Cell Biology and Genetics, Human Anatomy- Physiology, Developmental Biology, Ecology, Ethology, and Evolutionary Biology. The Zoology Department has several excellent teaching facilities including well-equipped laboratories with instruments like thermal cycler, Insect culture facilities, and a Museum of specimens. The Department has ten faculty, two Associates, and eight Assistant professors. All courses are taught by lecture and practical work.
</p>
<p>Co-curricular courses offered by the department include a choice-based credit system- A Journey into the Animal World and Human Life and certificate courses on âUrban ecology and pollution abatement technologiesâ, âBiodiversity, Wildlife and Conservation biologyâ and âEntomologyâ. Students will undertake a research project as part of certificate courses which can take place in the labs in the department or out in the field. Graduates are working on a wide range of projects/internships in reputed research institutions. The department encourages the popularization of science by conducting training and teaching activities through the Natural Science Association (including Conferences/ Seminars/webinars/Workshops/lectures).</p>
        </article>

                     At the School of Life Sciences, St Joseph's University, we believe in the power of asking questions.                      <button type="button"  class="custom-close" data-bs-dismiss="modal"  aria-label="Close" >

                   <div class="modal-body dean-modal-content">
                     
                     <p>At the School of Life Sciences, St Joseph's University, we believe in the power of asking questions. Questions that stem from observing and pondering about the world around us, questions about biomolecules and ecosystems, questions that continue to nurture curiosity, imagination, and a spirit of exploration.</p>

 <p>Our mission is to spark a lasting interest and joy in learning, discovery and research, while equipping students with the skills and confidence to excel in academia, industry, and society. We strive to create an environment that is intellectually engaging, collaborative, and supportive - one that helps every student to continue asking interesting questions, and forge meaningful paths.</p>

 <p>The School of Life Sciences is an interdisciplinary centre focusing on fundamental biology and applied fields. It comprises the Departments of Botany, Zoology, Environmental Science, Microbiology, Biotechnology, Food Science and Technology, and Biology. The School offers highly ranked graduate and postgraduate programs deeply rooted in scientific and rational pedagogical approaches.</p>

 <p>Learning at the School of Life Sciences extends far beyond classroom lectures and textbooks. Our faculty are trained in research-based pedagogical approaches, and ensure that the learning experience is holistic and relevant. Our programs are designed with a strong emphasis on experiential learning: hands-on practical training, interactive lectures, field-based learning, research-driven projects, regular expert lectures and workshops, and visits to academic and industry labs. Our students participate in International and national level programs like the prestigious DBT-Khorana Program, the Science Academies' Summer Fellowship program, and other fellowships and programs offered by premier research institutions in the country. Combined with the experience gained in our laboratories, these opportunities ensure our graduates are well-prepared to meet the demands of both professional and academic careers.
</p>
 <p>The School also harbours a vibrant research community-from undergraduate through graduate levels- dedicated to fundamental and socially relevant research in life sciences. Our alumni are placed in significant positions in the industry and academia, and make impactful contributions in various spheres, while also sustaining engagement with our programs at the School of Life Sciences.</p>
                     <p>
                       <strong>More on what is happening at the School of Life Sciences, SJU can be found here: <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/school-of-life-sciences-2a5928377/">School of Life Sciences | LinkedIn</a></strong>
                     </p>

                <div class="row g-4">
              <div class="col-lg-12 col-md-12 col-sm-12 data-item" data-category="phd-scholars">
                <div class="data-card">
                     <?php
                         $API_TOKEN='eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJhSWQiOiI0NTNlMzRjNWY1NDU5ZDMxNjg5OCIsImNJZCI6IjYyMDgiLCJvSWQiOiI1IiwiaWF0IjoxNzI0OTE1ODI2fQ.WSAp2aF6p0EiS0kjBzlSvE-1QcLnue8eEvYya0-r4ds';
                         $api_url = "https://sjuv4.linways.com/api/v1/exat2/forms/reports/KkAkaWwi5XkbQiiDs/ALL?departmentId=78";
 
                         $api_ch = curl_init();
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_URL, $api_url);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, ["Authorization: $API_TOKEN", "Accept: application/json"]);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, false);
                         $response_data = curl_exec($api_ch);
                         $response_data = json_decode($response_data, true);
                         curl_close($api_ch); 
                      ?>
                      
                    <div class="table-responsive">
                      <table class="table table-responsive table-bordered align-middle api_table">
                          <thead>
                              <tr>
                                  <th>Sl. no.</th>
                                  <th>Name of Research Scholar</th>
                                  <th>Date of Enrollment for Coursework at SJU</th>
                                  <th>Area of Research</th>
                                  <th>Title of the Thesis (Provisional)</th>
                                  <th>Supervisor Profile</th>
                                  <th>Status of the Thesis</th>
                              </tr>
                          </thead>
                          <tbody>
                          <?php
                          $cnt = 0;

                          if (!empty($response_data['data'])) {

                              // Sort date
                              usort($response_data['data'], function($a, $b) {
                              $dateA = strtotime($a['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');
                              $dateB = strtotime($b['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');

                              // First sort by date (latest first)
                              if ($dateA != $dateB) {
                                  return $dateB - $dateA;
                              }

                              // If dates are same, sort by name alphabetically
                              return strcmp(
                                  $a['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '',
                                  $b['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? ''
                              );
                            });

                              foreach ($response_data['data'] as $row) {
                                  $cnt++;
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo $cnt; ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Area of Research'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Title of the Thesis (Provisional)'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top">
                                  <?php if (!empty($row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor'])) { ?>
                                      <a class="fw-semibold text-primary text-decoration-none"
                                         href="<?php echo $row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor']; ?>"
                                         target="_blank">
                                         View Profile
                                      </a>
                                  <?php } ?>
                              </td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Status of the Thesis'] ?? '') ?></td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                              }

                          } else {
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td colspan="7" class="text-center fw-semibold py-4">
                                  No records found
                              </td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                          }
                          ?>
                       </tbody>
                    </table>
                  </div>
                 </div>
                </div>

      <div class="modal-body dean-modal-content">
        <h4>Dean's message:</h4>
    
<p>At the School of Life Sciences, St Joseph's University, we believe in the power of asking questions. Questions that stem from observing and pondering about the world around us, questions about biomolecules and ecosystems, questions that continue to nurture curiosity, imagination, and a spirit of exploration.</p>

<p>Our mission is to spark a lasting interest and joy in learning, discovery and research, while equipping students with the skills and confidence to excel in academia, industry, and society. We strive to create an environment that is intellectually engaging, collaborative, and supportive - one that helps every student to continue asking interesting questions, and forge meaningful paths.</p>

<p>The School of Life Sciences is an interdisciplinary centre focusing on fundamental biology and applied fields. It comprises the Departments of Botany, Zoology, Environmental Science, Microbiology, Biotechnology, Food Science and Technology, and Biology. The School offers highly ranked graduate and postgraduate programs deeply rooted in scientific and rational pedagogical approaches.</p>

<p>Learning at the School of Life Sciences extends far beyond classroom lectures and textbooks. Our faculty are trained in research-based pedagogical approaches, and ensure that the learning experience is holistic and relevant. Our programs are designed with a strong emphasis on experiential learning: hands-on practical training, interactive lectures, field-based learning, research-driven projects, regular expert lectures and workshops, and visits to academic and industry labs. Our students participate in International and national level programs like the prestigious DBT-Khorana Program, the Science Academies' Summer Fellowship program, and other fellowships and programs offered by premier research institutions in the country. Combined with the experience gained in our laboratories, these opportunities ensure our graduates are well-prepared to meet the demands of both professional and academic careers.</p>

<p>The School also harbours a vibrant research community-from undergraduate through graduate levels- dedicated to fundamental and socially relevant research in life sciences. Our alumni are placed in significant positions in the industry and academia, and make impactful contributions in various spheres, while also sustaining engagement with our programs at the School of Life Sciences.</p>
        <p>
          <strong>More on what is happening at the School of Life Sciences, SJU can be found here:<a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/school-of-life-sciences-2a5928377/"> School of Life Sciences | LinkedIn</strong>
        </p>
        <p class="mt-4">
          <span class=" text_blue fw-bold">â Dr Susan Mary Philip</span><br>
          <span class="text-warning mb-3">dean.lifesciences@sju.edu.in</span>
        </p>
      </div>

        <article id="about" class="dept-section department_tab">
           <div class="title-area"><h2 class="fw-bold text-blue mb-3">About</h2></div>
          <p>The Department of Electronics was established in 1984 and the programme Physics, Mathematics and Electronics (PME) became a Grant-in-Aid programme in 1988. 
          The Department offers undergraduate programmes in Electronics. With a legacy of thirty-eight years, our mission is to develop young men and women with active and 
          creative minds, inculcating a scientific temper in them. We try to achieve this by exposing them to theories and applications of Electronic Science that are in 
          tandem with the latest technological developments.</p>

         <p>We update our syllabus according to the latest trends in the industry and the trends in highly interdisciplinary research going between Electronics and other subjects. 
         The Department has been recognised by DBT through the award of DBT-STAR college status in 2019. We wish to help our students expand the horizons of their understanding 
         concerning the revolutionary contribution of Electronics to human well-being and also to facilitate the actualisation of their rich potential for unique contributions 
         to life-enhancing technology. During the course of their study, the students learn about various topics under Electronics, like Analog Electronics, Digital Electronics, 
         Sensors, Communication Electronics, Microprocessors and Microcontrollers. To give an edge to the students we have incorporated hardware description language and other 
         relevant software in the syllabus. The students get hands-on expertise and prepare interesting circuits and projects during their course of study. The Department 
         comprises a versatile and experienced faculty. The spacious laboratories are well equipped with the latest devices and instruments.</p>

         <p>The Department provides a platform for students to indulge in electronics-related activities both at intra-collegiate and intercollegiate levels through 
         its academic club named JET club. This helps in the team building and holistic development of young minds. The Department organises its popular Annual Inter-College 
         Fest âSHOCK' every year.</p>
         <p>We offer an inclusive, supportive and academically challenging learning environment. With personal attention and mentoring from faculty and collaborative hands-on projects, 
         students are inspired to excel and innovate.</p>
        </article>

                    <p class="dean-excerpt">We believe that this sense of wonderment, thirst for knowledge and wisdom is innate to all human beings. This forms the cornerstone of the philosophy 
                    of the School of Physical Sciences that comprises of the Departments of Physics, Mathematics, Electronics and Statistics of the St. Joseph's University. We use these subjects

                    <p class="dean-excerpt">The Department of Mathematics has nearly a century of history, being one of the first science departments to be started in the erstwhile

                      <h5>Dear reader,</h5>
                      <h5>Wonder why I wonder Why wonder? I wonder..</h5> 
                      <p class="dean-excerpt">We believe that this sense of wonderment, thirst for knowledge and wisdom is innate to all human beings. This forms the cornerstone of the philosophy of the School of Physical Sciences that comprises of the Departments of Physics, Mathematics, Electronics and Statistics of the St. Joseph's University. We use these subjects as our tools to nurture logical reasoning ability, a sense of wonderment and scientific temper among our students.</p>
                      <p class="dean-excerpt">The Department of Mathematics has nearly a century of history, being one of the first science departments to be started in the erstwhile St. Joseph's College (now St. Joseph's University). The youngest department in this school is the Department of Statistics. All these departments, however, are at the forefront of knowledge 
                      creation and dissemination in their respective fields. Many of the teachers are active researchers in diverse fields like Astrophysics, Number Theory, Markov Chains, Internet of Things etc. Our faculty members are sought after by other institutes and departments as resource persons for various teacher training programmes, conferences, seminars and workshops. 
                      Some of them are part of the Board of Studies of other universities and colleges, as we believe that together we can grow.</p>
                      <p class="dean-excerpt">Our alumni and alumnae are spread far and wide around the globe. Some of them are eminent scientists, researchers and entrepreneurs in India and abroad. Some others are delivering yeomen service for the upliftment of the poor and downtrodden the world over. We are proud of all of them and of the fact that they are all true Josephites, upholding the motto of our university Fide et Labore (Faith and Toil).</p>

              <div class="col-lg-12 col-md-12 col-sm-12 data-item" data-category="phd-scholars">
                <div class="data-card">
                    <?php
                         $API_TOKEN='eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJhSWQiOiI0NTNlMzRjNWY1NDU5ZDMxNjg5OCIsImNJZCI6IjYyMDgiLCJvSWQiOiI1IiwiaWF0IjoxNzI0OTE1ODI2fQ.WSAp2aF6p0EiS0kjBzlSvE-1QcLnue8eEvYya0-r4ds';
                         $api_url = "https://sjuv4.linways.com/api/v1/exat2/forms/reports/KkAkaWwi5XkbQiiDs/ALL?departmentId=74";
 
                         $api_ch = curl_init();
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_URL, $api_url);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, ["Authorization: $API_TOKEN", "Accept: application/json"]);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, false);
                         $response_data = curl_exec($api_ch);
                         $response_data = json_decode($response_data, true);
                         curl_close($api_ch); 
                      ?>
                      
                    <div class="table-responsive">
                      <table class="table table-responsive table-bordered align-middle api_table">
                          <thead>
                              <tr>
                                  <th>Sl. no.</th>
                                  <th>Name of Research Scholar</th>
                                  <th>Date of Enrollment for Coursework at SJU</th>
                                  <th>Area of Research</th>
                                  <th>Title of the Thesis (Provisional)</th>
                                  <th>Supervisor Profile</th>
                                  <th>Status of the Thesis</th>
                              </tr>
                          </thead>
                          <tbody>
                          <?php
                          $cnt = 0;

                          if (!empty($response_data['data'])) {

                              // Sort date
                              usort($response_data['data'], function($a, $b) {
                              $dateA = strtotime($a['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');
                              $dateB = strtotime($b['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');

                              // First sort by date (latest first)
                              if ($dateA != $dateB) {
                                  return $dateB - $dateA;
                              }

                              // If dates are same, sort by name alphabetically
                              return strcmp(
                                  $a['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '',
                                  $b['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? ''
                              );
                            });

                              foreach ($response_data['data'] as $row) {
                                  $cnt++;
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo $cnt; ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Area of Research'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Title of the Thesis (Provisional)'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top">
                                  <?php if (!empty($row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor'])) { ?>
                                      <a class="fw-semibold text-primary text-decoration-none"
                                         href="<?php echo $row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor']; ?>"
                                         target="_blank">
                                         View Profile
                                      </a>
                                  <?php } ?>
                              </td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Status of the Thesis'] ?? '') ?></td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                              }

                          } else {
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td colspan="7" class="text-center fw-semibold py-4">
                                  No records found
                              </td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                          }
                          ?>
                       </tbody>
                    </table>
                  </div>
                 </div>

        <article id="about" class="dept-section department_tab">
           <div class="title-area"><h2 class="fw-bold text-blue mb-3">About</h2></div>
          <p> The Department of Mathematics was established in 1923. It is one of the oldest science departments in the Institution. 
          The Department offers undergraduate and postgraduate programmes. In 2014, the Department instituted the MSc Mathematics programme 
          to promote higher studies and research in Mathematics. At present, the Department has 18 well-qualified and highly dedicated faculty 
          members and teaches over 800 students in the UG section and over 80 students in the PG programmes. The Department provides a platform 
          for students to indulge in Mathematics-related activities at both intra-collegiate and intercollegiate levels through its academic club 
          named ABACUS. The good work of the Department has been recognised by DBT and DST through the award of DBT- STAR and DST-FIST funding.</p>

        <p> The Department endeavours to be a centre of excellence nurturing joyful curiosity in learning, enthusiastic creativity in research, and passion 
        for building a respectful, free, transparent, and dynamic pedagogic community. The Department enthusiastically initiates students to the power of abstraction. 
        Students are led to enjoy and create patterns and explore relationships that underlie mathematical structures. The learning process is conducted in a manner 
        that interests students and opens their minds to explorations in the subject.</p>
        </article>

                    <p class="dean-excerpt">We believe that this sense of wonderment, thirst for knowledge and wisdom is innate to all human beings. This forms the cornerstone of the philosophy 
                    of the School of Physical Sciences that comprises of the Departments of Physics, Mathematics, Electronics and Statistics of the St. Joseph's University. We use these subjects 
                    as our tools to nurture logical reasoning ability, a sense of wonderment and scientific temper among our students.</p>
                    <p class="dean-excerpt">The Department of Mathematics has nearly a century of history, being one of the first science departments to be started in the erstwhile 
                    St. Joseph's College (now St. Joseph's University). The youngest department in this school is the Department of Statistics. All these departments, however, 
                    are at the forefront of knowledge creation and dissemination in their respective fields.</p>

                      <h5>Dear reader,</h5>
                      <h5>Wonder why I wonder Why wonder? I wonder..</h5> 
                      <p class="dean-excerpt">We believe that this sense of wonderment, thirst for knowledge and wisdom is innate to all human beings. This forms the cornerstone of the philosophy of the School of Physical Sciences that comprises of the Departments of Physics, Mathematics, Electronics and Statistics of the St. Joseph's University. We use these subjects as our tools to nurture logical reasoning ability, a sense of wonderment and scientific temper among our students.</p>
                      <p class="dean-excerpt">The Department of Mathematics has nearly a century of history, being one of the first science departments to be started in the erstwhile St. Joseph's College (now St. Joseph's University). The youngest department in this school is the Department of Statistics. All these departments, however, are at the forefront of knowledge 
                      creation and dissemination in their respective fields. Many of the teachers are active researchers in diverse fields like Astrophysics, Number Theory, Markov Chains, Internet of Things etc. Our faculty members are sought after by other institutes and departments as resource persons for various teacher training programmes, conferences, seminars and workshops. 
                      Some of them are part of the Board of Studies of other universities and colleges, as we believe that together we can grow.</p>
                      <p class="dean-excerpt">Our alumni and alumnae are spread far and wide around the globe. Some of them are eminent scientists, researchers and entrepreneurs in India and abroad. Some others are delivering yeomen service for the upliftment of the poor and downtrodden the world over. We are proud of all of them and of the fact that they are all true Josephites, upholding the motto of our university Fide et Labore (Faith and Toil).</p>
