                <div class="data-card">
                    <?php
                         $API_TOKEN='eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJhSWQiOiI0NTNlMzRjNWY1NDU5ZDMxNjg5OCIsImNJZCI6IjYyMDgiLCJvSWQiOiI1IiwiaWF0IjoxNzI0OTE1ODI2fQ.WSAp2aF6p0EiS0kjBzlSvE-1QcLnue8eEvYya0-r4ds';
                         $api_url = "https://sjuv4.linways.com/api/v1/exat2/forms/reports/KkAkaWwi5XkbQiiDs/ALL?departmentId=73";
 
                         $api_ch = curl_init();
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_URL, $api_url);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, ["Authorization: $API_TOKEN", "Accept: application/json"]);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, false);
                         $response_data = curl_exec($api_ch);
                         $response_data = json_decode($response_data, true);
                         curl_close($api_ch); 
                      ?>
                      
                    <div class="table-responsive">
                      <table class="table table-responsive table-bordered align-middle api_table">
                          <thead>
                              <tr>
                                  <th>Sl. no.</th>
                                  <th>Name of Research Scholar</th>
                                  <th>Date of Enrollment for Coursework at SJU</th>
                                  <th>Area of Research</th>
                                  <th>Title of the Thesis (Provisional)</th>
                                  <th>Supervisor Profile</th>
                                  <th>Status of the Thesis</th>
                              </tr>
                          </thead>
                          <tbody>
                          <?php
                          $cnt = 0;

                          if (!empty($response_data['data'])) {

                              // Sort date
                              usort($response_data['data'], function($a, $b) {
                              $dateA = strtotime($a['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');
                              $dateB = strtotime($b['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');

                              // First sort by date (latest first)
                              if ($dateA != $dateB) {
                                  return $dateB - $dateA;
                              }

                              // If dates are same, sort by name alphabetically
                              return strcmp(
                                  $a['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '',
                                  $b['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? ''
                              );
                            });

                              foreach ($response_data['data'] as $row) {
                                  $cnt++;
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo $cnt; ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Area of Research'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Title of the Thesis (Provisional)'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top">
                                  <?php if (!empty($row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor'])) { ?>
                                      <a class="fw-semibold text-primary text-decoration-none"
                                         href="<?php echo $row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor']; ?>"
                                         target="_blank">
                                         View Profile
                                      </a>
                                  <?php } ?>
                              </td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Status of the Thesis'] ?? '') ?></td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                              }

                          } else {
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td colspan="7" class="text-center fw-semibold py-4">
                                  No records found
                              </td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                          }
                          ?>
                       </tbody>
                    </table>

        <article id="about" class="dept-section department_tab">
           <div class="title-area"><h2 class="fw-bold text-blue mb-3">About</h2></div>
          <p>The Physics department at St. Joseph's College had its humble beginnings in the year 1923 under the first HOD Sri. S. Ramaswamy Iyengar and 
          Sri. P. Devasy. At present, the Department has 14 faculty members and teaching around five hundred students in the UG section and 60 students 
          in the PG programme. Over the last nine decades, the Department has scaled new heights in setting standards of education by promoting scientific 
          temperament and kindling curiosity in physics among students. The laboratories and library are enriched by grants from the UGC, K.Kasturirangan MP LADS funds, and CE grants.</p>

          <p>The department organises a certificate course âSpace and Rocket Dynamicsâ in collaboration with ISRO since 2000. The course which is also open to 
          students from other institutions provides a unique platform for the engineering and degree students to interact closely with eminent scientists from ISRO, 
          and IIA. The course helps in creating awareness among the students on India's triumphant odyssey in space exploration. The department has to its credit an 
          8-inch Schmidt-Cassegrain optical telescope sponsored by ISRO to see the wonders of the night sky.</p>

          <p>Some of the courses are provided through learning management systems. The numerical techniques course has a hand on laboratory using Python programming. 
          There are two open electives 1. Astrophysics 2. Material Science. The students will have to do a compulsory project with premier research institutes like ISRO, IISc, 
          RRI and IIA, etc during their final semester. In addition, the programme has initiated bridge courses to make learning physics at the PG level more conformable and 
          provide continuity to the narrative from the UG curriculum and help students from disparate backgrounds. A recent approval of the department as a Research Centre 
          under Bangalore University will see more advances in the unique features of this department.</p>
        </article>

                    <p class="dean-excerpt">The Department of Physics is dedicated to inculcating in its students a deep commitment to the pursuit of knowledge and understanding 
                    in the Physical Sciences through promoting a spirit of open- ended intellectual curiosity. We encourage our students to be innovative and adaptable to new 
                    developments in society through an emphasis on quality in teaching, learning and research. The Physics Students Association (PSA) is very active and provides 
                    an opportunity for the students to exhibit their extra-curricular talents thereby enabling them to enjoy learning physics. The PG students have an association 
                    ÏÏÎ¾ (called physeeksee). Under this banner the students host the intercollegiate event called Tek-Olma every year and also organize special lectures and various 
                    intra-collegiate events. These associations both at the UG and PG levels provide the students a dais for showcasing their creativity and giving an opportunity 
                    to amplify their organizational skills. The P.G. Physics course was initiated by the department in 2010 to promote higher studies and research in physics. 
                    The section started with very moderate grants and a humble number of twenty students. The PG section has now grown to include sixty students. The course 
                    attempts to provide Physics skills to students by way of providing ground for the application of concepts. There is a very active forum engaged in the 
                    discussion of physics strengthened by various visiting experts giving small discourses in their fields of specialization. Some of the courses are provided 
                    through learning management systems. The numerical techniques course has a hand on laboratory using Python programming. </p>
                    <p>There are two open electives: </p>
                    <ol><li> Astrophysics</li><li>Soft condensed matter physics.</li> </ol> 
                    <p>The students will have to do a compulsory project with premier research institutes 
                    like ISRO, IISc, RRI and IIA etc during their final semester. In addition, the program has initiated bridge courses to make learning physics at the PG level more 
                    conformable and to provide continuity to the narrative from the UG curriculum and helping students from disparate backgrounds. A recent approval of the department 
                    as a research Centre under Bangalore University will see more advances in the unique features of this department.</p>

                    <?php
                         $API_TOKEN='eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJhSWQiOiI0NTNlMzRjNWY1NDU5ZDMxNjg5OCIsImNJZCI6IjYyMDgiLCJvSWQiOiI1IiwiaWF0IjoxNzI0OTE1ODI2fQ.WSAp2aF6p0EiS0kjBzlSvE-1QcLnue8eEvYya0-r4ds';
                         $api_url = "https://sjuv4.linways.com/api/v1/exat2/forms/reports/KkAkaWwi5XkbQiiDs/ALL?departmentId=71";
 
                         $api_ch = curl_init();
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_URL, $api_url);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, ["Authorization: $API_TOKEN", "Accept: application/json"]);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, false);
                         $response_data = curl_exec($api_ch);
                         $response_data = json_decode($response_data, true);
                         curl_close($api_ch); 
                      ?>
                      
                    <div class="table-responsive">
                      <table class="table table-responsive table-bordered align-middle api_table">
                          <thead>
                              <tr>
                                  <th>Sl. no.</th>
                                  <th>Name of Research Scholar</th>
                                  <th>Date of Enrollment for Coursework at SJU</th>
                                  <th>Area of Research</th>
                                  <th>Title of the Thesis (Provisional)</th>
                                  <th>Supervisor Profile</th>
                                  <th>Status of the Thesis</th>
                              </tr>
                          </thead>
                          <tbody>
                          <?php
                          $cnt = 0;

                          if (!empty($response_data['data'])) {

                              // Sort date
                              usort($response_data['data'], function($a, $b) {
                              $dateA = strtotime($a['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');
                              $dateB = strtotime($b['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');

                              // First sort by date (latest first)
                              if ($dateA != $dateB) {
                                  return $dateB - $dateA;
                              }

                              // If dates are same, sort by name alphabetically
                              return strcmp(
                                  $a['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '',
                                  $b['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? ''
                              );
                            });

                              foreach ($response_data['data'] as $row) {
                                  $cnt++;
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo $cnt; ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Area of Research'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Title of the Thesis (Provisional)'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top">
                                  <?php if (!empty($row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor'])) { ?>
                                      <a class="fw-semibold text-primary text-decoration-none"
                                         href="<?php echo $row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor']; ?>"
                                         target="_blank">
                                         View Profile
                                      </a>
                                  <?php } ?>
                              </td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Status of the Thesis'] ?? '') ?></td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                              }

                          } else {
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td colspan="7" class="text-center fw-semibold py-4">
                                  No records found
                              </td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                          }
                          ?>
                       </tbody>
                    </table>

        <article id="about" class="dept-section department_tab">
           <div class="title-area"><h2 class="fw-bold text-blue mb-3">About</h2></div>
          <p>We live in a world where the use of statistical data is pivotal to comprehending many issues around us. The Department of Statistics 
          in St Joseph's College was established in 2010. The Department of Statistics is committed to excellence in teaching and equipping students 
          to become practicing Statisticians. The Department provides a platform for the students to analyze real-life data, draw conclusions, and 
          support conclusions by explaining the reasoning behind them. The Department also offers two certificate courses namely âStatistics using 
          SPSS and MS Excelâ and âData Science and Analyticsâ. The programme also includes internships and projects with analysis of real-life data. 
          The main objectives of the department are to acquaint students with various statistical methods and their application in different fields, 
          cultivate statistical thinking among students, develop skills in handling complex problems in data analysis and research design, and prepare 
          students for future courses having quantitative components.</p>

          <p>The department aims to instill scientific temper, analytical skills, and intellectual vigor among students, so that they may contribute 
          to the needs of society. The department aims to provide students with life-oriented education through projects of social relevance. The department 
          is offering eight papers in six semesters for the students. These papers introduce basic statistical tools needed for postgraduate study in 
          statistics/applied statistics. These papers are designed to impart the learning of statistical methods and tools, which is expected to improve 
          students' ability to analyse various types of real-life data. Introduction to Probability and Statistics and theoretical probability distributions 
          are papers that help students to acquire basic knowledge in statistics, understand the importance of statistics, and will provide students with 
          basic knowledge of probability models and their applications in real-life problems. The papers Statistical Inference- I and Statistical 
          Inference -II provide basic knowledge of estimation theory.</p>
        </article>

We use these subjects as our tools to nurture logical reasoning ability, a sense of wonderment and scientific temper among our students.</p>
                      <p class="dean-excerpt">The Department of Mathematics has nearly a century of history, being one of the first science departments to be started in the erstwhile St. Joseph's College (now St. Joseph's University). The youngest department in this school is the Department of Statistics. All these departments, however, are at the forefront of knowledge 
                      creation and dissemination in their respective fields. Many of the teachers are active researchers in diverse fields like Astrophysics, Number Theory, Markov Chains, Internet of Things etc. Our faculty members are sought after by other institutes and departments as resource persons for various teacher training programmes, conferences, seminars and workshops. 
                      Some of them are part of the Board of Studies of other universities and colleges, as we believe that together we can grow.</p>
                      <p class="dean-excerpt">Our alumni and alumnae are spread far and wide around the globe. Some of them are eminent scientists, researchers and entrepreneurs in India and abroad. Some others are delivering yeomen service for the upliftment of the poor and downtrodden the world over. We are proud of all of them and of the fact that they are all true Josephites, upholding the motto of our university Fide et Labore (Faith and Toil).</p>

                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, false);
                         $response_data = curl_exec($api_ch);
                         $response_data = json_decode($response_data, true);
                         curl_close($api_ch); 
                      ?>
                      
                    <div class="table-responsive">
                      <table class="table table-responsive table-bordered align-middle api_table">
                          <thead>
                              <tr>
                                  <th>Sl. no.</th>
                                  <th>Name of Research Scholar</th>
                                  <th>Date of Enrollment for Coursework at SJU</th>
                                  <th>Area of Research</th>
                                  <th>Title of the Thesis (Provisional)</th>
                                  <th>Supervisor Profile</th>
                                  <th>Status of the Thesis</th>
                              </tr>
                          </thead>
                          <tbody>
                          <?php
                          $cnt = 0;

                          if (!empty($response_data['data'])) {

                              // Sort date
                              usort($response_data['data'], function($a, $b) {
                              $dateA = strtotime($a['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');
                              $dateB = strtotime($b['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');

                              // First sort by date (latest first)
                              if ($dateA != $dateB) {
                                  return $dateB - $dateA;
                              }

                              // If dates are same, sort by name alphabetically
                              return strcmp(
                                  $a['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '',
                                  $b['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? ''
                              );
                            });

                              foreach ($response_data['data'] as $row) {
                                  $cnt++;
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo $cnt; ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Area of Research'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Title of the Thesis (Provisional)'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top">
                                  <?php if (!empty($row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor'])) { ?>
                                      <a class="fw-semibold text-primary text-decoration-none"
                                         href="<?php echo $row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor']; ?>"
                                         target="_blank">
                                         View Profile
                                      </a>
                                  <?php } ?>
                              </td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Status of the Thesis'] ?? '') ?></td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                              }

                          } else {
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td colspan="7" class="text-center fw-semibold py-4">
                                  No records found
                              </td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                          }
                          ?>
                       </tbody>
                    </table>
                  </div>
                 </div>
                </div>
             </div>
             <!--RESEARCH FELLOW-->
             <div class="row g-4 mt-2">
              <div class="col-lg-12 col-md-12 col-sm-12 data-item" data-category="research-fellow">

        <p class="dean-excerpt">We believe that this sense of wonderment, thirst for knowledge and wisdom is innate to all human beings. This forms the cornerstone of the philosophy 
        of the School of Physical Sciences that comprises of the Departments of Physics, Mathematics, Electronics and Statistics of the St. Joseph's University. We use these subjects 
        as our tools to nurture logical reasoning ability, a sense of wonderment and scientific temper among our students.</p>
        <p class="dean-excerpt">The Department of Mathematics has nearly a century of history, being one of the first science departments to be started in the erstwhile St. Joseph's 
        College (now St. Joseph's University). The youngest department in this school is the Department of Statistics. All these departments, however, are at the forefront of knowledge 
        creation and dissemination in their respective fields. Many of the teachers are active researchers in diverse fields like Astrophysics, Number Theory, Markov Chains, Internet of 
        Things etc. Our faculty members are sought after by other institutes and departments as resource persons for various teacher training programmes, conferences, seminars and workshops. 
        Some of them are part of the Board of Studies of other universities and colleges, as we believe that together we can grow.</p>
        <p class="dean-excerpt">Our alumni and alumnae are spread far and wide around the globe. Some of them are eminent scientists, researchers and entrepreneurs in India and abroad. 
        Some others are delivering yeomen service for the upliftment of the poor and downtrodden the world over. We are proud of all of them and of the fact that they are all true Josephites, 
        upholding the motto of our university Fide et Labore (Faith and Toil).</p>

        <article id="about" class="dept-section department_tab">
           <div class="title-area"><h2 class="fw-bold text-blue mb-3">About</h2></div>
          <p> The School of Social Work at St Joseph's University, Bengaluru, established in 2005, is committed to nurturing social change agents who seek to improve 
          the quality of life for marginalized and vulnerable communities. The School offers rigorous Bachelor of Social Work (BSW), Master of Social Work (MSW) and 
          PhD programs designed to equip students and scholars with the knowledge, skills, and ethical grounding essential for effective social work practice.</p>

          <p> The BSW program lays a strong foundation by preparing graduates to address the complex social problems of today through critical self-reflection, 
          applied theories, and field work. It fosters an understanding of social justice, human rights, and the need for intervention at individual, family, 
          group, and community levels. The curriculum is built to develop socially sensitive professionals capable of advocating for systemic change. Freshly 
          graduated adolescents are enrolled in this program and are trained on life skills to know oneself better.</p>

          <p> Building on this foundation, the MSW program offers an integrated curriculum that intertwines classroom learning with extensive fieldwork. 
          This blend ensures that students gain hands-on experience while deepening their theoretical knowledge. A well-trained faculty supports students 
          through research and practical guidance to develop competencies that empower them to lead innovative social work interventions. The program emphasizes 
          an intellectual, scientific, and action-based approach to social transformation.</p>

          <p> Each semester includes placements such as concurrent and block fieldwork, rural camp, community visits, and specialized projects, providing students 
          with real-world exposure that prepares them to be catalysts of change. Through this experiential learning, students develop empathy, professional ethics, 
          and leadership qualities essential for social workers.</p>
        </article>

                      our school stands at a historic milestone as we prepare to celebrate the Porcelain Jubilee, a testimony to two decades of unwavering commitment to social transformation through education.</p>

                      <p class="dean-excerpt">We are deeply honoured to have received the prestigious Nehru Yuva Chetana Award and have always been highlighted in the national rankings 
                      among the schools of Social Work, which recognizes not only our academic excellence but our steadfast dedication to empowering the youth and working alongside vulnerable communities.</p>

                      <p class="dean-excerpt">One of the defining strengths of our school is the diversity of our faculty and student body. The multicultural environment enriches learning by fostering mutual 
                      respect, inclusion, and a global outlookâensuring that both students and teachers grow through shared perspectives and lived experiences.</p>
                      <p class="dean-excerpt">As part of a Jesuit University, the School of Social Work is anchored in the Ignatian pedagogical paradigmâwhere context, experience, reflection, 
                      action, and evaluation form the bedrock of learning. Beyond academics, this paradigm instills in students the values of empathy, discernment, and service. 
                      We proudly uphold the Universal Apostolic Preferences, making them integral to our curricular framework and teaching pedagogy.</p>

                      <p class="dean-excerpt">Aligned with the professional benchmarks of the International Federation of Social Workers (IFSW), we design and deliver our BSW and 
                      MSW programmes to ensure global standards in practice-based social work education. These programmes not only enhance the wellbeing of individuals, groups, and 
                      communities but also empower students to see themselves as catalysts of societal transformation. We firmly believe that transformation begins with self-realisation, 
                      and it is this conviction that inspires our holistic approach.</p>

                      <p class="dean-excerpt">Our programmes are recognised across the country for their rigour and fieldwork-based exposure, building a reputation for standing 
                      alongside the excluded and marginalized. From rural camps, study tours, and tribal visits to innovative fieldwork partnerships, students gain invaluable 
                      experiences that connect theory with practice. International and national collaborations through workshops, conferences, and seminars further broaden their 
                      horizons, nurturing socially committed professionals ready to engage with global challenges.</p>

                      <p class="dean-excerpt">At its heart, the School of Social Work seeks to walk as an ally to the marginalized, inspiring our students to actively shape a more 
                      just and inclusive world. Our alumni frequently affirm that the grounding they received here has equipped them not just with skills but with convictionâthe 
                      conviction that social work is a calling to stand with others, build hope, and create change.</p>

                      <p class="dean-excerpt">As we step into our third decade, we look ahead with gratitude, confidence, and renewed commitment to live up to our mission: to educate, 
                      to empower, and to transform. We warmly invite each of our readers to be a part of our school and aid the process of holistic social development.</p>

                    <?php
                         $API_TOKEN='eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJhSWQiOiI0NTNlMzRjNWY1NDU5ZDMxNjg5OCIsImNJZCI6IjYyMDgiLCJvSWQiOiI1IiwiaWF0IjoxNzI0OTE1ODI2fQ.WSAp2aF6p0EiS0kjBzlSvE-1QcLnue8eEvYya0-r4ds';
                         $api_url = "https://sjuv4.linways.com/api/v1/exat2/forms/reports/KkAkaWwi5XkbQiiDs/ALL?departmentId=70";
 
                         $api_ch = curl_init();
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_URL, $api_url);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, ["Authorization: $API_TOKEN", "Accept: application/json"]);
                         curl_setopt($api_ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, false);
                         $response_data = curl_exec($api_ch);
                         $response_data = json_decode($response_data, true);
                         curl_close($api_ch); 
                      ?>
                      
                    <div class="table-responsive">
                      <table class="table table-responsive table-bordered align-middle api_table">
                          <thead>
                              <tr>
                                  <th>Sl. no.</th>
                                  <th>Name of Research Scholar</th>
                                  <th>Date of Enrollment for Coursework at SJU</th>
                                  <th>Area of Research</th>
                                  <th>Title of the Thesis (Provisional)</th>
                                  <th>Supervisor Profile</th>
                                  <th>Status of the Thesis</th>
                              </tr>
                          </thead>
                          <tbody>
                          <?php
                          $cnt = 0;

                          if (!empty($response_data['data'])) {

                              // Sort date
                              usort($response_data['data'], function($a, $b) {
                              $dateA = strtotime($a['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');
                              $dateB = strtotime($b['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '');

                              // First sort by date (latest first)
                              if ($dateA != $dateB) {
                                  return $dateB - $dateA;
                              }

                              // If dates are same, sort by name alphabetically
                              return strcmp(
                                  $a['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '',
                                  $b['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? ''
                              );
                            });

                              foreach ($response_data['data'] as $row) {
                                  $cnt++;
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo $cnt; ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Name of Research Scholar'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Date of enrollment for coursework at SJU'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Area of Research'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Title of the Thesis (Provisional)'] ?? '') ?></td>
                              <td class="align-top">
                                  <?php if (!empty($row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor'])) { ?>
                                      <a class="fw-semibold text-primary text-decoration-none"
                                         href="<?php echo $row['Link to the Profile of the Supervisor']; ?>"
                                         target="_blank">
                                         View Profile
                                      </a>
                                  <?php } ?>
                              </td>
                              <td class="align-top"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['Status of the Thesis'] ?? '') ?></td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                              }

                          } else {
                          ?>
                          <tr>
                              <td colspan="7" class="text-center fw-semibold py-4">
                                  No records found
                              </td>
                          </tr>
                          <?php
                          }
                          ?>
                       </tbody>
                    </table>

    </div>
    <div class="container">
       <div class="p-4 p-md-4 bg-white rounded-4 shadow-sm border">
        <p>The Social Work Students Association supports the Social Work student community, facilitates meaningful learning 
        opportunities within and outside of college, provides events for students to attend and is a powerful voice for students in advocating for improvements to the department.</p>

        <p>SWSA organises various events for the student body throughout the academic year, such as creating awareness through rallies and street plays within college 
        and for the general public, working with the marginalised communities, conducting seminars, discussions and public lectures with eminent professionals from 
        various fields of Social Work, organising student to student forums, student faculty meets and informal networking events for the social work students. 
        Through SWSA the students also participate in public protests. SWSA celebrates national and international days of importance through different programmes. 
        We also have events in collaboration with NGOs within the city. SWSA also has its annual interclass fest, where all BSW and MSW students get a chance to 
        showcase their talents and creativity, and helps in building the class dynamics. SWSA also provides leadership opportunities to students who would like 
        to explore their potentials and play prominent roles in leading the association.</p>
     </div>
   </div>
</section>

<script>
document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#sdg-"]').forEach(function(a) {
  a.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    var target = document.querySelector(this.getAttribute('href'));
    if (target) {
      e.preventDefault();
      target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
      target.style.outline = '3px solid #2563b0';
      target.style.outlineOffset = '4px';
      target.style.borderRadius = '16px';
      setTimeout(function(){ target.style.outline = ''; target.style.outlineOffset = ''; }, 1800);
    }
  });
});
</script>

<?php


$config = file_exists('/home/sjubedu/config.php') ? '/home/sjubedu/config.php' : __DIR__ . '/../../config.php';
require_once $config;
$pdo = new PDO("mysql:host=" . DB_HOST . ";dbname=" . DB_NAME . ";charset=utf8mb4", DB_USER, DB_PASS);
    $pdo->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);

    $today = date('Y-m-d');
$weekStart = date('Y-m-d', strtotime('monday this week'));
$weekEnd = date('Y-m-d', strtotime('sunday this week'));
$monthStart = date('Y-m-01');


    $search = trim($_REQUEST['siteSearch'] ?? '');

    if ($search == '') {
        echo "Enter a search word";
        exit;
    }


$status = 'Y';
$words = explode(' ', $search);

$params = [':status' => $status];

$newsWhere = [];
$eventsWhere = [];
$annWhere = [];

foreach ($words as $index => $word) {

    $key = ":word" . $index;
    $params[$key] = "%$word%";

    $newsWhere[]   = "(title LIKE $key OR description LIKE $key)";
    $eventsWhere[] = "(event_name LIKE $key OR description LIKE $key)";
    $annWhere[]    = "(title LIKE $key OR description LIKE $key)";
}

$newsWhere   = implode(" AND ", $newsWhere);
$eventsWhere = implode(" AND ", $eventsWhere);
$annWhere    = implode(" AND ", $annWhere);

$sql = "
SELECT id, title, slug, description, created_at, 'news' AS type, c_image
FROM news
WHERE c_status = :status AND ($newsWhere)

UNION ALL

SELECT id, event_name AS title, slug, description, created_at, 'events' AS type, c_image
FROM events
WHERE c_status = :status AND ($eventsWhere)

UNION ALL

SELECT id, title, slug, description, created_at, 'announcements' AS type, c_image
FROM announcements
WHERE c_status = :status AND ($annWhere)

ORDER BY created_at DESC
";

$stmt = $pdo->prepare($sql);
$stmt->execute($params);

while ($row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)) {
  $newsDate = date('Y-m-d', strtotime($row['created_at']));


    ?>
<div class="news-type p-3" data-category="">
       <div class="row g-0">

           <div class="col-md-3 pb-3">
<?php if($row['type'] == 'news') { ?>

           <img src="sju_admin/assets/admin/uploads/news/original/<?php echo $row['c_image'];?>" class="img-fluid news-img">
           <?php } elseif($row['type'] == 'events') { ?>
          <img src="sju_admin/assets/admin/uploads/events/original/<?php echo $row['c_image'];?>" class="img-fluid news-img">
           <?php } else { ?>
          <img src="sju_admin/assets/admin/uploads/announcement/original/<?php echo $row['c_image'];?>" class="img-fluid news-img">
          <?php } ?>
           </div>

          <div class="col-md-9">
            <div class="py-2 px-4">
             <span class="news-date"><?php echo date("d-m-Y", strtotime($row['created_at']));?></span>

             <h4 class="fw-bold"><?php echo htmlspecialchars($row['title']);?></h4>

             <p><?php 
              $desc = strip_tags($row['description']);
              echo htmlspecialchars(substr($desc,0,200)); 
              if(strlen($desc) >200) echo "...";
              ?></p>
        <?php if($row['type'] == 'news') { ?>
                <a href="news-detail.php?slug=<?php echo $row['slug']; ?>" class="news-link fw-bold">More</a>

            <?php } elseif($row['type'] == 'events') { ?>
                <a href="events-detail.php?slug=<?php echo $row['slug']; ?>" class="news-link fw-bold">More</a>

            <?php } else { ?>
                <a href="announcement-detail.php?slug=<?php echo $row['slug']; ?>" class="news-link fw-bold">More</a>
            <?php } ?>

<script>
    const tabs = document.querySelectorAll(".news-tabs button");
const newsCards = document.querySelectorAll(".news-type");
const searchInput = document.getElementById("newsSearch");

tabs.forEach(tab => {

tab.addEventListener("click", function(){

tabs.forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove("active","btn-primary"));
tabs.forEach(btn => btn.classList.add("btn-light"));

this.classList.add("active","btn-primary");
this.classList.remove("btn-light");

let filter = this.getAttribute("data-filter");

newsCards.forEach(card => {

if(filter === "all" || card.dataset.category === filter){
card.style.display = "block";
}else{
card.style.display = "none";
}

});

});

});
 


 //SEARCH
 //const searchInput = document.getElementById("newsSearch");
//const newsCards = document.querySelectorAll(".news-type");

searchInput.addEventListener("keyup", function() {

let searchValue = this.value.toLowerCase();

newsCards.forEach(card => {

let text = card.innerText.toLowerCase();

if(text.includes(searchValue)){
    card.style.display = "block";
}else{
    card.style.display = "none";
}

});

});

	<h2>Change in Functioning Style in New Millennium</h2>
			
         <p>
           <ul class="language-list mt-0 p-0" style="list-style-type:none;">
                       <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>During this period -More Collaboration with Global International Movements & Bodies with similar ideologies and Principles</li>
                       <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>AICUFers took part in programmes organised by IMCS,(International Movement For Catholic Students), SAPI (South Asian People's Initiatives), WSF (World Social Forum), WYD (World Youth Day) and so on</li>
                       <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>National Councils, Summer Camps and Commission Programmes were given importance.</li>
			   <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Student Centrality was stressed as always which was and is the core of AICUF movement.</li>
			   <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Student issues and common social issues were discussed & deliberated critically But there seems to be hesitancy in plunging into action as the socio-economic-political scenario kept changing.</li>
			   <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Training Programmes reduced......Financial Constraints came in.</li>
			   <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>National councils in AICUF is the time to review the Unit, Regional, State, and National level AICUF programs and activities, to introspect and clarify from each other about the movement, to evaluate the activities in the light of clarity of the option and relevance of the context.</li>
			   <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Every year new members join the council and bring newness and freshness.</li>
			   <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>The new leaders come to listen, share views, analyse, deliberate and decide for the Federation, ratifying important steps of the states, reinforcing the constitution and meaningful traditions and experiments.</li>
			   <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>National Councils are held every year from the 12th to the 15th of August .</li>
			   <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Only exception is when there is mid-term Consultation or Convention coming the dates may differ otherwise more or less the dates are fixed.Covid changed our normal life and the programmes.</li>
			   <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>We are trying to revive our normalcy in AICUF in this new normal.</li>
			   
              </ul> </p>	
		<h4>Training Programmes conducted</h4>
		 <ul class="language-list mt-0 p-0" style="list-style-type:none;">
		<li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Training Programmes for the Advisors and Animators</li>

National Training Programs Training is the Centre of AICUF Of all the trainings, AICUF considered the following three training programs as important to the movement's growth- • Training for National Advisers and Animators</li>

			 <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>It needs to be cared, nurtured, even pruned to make it grow bigger and Make a difference in the lives of AICUFers and in Society...... 	<p>There are about 500 volunteers in AICUF  from St Joseph's University. All these members take part in the events conducted by the AICUF. We all are known as AICUFers.</p>	
		<h4>Regular Events conducted in AICUF</h4>
	  <ul class="language-list mt-0 p-0" style="list-style-type:none;">
		<li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i><b>Leadership Development Program: </b>
AICUF mainly focuses on certain area of leadership development for students such asdalit politics, communism, fight for marginalized people, women empowerment, transgender empowerment, road safety, awareness on flood safety and role of youth in politics.</li>
			   <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i><b>Orphanage visit: </b>
Aicuf takes initiative of insisting social responsibility in the Students. One way in which this is done by arranging regular visit to ashrams, Homes and orphanages encouraging the students to interact regularly with Residents and carrying out various activities and having interactive sessions with them.</li>
			   <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i><b>Rural camps:</b>
The main objective of conducting rural camps areto create a platform for the students to understand and analyze the Rural Social System, Strategies used by the Non-Governmental Agencies, Nature of Government Intervention for the development of poor people, and to facilitate students experiences of group living.</li>
		  <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i><b>Essay and drawing competition:</b>
This is one form of expressing by the students on a current social issue or problem to get the creative ideas and the thought of students to give a platform to express.</li>
		  <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i><b>Awareness program:</b>
To increase the knowledge of the students on various current social issues and many other informative sessions to the students.</li>
		  <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i><b>Rallies:</b>
Students are encouraged to go on rallies to support a social causein order to show support and spread awareness.</li>
		   <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i><b>Stationary drive:</b>
Collect stationary from the students and donate it to the orphanage kids who are not able to afford them.</li>
		  <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i><b>Regular meetings with Aicufer's:</b>
The main objective of this meeting is to let the Aicufer's know what is going in the council and future plans.</li>
		   <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i><b>Camps:</b>
Here the state organises camps so all the units in the state come together to learn and get to know each other. Help the students in team building and exposure to other places.</li>
			 
		</ul>
	  
	  <br>
	  
	 <h4>Achievements</h4>
	  <ul class="language-list mt-0 p-0" style="list-style-type:none;">
		<li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>We represented our college in an inter collegiate gospel fest conducted by Mount Carmel College and our participants who represented SJU won in many events.</li>			   
		<li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>We conducted an outreach to Vidyaranya orphanage which was another great success</li>
		  <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>We also gave our best to the working of Exodus, an inter collage fest conducted by SJU</li>
		  <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>We have our council member Ms. Rashmi representing the entire college in the state as the Nation Team Member and the Co-Convener.</li>
		  <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>SJU have won in the sports meet conducted by AICUF Karnataka</li>

		</ul>

	 <h4>Testimony of Students</h4>
	  <ul class="language-list mt-0 p-0" style="list-style-type:none;">
		<li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>AICUF - All India Catholic University Federation, is a movement of university students with a vision for a new and just society. Progressing in a history of constant rediscovery and re- creation, the AICUF ever tries to link itself to the emerging needs and realities of the University, the Church and wider society. The AICUF is affiliated to PAX ROMANA – the International Movement of Catholic Students (IMCS).  It was represented Maharashtra and India at several national and international level programs for university students, including the International Council of the IMCS.</li>
		  <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Every year the AICUF takes charge of the Eucharistic celebrations for the feast of St. Ignatius of Loyola and St. Francis Xavier. The annual women's empowerment initiative ‘Ujali' is a combination of talks, panel discussions, debates, poetry sessions and creative activity-based awareness sessions. The annual YES (Youth Encounter Sessions) camps are an opportunity for personality development and socio-cultural awareness. Tutoring underprivileged children and conducting workshops for them are part of social outreach. Besides these regular annual activities, there are many other activities that the AICUF organizes for students. We look forward to being of continual service to the college and to society, especially to those who are marginalized and discriminated against.</li>
		  <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>AICUF - All India Catholic University Federation, is a movement of university students with a vision for a new and just society. Progressing in a history of constant rediscovery and re- creation, the AICUF ever tries to link itself to the emerging needs and realities of the University.</li>
		  <li class="pb-3"><i class="fas fa-check me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>It organizes various activities keeping 3 objectives in mind - Social Outreach, Personality Development and Spiritual Growth. These activities include camps, retreats, hikes, exposure visits, exhibitions, seminars, webinars, rallies and campaigns. The AICUF aims to respond to various social and societal issues, especially those where inequality and injustice are rampant. Social justice and reconciliation is the basis of all AICUF activities. It includes social awareness, social service and social outreach. Our aim is to live up to the AICUF motto - “We are born into an unjust society and we are determined not to leave it as we have found it”.</li>
		   
		</ul>

         <p><strong>Director's Message</strong></p>
         <p>Anchored in the Jesuit tradition of caring for the whole person, the Centre for Human Excellence seeks to form individuals of competence, compassion, commitment, conscience, and creativity. We accompany students in their intellectual, moral, spiritual, and emotional growth through life-skills training, value-based learning, mental health resources, and personalised mentorship. These opportunities foster resilience, self-awareness, and balance, equipping students to face challenges with integrity. Through social analysis, we further instill in students a responsibility for sustainability, justice, and peace. We strive to support and challenge every student to grow fully in knowledge, character, and heart, so that they become persons of "magis" and lead with vision, courage, and compassion to build a more humane and just world.</p>

<?php 
/**
 * 1. S3 FETCH LOGIC (WITH BUILT-IN DEBUGGING)
 */
function get_che_s3_images($folderPath, &$debugLog) {
    $bucket = 'sjub'; 
    $region = 'ap-south-1';
    
    // Ensure folder path format
    $folderPath = trim($folderPath, '/') . '/';
    
    // AWS API Query prefix: Encode spaces as '+' for the API request
    $prefix = str_replace(' ', '+', $folderPath);
    $apiUrl = "https://{$bucket}.s3.{$region}.amazonaws.com/?prefix=" . $prefix;

    $debugLog['API_URL'] = $apiUrl;
    $images = [];
    $xmlContent = false;

    // Use cURL as it is more reliable than file_get_contents on strict servers
    if (function_exists('curl_version')) {
        $ch = curl_init();
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_URL, $apiUrl);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, 1);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, false); // Prevent SSL block
        $xmlContent = curl_exec($ch);
        $debugLog['HTTP_Status'] = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
        $debugLog['cURL_Error'] = curl_error($ch);
        curl_close($ch);
        $debugLog['Fetch_Method'] = 'cURL';
    } else {
        $xmlContent = @file_get_contents($apiUrl);
        $debugLog['Fetch_Method'] = 'file_get_contents';
        if ($xmlContent === false) {
            $err = error_get_last();
            $debugLog['PHP_Error'] = $err ? $err['message'] : 'Unknown file_get_contents error';
        }
    }

    $debugLog['Raw_XML_Response'] = $xmlContent ? htmlspecialchars($xmlContent) : 'No response received.';

    if ($xmlContent !== false && !empty($xmlContent)) {
        try {
            $xml = new SimpleXMLElement($xmlContent);
            $xml->registerXPathNamespace('s3', 'http://s3.amazonaws.com/doc/2006-03-01/');
            
            // Check if AWS threw an error (like AccessDenied)
            if (isset($xml->Code) && isset($xml->Message)) {
                $debugLog['AWS_Error'] = (string)$xml->Code . " - " . (string)$xml->Message;
            }

            $nodes = $xml->xpath('//s3:Contents');
            if ($nodes) {
                foreach ($nodes as $node) {
                    $key = (string)$node->Key;
                    
                    // Match jpg, jpeg, png, webp (case-insensitive)
                    if (preg_match('/\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp)$/i', $key) && !str_ends_with($key, '/')) {
                        
                        $filename = pathinfo($key, PATHINFO_FILENAME);
                        $cleanCaption = ucwords(str_replace(['-', '_'], ' ', $filename));

                        // Encode the final image URL correctly for browsers
                        $encodedKey = implode('/', array_map('rawurlencode', explode('/', $key)));

                        $images[] = [
                            'url' => "https://{$bucket}.s3.{$region}.amazonaws.com/" . $encodedKey,
                            'caption' => $cleanCaption
                        ];
                    }
                }
            } else {
                $debugLog['XML_Parsing'] = 'Found 0 <Contents> nodes. Path might be empty or incorrect.';
            }
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            $debugLog['XML_Parsing_Error'] = $e->getMessage();
        }
    }
    return $images;
}

// 2. DATA COLLECTION
$debugLog = [];

$items_per_page = 12;

if ($current_page < 1) $current_page = 1;

$start_index = ($current_page - 1) * $items_per_page;
$display_images = array_slice($all_images, $start_index, $items_per_page);

<?php print_r($debugLog); ?>
                          </pre>
                          <ul class="mb-0 small text-danger">
                              <li><strong>If HTTP_Status is 403:</strong> The `sjudata` bucket blocks anonymous "ListBucket" access for this folder. Check AWS IAM / Bucket Policies.</li>
                              <li><strong>If Raw_XML_Response is empty/false:</strong> Your server is blocking the outbound connection.</li>
                              <li><strong>If XML shows no files:</strong> Double-check that there are actually `.jpg`, `.png`, or `.webp` files in exactly `Center for Human Excellence/Gallery/` inside S3.</li>

              <?php endif; ?>

              <?php for($i = 1; $i <= $total_pages; $i++): ?>
                  <li class="page-item <?= ($i == $current_page) ? 'active' : '' ?>">

Through interactive sessions, students learn to apply key concepts and frameworks to real-world issues. They engage with contemporary case studies on pressing social concerns in Indian society—such as caste, gender, migration, and environmental justice—developing analytical skills and ethical awareness. The program fosters reflective thinking, collaborative learning, and a deeper understanding of social dynamics. Ideal for students passionate about social impact, it empowers them to become informed, empathetic contributors to a more just and inclusive society.</p>
</div>

Through hands-on sessions, students develop core competencies, emphasising resume writing, interview techniques, Group Discussion, and workplace etiquette, while also nurturing soft skills such as accountability and ownership. Using real-world scenarios and role-play exercises, students gain confidence and clarity in navigating professional environments. Designed to bridge academic learning with industry expectations, this program empowers students to present themselves effectively, collaborate with impact, and thrive in diverse organisational settings.</p>
			  
<p><strong>Kairos (Gratitude Program):</strong> The Gratitude Program is a heartfelt initiative designed for students in their final semester to reflect on their college journey and express appreciation for the people and experiences that shaped them. Through guided activities, sharing circles, and creative expressions, students honour mentors, peers, and personal growth. The program fosters closure, community, and celebration—encouraging students to acknowledge challenges overcome and lessons learned. It culminates in a meaningful ceremony where gratitude becomes a bridge to future aspirations. This reflective space helps students transition with clarity, humility, and a deep sense of connection to their college legacy.</p>

<?php 
/**
 * 1. S3 FETCH LOGIC (WITH BUILT-IN DEBUGGING)
 */
function get_che_s3_images($folderPath, &$debugLog) {
    $bucket = 'sjub'; 
    $region = 'ap-south-1';
    
    // Ensure folder path format
    $folderPath = trim($folderPath, '/') . '/';
    
    // AWS API Query prefix: Encode spaces as '+' for the API request
    $prefix = str_replace(' ', '+', $folderPath);
    $apiUrl = "https://{$bucket}.s3.{$region}.amazonaws.com/?prefix=" . $prefix;

    $debugLog['API_URL'] = $apiUrl;
    $images = [];
    $xmlContent = false;

    // Use cURL as it is more reliable than file_get_contents on strict servers
    if (function_exists('curl_version')) {
        $ch = curl_init();
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_URL, $apiUrl);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, 1);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, false); // Prevent SSL block
        $xmlContent = curl_exec($ch);
        $debugLog['HTTP_Status'] = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
        $debugLog['cURL_Error'] = curl_error($ch);
        curl_close($ch);
        $debugLog['Fetch_Method'] = 'cURL';
    } else {
        $xmlContent = @file_get_contents($apiUrl);
        $debugLog['Fetch_Method'] = 'file_get_contents';
        if ($xmlContent === false) {
            $err = error_get_last();
            $debugLog['PHP_Error'] = $err ? $err['message'] : 'Unknown file_get_contents error';
        }
    }

    $debugLog['Raw_XML_Response'] = $xmlContent ? htmlspecialchars($xmlContent) : 'No response received.';

    if ($xmlContent !== false && !empty($xmlContent)) {
        try {
            $xml = new SimpleXMLElement($xmlContent);
            $xml->registerXPathNamespace('s3', 'http://s3.amazonaws.com/doc/2006-03-01/');
            
            // Check if AWS threw an error (like AccessDenied)
            if (isset($xml->Code) && isset($xml->Message)) {
                $debugLog['AWS_Error'] = (string)$xml->Code . " - " . (string)$xml->Message;
            }

            $nodes = $xml->xpath('//s3:Contents');
            if ($nodes) {
                foreach ($nodes as $node) {
                    $key = (string)$node->Key;
                    
                    // Match jpg, jpeg, png, webp (case-insensitive)
                    if (preg_match('/\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp)$/i', $key) && !str_ends_with($key, '/')) {
                        
                        $filename = pathinfo($key, PATHINFO_FILENAME);
                        $cleanCaption = ucwords(str_replace(['-', '_'], ' ', $filename));

                        // Encode the final image URL correctly for browsers
                        $encodedKey = implode('/', array_map('rawurlencode', explode('/', $key)));

                        $images[] = [
                            'url' => "https://{$bucket}.s3.{$region}.amazonaws.com/" . $encodedKey,
                            'caption' => $cleanCaption
                        ];
                    }
                }
            } else {
                $debugLog['XML_Parsing'] = 'Found 0 <Contents> nodes. Path might be empty or incorrect.';
            }
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            $debugLog['XML_Parsing_Error'] = $e->getMessage();
        }
    }
    return $images;
}

// 2. DATA COLLECTION
$debugLog = [];

<?php
/**
 * Fetch images from S3 and caption them as "Ignitors 1", "Ignitors 2", etc.
 */
function get_ignitors_photos($folderPath) {
    $bucket = 'sjub';
    $region = 'ap-south-1';
    $folderPath = trim($folderPath, '/') . '/';
    $prefix  = str_replace(' ', '+', $folderPath);
    $apiUrl  = "https://{$bucket}.s3.{$region}.amazonaws.com/?prefix=" . $prefix;

    $xmlContent = false;
    if (function_exists('curl_version')) {
        $ch = curl_init();
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_URL, $apiUrl);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, 1);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, false);
        $xmlContent = curl_exec($ch);
        curl_close($ch);
    } else {
        $xmlContent = @file_get_contents($apiUrl);
    }

    $images = [];
    if ($xmlContent) {
        try {
            $xml = new SimpleXMLElement($xmlContent);
            $xml->registerXPathNamespace('s3', 'http://s3.amazonaws.com/doc/2006-03-01/');
            $nodes = $xml->xpath('//s3:Contents');
            if ($nodes) {
                $counter = 1;
                foreach ($nodes as $node) {
                    $key = (string)$node->Key;
                    if (preg_match('/\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp)$/i', $key) && !str_ends_with($key, '/')) {
                        $encodedKey = implode('/', array_map('rawurlencode', explode('/', $key)));
                        $images[] = [
                            'url'     => "https://{$bucket}.s3.{$region}.amazonaws.com/" . $encodedKey,
                            'caption' => 'Ignitors ' . $counter,
                        ];
                        $counter++;
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception $e) { /* silent */ }
    }
    return $images;
}

<?php 
/**
 * 1. S3 FETCH LOGIC
 */
function get_che_s3_images($folderPath) {
    $bucket = 'sjub'; 
    $region = 'ap-south-1';
    $folderPath = trim($folderPath, '/') . '/';
    $prefix = str_replace(' ', '+', $folderPath);
    $apiUrl = "https://{$bucket}.s3.{$region}.amazonaws.com/?prefix=" . $prefix;

    $images = [];
    $ch = curl_init();
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_URL, $apiUrl);
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, 1);
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, false);
    $xmlContent = curl_exec($ch);
    curl_close($ch);

    if ($xmlContent) {
        try {
            $xml = new SimpleXMLElement($xmlContent);
            $xml->registerXPathNamespace('s3', 'http://s3.amazonaws.com/doc/2006-03-01/');
            $nodes = $xml->xpath('//s3:Contents');
            if ($nodes) {
                foreach ($nodes as $node) {
                    $key = (string)$node->Key;
                    if (preg_match('/\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp)$/i', $key) && !str_ends_with($key, '/')) {
                        $filename = pathinfo($key, PATHINFO_FILENAME);
                        $cleanCaption = ucwords(str_replace(['-', '_'], ' ', $filename));
                        $encodedKey = implode('/', array_map('rawurlencode', explode('/', $key)));
                        $images[] = [
                            'url' => "https://{$bucket}.s3.{$region}.amazonaws.com/" . $encodedKey,
                            'caption' => $cleanCaption
                        ];
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception $e) {}
    }
    return $images;
}

$all_images = get_che_s3_images('Center for Human Excellence/Gallery');

<?php 
/**
 * 1. S3 PREVIEW FETCH LOGIC
 */
function get_preview_images($folderPath, $limit = 7) {
    $bucket = 'sjub'; 
    $region = 'ap-south-1';
    $encodedPath = str_replace(' ', '+', trim($folderPath, '/')) . '/';
    $apiUrl = "https://{$bucket}.s3.{$region}.amazonaws.com/?prefix=" . $encodedPath;
    $images = [];
    $ch = curl_init();
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_URL, $apiUrl);
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, 1);
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, false);
    $xmlContent = curl_exec($ch);
    curl_close($ch);
    if ($xmlContent !== false) {
        try {
            $xml = new SimpleXMLElement($xmlContent);
            $xml->registerXPathNamespace('s3', 'http://s3.amazonaws.com/doc/2006-03-01/');
            $nodes = $xml->xpath('//s3:Contents');
            if ($nodes) {
                foreach ($nodes as $node) {
                    $key = (string)$node->Key;
                    if (preg_match('/\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp|JPG|JPEG)$/i', $key) && !str_ends_with($key, '/')) {
                        $images[] = "https://{$bucket}.s3.{$region}.amazonaws.com/" . str_replace(' ', '+', $key);
                    }
                    if (count($images) >= $limit) break; 
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception $e) {}
    }
    return $images;
}

$preview_imgs = get_preview_images('Hostel/Gallery/Ladies-B', 7);
if (count($preview_imgs) < 7) {
    $preview_imgs = array_pad($preview_imgs, 7, 'https://via.placeholder.com/800x600?text=SJU+Hostel');
}

<?php 
/**
 * 1. S3 FETCH LOGIC
 */
function get_sju_s3_images($folderPath) {
    $bucket = 'sjub'; 
    $region = 'ap-south-1';
    $folderPath = trim($folderPath, '/') . '/';
    $apiUrl = "https://{$bucket}.s3.{$region}.amazonaws.com/?prefix=" . urlencode($folderPath);

    $images = [];
    $xmlContent = @file_get_contents($apiUrl);

    if ($xmlContent !== false) {
        try {
            $xml = new SimpleXMLElement($xmlContent);
            $xml->registerXPathNamespace('s3', 'http://s3.amazonaws.com/doc/2006-03-01/');
            $nodes = $xml->xpath('//s3:Contents');

            foreach ($nodes as $node) {
                $key = (string)$node->Key;
                // Get images, ignore folder markers
                if (preg_match('/\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp|JPG|JPEG)$/i', $key) && !str_ends_with($key, '/')) {
                    
                    $pathParts = explode('/', $key);
                    // Get subfolder name (e.g., "Event Name (Ladies Hostel)") for the caption
                    $subFolder = (count($pathParts) > 4) ? $pathParts[count($pathParts) - 2] : '';
                    $filename = pathinfo($key, PATHINFO_FILENAME);
                    
                    $cleanCaption = !empty($subFolder) ? $subFolder : $filename;
                    $cleanCaption = ucwords(str_replace(['-', '_'], ' ', $cleanCaption));

                    $images[] = [
                        'url' => "https://{$bucket}.s3.{$region}.amazonaws.com/" . $key,
                        'caption' => $cleanCaption
                    ];
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception $e) {}
    }
    return $images;
}

// 2. DATA COLLECTION
$ladies_images = get_sju_s3_images('Hostel/Gallery/Ladies');
$gents_images  = get_sju_s3_images('Hostel/Gallery/Gents');

foreach($gents_images as $img) { $img['cat'] = 'gents'; $img['cat_label'] = 'Gents Hostel'; $all_images[] = $img; }

// 3. PAGINATION
$items_per_page = 12; 
$current_page = isset($_GET['page']) ? (int)$_GET['page'] : 1;
if ($current_page < 1) $current_page = 1;

$total_images = count($all_images);
$total_pages = ceil($total_images / $items_per_page);
$start_index = ($current_page - 1) * $items_per_page;
$display_images = array_slice($all_images, $start_index, $items_per_page);

    $(document).ready(function() {
        // Initialize Slideshow & Click to Zoom
        $('.popup-gallery').magnificPopup({
            delegate: 'a',
            type: 'image',
            gallery: {
                enabled: true,
                navigateByImgClick: true,
                preload: [0,1]
            },
            zoom: {
                enabled: true,
                duration: 300
            }
        });
    });

    function filterGallery(category, btn) {
        $('.filter-btn').removeClass('active');
        $(btn).addClass('active');

        if (category === 'all') {
            $('.gallery-item').fadeIn(400);
        } else {
            $('.gallery-item').hide();
            $('.gallery-item[data-category="' + category + '"]').fadeIn(400);
        }
    }
    </script>

<?php 
/**
 * 1. S3 PREVIEW FETCH LOGIC
 * Fetches exactly 7 images from the Ladies folder for the staggered layout
 */
function get_preview_images($folderPath, $limit = 7) {
    $bucket = 'sjub'; 
    $region = 'ap-south-1';
    $folderPath = trim($folderPath, '/') . '/';
    $apiUrl = "https://{$bucket}.s3.{$region}.amazonaws.com/?prefix=" . urlencode($folderPath);

    $images = [];
    $xmlContent = @file_get_contents($apiUrl);

    if ($xmlContent !== false) {
        try {
            $xml = new SimpleXMLElement($xmlContent);
            $xml->registerXPathNamespace('s3', 'http://s3.amazonaws.com/doc/2006-03-01/');
            $nodes = $xml->xpath('//s3:Contents');

            foreach ($nodes as $node) {
                $key = (string)$node->Key;
                if (preg_match('/\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp|JPG|JPEG)$/i', $key) && !str_ends_with($key, '/')) {
                    $images[] = "https://{$bucket}.s3.{$region}.amazonaws.com/" . $key;
                }
                if (count($images) >= $limit) break; 
            }
        } catch (Exception $e) {}
    }
    return $images;
}

// Fetch 7 images specifically from the Ladies folder
$preview_imgs = get_preview_images('Hostel/Gallery/Ladies-B', 7);

// Fallback logic if S3 is empty
if (count($preview_imgs) < 7) {
    $preview_imgs = array_pad($preview_imgs, 7, 'https://via.placeholder.com/800x600?text=SJU+Hostel');
}

<?php 
/**
 * 1. S3 PREVIEW FETCH LOGIC
 * Fetches exactly 7 images from the Ladies folder for the staggered layout
 */
function get_preview_images($folderPath, $limit = 7) {
    $bucket = 'sjub'; 
    $region = 'ap-south-1';
    $folderPath = trim($folderPath, '/') . '/';
    $apiUrl = "https://{$bucket}.s3.{$region}.amazonaws.com/?prefix=" . urlencode($folderPath);

    $images = [];
    $xmlContent = @file_get_contents($apiUrl);

    if ($xmlContent !== false) {
        try {
            $xml = new SimpleXMLElement($xmlContent);
            $xml->registerXPathNamespace('s3', 'http://s3.amazonaws.com/doc/2006-03-01/');
            $nodes = $xml->xpath('//s3:Contents');

            foreach ($nodes as $node) {
                $key = (string)$node->Key;
                if (preg_match('/\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp|JPG|JPEG)$/i', $key) && !str_ends_with($key, '/')) {
                    $images[] = "https://{$bucket}.s3.{$region}.amazonaws.com/" . $key;
                }
                if (count($images) >= $limit) break; 
            }
        } catch (Exception $e) {}
    }
    return $images;
}

// Fetch 7 images specifically from the Ladies folder
$preview_imgs = get_preview_images('Hostel/Gallery/Ladies-B', 7);

// Fallback logic if S3 is empty
if (count($preview_imgs) < 7) {
    $preview_imgs = array_pad($preview_imgs, 7, 'https://via.placeholder.com/800x600?text=SJU+Hostel');
}

<?php 
/**
 * 1. S3 PREVIEW FETCH LOGIC
 * Fetches exactly 7 images from the Ladies folder for the staggered layout
 */
function get_preview_images($folderPath, $limit = 7) {
    $bucket = 'sjub'; 
    $region = 'ap-south-1';
    $folderPath = trim($folderPath, '/') . '/';
    $apiUrl = "https://{$bucket}.s3.{$region}.amazonaws.com/?prefix=" . urlencode($folderPath);

    $images = [];
    $xmlContent = @file_get_contents($apiUrl);

    if ($xmlContent !== false) {
        try {
            $xml = new SimpleXMLElement($xmlContent);
            $xml->registerXPathNamespace('s3', 'http://s3.amazonaws.com/doc/2006-03-01/');
            $nodes = $xml->xpath('//s3:Contents');

            foreach ($nodes as $node) {
                $key = (string)$node->Key;
                if (preg_match('/\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp|JPG|JPEG)$/i', $key) && !str_ends_with($key, '/')) {
                    $images[] = "https://{$bucket}.s3.{$region}.amazonaws.com/" . $key;
                }
                if (count($images) >= $limit) break; 
            }
        } catch (Exception $e) {}
    }
    return $images;
}

// Fetch 7 images specifically from the Ladies folder
$preview_imgs = get_preview_images('Hostel/Gallery/Ladies', 7);

// Fallback logic if S3 is empty
if (count($preview_imgs) < 7) {
    $preview_imgs = array_pad($preview_imgs, 7, 'https://via.placeholder.com/800x600?text=SJU+Hostel');
}

            <p>St Joseph's University prides itself on creating an academic ambience that fosters learning, growth, and intellectual development. 
            The university's commitment to providing a conducive academic environment is reflected in various aspects of its campus and facilities.</p>
            <p>The university's hostels play a significant role in cultivating an academic ambience. The magnificently designed men's hostel is equipped 
            with all the necessary amenities to ensure a comfortable stay for the students. The well-maintained rooms offer a peaceful and conducive atmosphere 
            for studying and rest. With the provision of single rooms, students have the privacy and solitude they need to focus on their academic pursuits.</p>
            <p>The academic ambience is further enhanced by the presence of dedicated spaces within the hostel. There are four large halls, including a prayer hall, 
            which provide additional areas for studying, group discussions, and communal activities. In response to the evolving needs of the students, two of these 
            halls have been converted into cubicles, expanding the accommodation capacity of the hostel.</p>
            <p>Overall, St Joseph's University is committed to maintaining an academic ambience that encourages learning, critical thinking, and personal growth. 
            The well-designed hostels, along with their amenities and architectural significance, contribute to creating an environment that nurtures the intellectual 
            development and holistic well-being of the students.</p>

           <!-- Heading -->
           <div class="mb-3"> 
             <h2 class="guidelines-title mt-3"> Home Away From Home</h2>
           </div>
           <p>St Joseph's University Boys Hostel, located on the campus, is a 75-year-old hostel and celebrated its platinum jubilee on 26 January 2023. 
           It has been home to some brilliant and renowned minds of this institution. With its well-designed infrastructure and essential amenities, 
           it provides a comfortable and conducive environment for students' boarding needs and recreational activities.</p>

           <p>One of the remarkable aspects of the hostel is its architectural beauty, due to which the hostel block building stands out as a remarkable specimen, 
           making it a heritage building. The hostel building, constructed in 1948, boasts a unique semi-circular or crescent-shaped design. The building itself is made of stone, 
           giving it a timeless and elegant appeal and showcasing the university's commitment to preserving its rich heritage. The green plants and the flowering bougainvillea add 
           to the overall aesthetic appeal.</p>

           <p>Inside the hostel, there are various facilities to cater to the students' needs. The hostel offers single rooms for accommodation, ensuring privacy 
           and personal space for each resident. Additionally, there are large halls, including a prayer hall, which serve as common areas for socialising, studying, 
           and engaging in group activities. Over time, some of these halls have been converted into cubicles, increasing the accommodation capacity of the hostel.</p>

           <p>To promote a healthy and well-balanced lifestyle the hostel has its own canteen. The canteen operates on a cooperative basis, providing students with 
           hygienic and nutritious meals. This facility not only saves students the hassle of cooking but also serves as a gathering place where the residents can 
           enjoy tasty food while fostering a sense of community among themselves.</p>

           <p>Additionally, St Joseph's University also has a second hostel for boys, located in Ejipura, approximately 4 kilometers away from the university campus. 
           This additional hostel, known as St Berchman's Hostel, can accommodate 20 boys and offers dormitory facilities. The university is actively working on arranging a 
           canteen facility to cater to the residents' dining needs.</p>

           <p>Overall, St Joseph's University Hostel and its extension, St Berchman's Hostel, provide a safe, comfortable, and nurturing living space for students 
           pursuing their education. With its well-maintained infrastructure, essential amenities, and a supportive community, the hostels truly serve as a home 
           away from home for the students, allowing them to focus on their studies and personal growth.</p>
        </article>
